title: Campus Finance Specialist I (ES)
location: MOSSY OAKS ELEMENTARY(High-Needs School), South Carolina
description:
POSITION PURPOSE: Performs various routine-to-moderately complex bookkeeping and clerical work to ensure efficient and effective school fiscal operations. Provides assistance to supervisor, co-workers, students and the general public as required. This position is often assigned additional duties that support the school in general.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Obtains price quotes and verifies available funds for equipment, supplies and materials; prepares electronic purchase orders; processes invoices for payment.
  • Communicates with vendors as needed to obtain pricing and availability information, expedite orders, and resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Manages the use of procurement cards and electronically reconciles transactions in the card management program.
  • Collects, receipts, records, and deposits various school revenues; prepares billing invoices as required; maintains individual accounts as assigned, including pupil activity accounts.
  • Maintains accurate and up-to-date ledgers and other financial records; prepares periodic financial reports as required by the school and district; balances imprest account bank statements.
  • May perform routine bookkeeping and reporting duties for assigned grants.
  • Processes reimbursement requests, travel vouchers, travel requests, etc.
  • Records the receipt of equipment and supplies electronically.
  • Prepares records for internal and external audits.
  • Orders, dispenses, and takes inventory of school supplies.
  • Assists supervisor and other department staff by performing a variety of clerical duties, which may include but are not limited to typing routine reports and correspondence, copying, and filing documents, collating materials, sending, and receiving faxes, maintaining logs and lists, processing daily mail, distributing staff paychecks and direct deposit notifications, etc.
  • Interacts and communicates with a variety of individuals and groups, which may include the immediate supervisor, other school administrators and staff, district staff, students, parents/guardians, sales representatives, various outside organizations and professionals, and the public.
  • Performs computer data entry to record and retrieve information; generates spreadsheets and other computer reports as required.
  • Answers telephone to provide information, take messages, or transfer calls.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES: Performs other related tasks as assigned by the Principal, Chief Officer, Superintendent or other district office administrator as designated by the Superintendent.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Three years of bookkeeping experience required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual should be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office products including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint. Ability to use the Internet for research applications. Minimum of 60 wpm. Database management skills are desirable. Must possess working knowledge of common office equipment, such as fax, copier, calculator, etc.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job and are not meant to be all inclusive. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job.

Unless reasonable accommodations can be made, while performing this job the staff member shall:

  1. Use strength to lift items needed to perform the functions of the job.
  2. Sit, stand and walk for required periods of time.
  3. Speak and hear.
  4. Use close vision, color vision, peripheral vision and depth perception along with the ability to focus vision.
  5. Communicate effectively in English, using proper grammar and vocabulary. American Sign Language or Braille may also be considered as acceptable forms of communication.
  6. Reach with hands and arms and use hands and fingers to handle objects and operate tools, technology equipment, computers, and/or controls.

WORK PLACE EXPECTATIONS:

  1. Work effectively with and respond to diverse cultures or backgrounds.
  2. Demonstrate professionalism and appropriate judgment in behavior, speech, and dress in a neat, clean and professional manner for the assignment and work setting.
  3. Have regular and punctual attendance.

title: Principal Network Engineer
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every Rocket Lab launch depends on networks that perform the first time, every time. From the HMIs and telemetry servers at the pad to live streams, mission control and customer connectivity, our Launch networks keep engineers, operators and customers connected through every stage of a mission.

Based in our Auckland Production Complex, the Principal Network Engineer will be responsible for the implementation, administration and operation of all networks and firewalls supporting Launch and Launch Operations. This includes our Electron and Neutron launch systems and related sites, such as rocket launch sites and engine test facilities. You'll lead upgrades and new site commissioning, set the standards that keep our Launch infrastructure secure and reliable, and be the go-to network expert for the Launch team.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role. Reporting to the Team Lead – IT Engineer, you'll work alongside our other Network Engineers and a team of world-class IT, engineering and business professionals. It's a high-stakes environment where reliability matters, and it's a rare opportunity to build and run the networks behind real rocket launches.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Deploy and manage highly reliable, scalable network infrastructure and supporting software that enables Rocket Lab engineers and launch personnel to deliver world-class launch capabilities.
  • Implement, administer and operate the networks and firewalls behind Launch Operations, including HMIs, live streams, loggers and telemetry servers, remote operators, mission control room infrastructure and customer connectivity.
  • Provide subject matter expertise to deliver and support highly reliable, highly available network infrastructure for the Launch team.
  • Lead upgrades and maintenance with a focus on continuous improvement, keeping our network infrastructure reliable and secure.
  • Lead or assist with project scoping, planning and deployment for Launch network infrastructure and new site commissioning projects in support of Annual Operating Plan goals.
  • Implement standards for deploying and managing Launch infrastructure environments, ensuring compliance with Rocket Lab policies and cybersecurity policies, standards and procedures.
  • Drive simplified, consistent environment management practices and automated build and maintenance processes.
  • Improve system reliability and ensure High Availability and Disaster Recovery are built into our Launch environments.
  • Make sure the team is providing effective support, with clear and concise reporting on usage, uptime and support levels.
  • Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation of environments and support processes.
  • Manage infrastructure costs efficiently.
  • Work with the other Network Engineers to establish WAN and LAN networking standards.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of experience in IT, including at least 4 years in a platform-focused technology role.
  • Expert knowledge of Juniper or Cisco network switching and firewall setup, configuration and management.
  • Strong knowledge of WAN, SD-WAN, routing, IPSec, SSL VPNs and firewalls.
  • The ability to lead projects from scoping and planning through to deployment.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly.
  • A proactive, "How can I help?" attitude and a willingness to own your work through to completion.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • A specialist qualification in your area of expertise, such as CISM, AWS, Azure or Microsoft certifications.
  • Experience with AWS and/or O365 and Azure enterprise environments.
  • Experience with one or more of Kubernetes, VMware, Linux or Windows.
  • Experience with configuration management, automation and/or Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with one or more of server and storage hardware, backups, or HA/DR/BC.
  • Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, Certificate Management (PKI), DNS or DHCP.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001 or NIST 800-171.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Domestic and international travel may be required.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

title: Standaard
description:
Kwaliteit is voor Verdi Groep meer dan voldoen aan normen en certificeringen. Het gaat om een manier van werken waarin kwaliteit, veiligheid, compliance en continu verbeteren onderdeel zijn van onze dagelijkse praktijk.

Daarom zoeken wij een Kwaliteitsmanager die richting geeft aan ons kwaliteitsmanagement en helpt om dit binnen de hele organisatie verder te professionaliseren.

Jouw rol

Als Centrale Kwaliteitsmanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, implementatie en verbetering van het centrale kwaliteitsmanagementsysteem binnen Verdi Groep.

Je vertaalt organisatiedoelstellingen, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, SBCA en NEN7510 wet- en regelgeving en ontwikkelingen binnen de arbodienstverlening naar duidelijke kaders en werkbare processen. Vanuit jouw centrale rol bewaak je de samenhang tussen kwaliteit, compliance, risico's, privacy en informatiebeveiliging in nauwe samenwerking met de CISO.

Je stuurt functioneel de regionale kwaliteitscoördinatoren aan en bent een onafhankelijke gesprekspartner voor directie en management. Je brengt risico's en verbeterpunten in beeld en zorgt dat deze worden omgezet in concrete acties.


Wat ga je doen?

  • Strategisch kwaliteitsmanagement: Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van het centrale kwaliteitsbeleid, het kwaliteitssysteem en de kwaliteitsjaarplanning

  • Coördineren van interne audits en externe ISO 9001, ISO 27001, SBCA en NEN7510 - audits en zorgen voor een goede opvolging van bevindingen

  • Functioneel aansturen en ondersteunen van regionale kwaliteitscoördinatoren

  • Analyseren van kwaliteitsdata, klachten, incidenten en audits en vertalen naar verbetermaatregelen

  • Adviseren van directie en management over kwaliteit, compliance, risico's en verbeterprioriteiten

  • Bijdragen aan een sterke kwaliteitscultuur waarin eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan


Wat wij bieden?

  • Een centrale rol binnen een groeiende organisatie

  • Veel ruimte om te bouwen aan structuur en professionalisering

  • Directe samenwerking met management en verschillende disciplines binnen Verdi Groep

  • Veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief

  • Een professionele, ondernemende en mensgerichte werkomgeving

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling


Wie ben jij?

  • Je beschikt over hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau en hebt ervaring binnen kwaliteitsmanagement

  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van ISO 9001 en ervaring met interne en externe audits

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar duidelijke acties

  • Je bent zelfstandig, organisatiesensitief en overtuigend in je advisering

  • Je weet mensen te verbinden en mee te nemen in verandering

  • Kennis van NEN 7510, AVG en kwaliteitsmanagement binnen zorg of arbodienstverlening


Over Verdi Groep

Verdi Groep is een groeiend collectief van organisaties gespecialiseerd in arbeid, gezondheid, verzuim, preventie, duurzame inzetbaarheid en sociale zekerheid. Vanuit verschillende labels ondersteunen wij werkgevers en werknemers bij gezond, veilig en duurzaam werken.

Door onze groei en verdere ontwikkeling wordt een sterke en eenduidige kwaliteitsbasis steeds belangrijker. Als Centrale Kwaliteitsmanager krijg je de ruimte om hier vanuit een centrale rol aan bij te dragen en samen met collega's verder te bouwen aan kwaliteit binnen de hele organisatie.


Interesse?

Wil jij bouwen aan een professioneel en toekomstbestendig kwaliteitsmanagement binnen Verdi Groep?

Neem dan contact op met onze Corporate Recruiter Cars Klappe via cars.klappe@verdigroep.nl of 06-25447550. We vertellen je graag meer over de functie, het team en de ambities van Verdi Groep.

title: Senior Equipment Engineer
description:
The Equipment Engineer is responsible for equipment troubleshooting, installation, qualification, modification, automation, and continuous improvement to ensure stable, reliable, and efficient equipment performance. Mechanical, electrical, software, AI, and automation solutions are designed and integrated to enhance process equipment capability and automation tooling performance. Maintenance procedures, technical documentation, safety standards, and technician training are developed, while equipment projects, equipment characterization, and manufacturing capability development are supported.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Equipment troubleshooting, installation, qualification, modification, and continuous improvement are supported across manufacturing lines.
  • Equipment automation and upgrades are developed and implemented using AI and the latest automation technologies to improve equipment stability, performance, and productivity.
  • Electrical drawings, wiring layouts, software debugging, and control systems are prepared and maintained for process equipment.
  • Different equipment modules and systems are integrated to ensure stable and reliable operation.
  • Mechanical and electrical components are designed, modified, and assembled to improve equipment performance across various process requirements.
  • Process parameters are monitored and optimized to achieve consistent output quality and performance targets.
  • Maintenance, troubleshooting, and testing procedures are developed for equipment electrical and mechanical components.
  • Equipment characterization and capability studies are performed to ensure equipment meets required quality, performance, and specification standards.
  • Equipment design, modification, expansion, and automation projects are supported.
  • SOPs, safety procedures, environmental requirements, and HIRAC documentation are prepared and maintained.
  • Technical and safety training are provided, and safety guidelines are established for equipment technicians.
  • Process, manufacturing, automation teams, and suppliers are closely collaborated with to identify problems, develop solutions, and drive equipment improvements.
  • Consumable usage and equipment-related costs are monitored and optimized to reduce cost of ownership.
  • Equipment-related data is collected and analyzed to support continuous improvement and predictive maintenance initiatives.

REQUIRED:

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Materials Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related engineering field.
  • Fresh graduates with relevant engineering qualifications are encouraged to apply.

PREFERRED:

  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on equipment, automation, electrical/mechanical systems, or process equipment
  • Good problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills related to surface finishing and polishing processes
  • Experience or strong interest in CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization), polishing automation, AI-based process control, robotics, and new technologies

title: Computerized Maintenance Management System Program Lead
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Provides leadership and strategic direction for the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) and associated processes to ensure efficient and effective execution of the goals of the Sewer District’s maintenance program. Key consultant in the maintenance program and is the owner of CMMS processes, procedures and data integrity. Analyzes data and reports for improvement activities and proactively works to improve the performance of services to deliver enhanced value to Operation and Maintenance. Works closely with internal and external stakeholders to design, implement, and manage CMMS processes within the organization. Performs other duties of a similar nature as may be required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Program and Process Ownership

  • Designs, implements, and executes CMMS processes. Serves as program manager, which entails end-to-end ownership of the system processes.
  • Generates requirements for implementation of processes and serves as subject matter expert within the ideation phase to determine the execution path.
  • Ensures appropriate business processes are developed and documented to capture relevant job and asset data in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Implements and facilitates change management processes, including authorizing changes and communicating impact to team and end users.
  • Responsible for developing CMMS program goals and objectives, managing the development of software applications and databases, and coordinating requirements between departmental systems and work processes.
  • Develop reports that assess process Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for the purposes of demonstrating effectiveness and compliance.
  • Leads the effective utilization of the CMMS; ensures that data integrity is maintained, and reports provide accurate and relevant information for proper evaluation and decision-making.

Asset Management System Standardization and Maintenance

  • Establishes and maintains the CMMS asset hierarchy. Enforces consistency with asset naming, asset descriptions, asset class hierarchy, and asset locations.
  • Ensures preventative maintenance schedules, inspections and checklist are consistently implemented.
  • Works Sewer District-wide to standardize preventative maintenance procedures.
  • Enforces CMMS and Asset Management standards by creating, designing, communicating, and maintaining the standards and formats.
  • Establishes and maintains an asset tagging program for ease in asset identification.
  • Develops Standard Operating Procedures for CMMS users to follow to ensure the collection of data and information remains consistent, efficient, and effective.
  • Maintains the CMMS structure for both vertical and horizontal assets to allow for the utilization of a risk-based asset management strategy developed by rating assets for consequence and likelihood of failure.
  • Develops and improves CMMS reporting systems to track operational and asset performance. Develops workflows and customized inspection forms as needed to collect data to support the CMMS application.
  • Troubleshoots system and business process issues by working with end users and software vendors. Maintains adequate communication of outages and planned downtime to all affected.
  • Develops and maintains mobile device strategy and implements training program for CMMS mobile devices.
  • Establishes system response and recovery plans.
  • Establishes and maintains software service contracts with vendor.

Analysis and Reporting

  • Analyzes and researches trends to determine applicable intervention activities. Utilizes data for problem identification and/or bottleneck recognition.
  • Creates, analyzes, reports, converts and/or transfers data using industry-standard or customized GIS/CMMS software tools. Utilizes problem analysis and problem-solving skills, evaluating all possible alternatives and recommending best solutions/courses of action to meet organization, customer, project and/or program needs.
  • Transforms performance metrics, KPI’s and other data into comprehensible formats, such as diagrams, workflows, flowcharts for Sewer District stakeholders.
  • Creates, analyzes and presents various data, including but not limited to results, reports, findings, plans, recommendations, to diverse audiences at various levels throughout the Sewer

Organizational Development and Continuous Improvement

  • Continually meets with internal and external CMMS users to identify and implement system or workflow process improvements to ensure the meeting of objectives.
  • Assigns and manages direct reports to develop and maintain CMMS automated work processes and asset management reporting capabilities.
  • Trains, develops and coaches direct reports and end users in areas where CMMS activities are required.
  • Supervises and directs assigned staff by providing training, coaching and mentoring. Responsible for assessing performance, provides constructive feedback, documents discipline issues, provides additional training and takes corrective action as needed. Responsible for time tracking including approving time worked and time off requests in the Human Resources Information System (HRIS).
  • Performs other duties of a similar nature as may be required.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION

Candidate must possess a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Services, Business Administration or a closely related field.

EXPERIENCE

  • Candidate must possess five (5) years of experience in managing and analysis of asset related data in areas of planning, corrective or continuous improvement initiatives and processes.
  • Candidate must possess three (3) years of experience supervising, managing and/or leading people, projects and/or processes.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Candidate must possess knowledge in asset management principles and practices.
  • Candidate must possess the ability to effectively plan, coordinator, establish and maintain effective working relationships and prioritize workloads based on available resources.
  • Candidate must possess strong public speaking skills to be able to present to a broad audience of users, including business leaders.
  • Must be able to adapt to a rapidly changing environment, anticipate business needs, multitask and work efficiently with minimal supervision.
  • Candidate must possess negotiation and conflict resolution skills to address issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Candidate must be detail oriented and capable of managing large amounts of data, maintain detailed comprehensive records, analyze and organize information, have effective project and time management skills and be well organized.
  • Must possess the ability to prepare reports and communicate and/or present information to non- technical audiences, establish and maintain effective professional relationships, interact effectively at all levels throughout the organization, successfully lead, influence and persuade constituents and work individually or as part of a team.
  • Candidate must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, Access, Outlook and PowerPoint.
  • Candidate must be proficient in database Must possess experience in the utilization of a CMMS application, GIS application, Microsoft Visio. Must be able to learn new tools, software and processes as project needs dictate.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

During the course of performing the essential functions of this position the employee must be able to compare, compute, analyze, synthesize, copy, compile, coordinate, negotiate and instruct. Ability to communicate while exhibiting strong interpersonal skills is required. Physical work will need to be performed, such as sitting, talking, fingering and hearing. Ability to lift up to 10 lbs. on a frequent basis. Position will require visual demands of depth perception, color vision, accommodation and near acuity. The position is primarily office work; however, the position may require visiting District sites up to 20% of the typical workday.

Pay Range: USD, Commensurate with Experience

$80,606 - $100,758

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Our Accessibility Statement

Our Employee Benefits & Wellness Programs
We offer a comprehensive employee benefits package including Health Insurance Coverage, Various Retirement Planning Options (Ohio Public Employee Retirement System and Deferred Compensation Plans), Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Program, Free Parking at our facilities, Corporate Discounts, and more! We also have an active Health & Wellness Program that promotes a life/work balance.

NEORSD supports the use of hybrid work as a way to help attract and retain talented individuals in public service, increase worker productivity and better prepares the agency to operate during emergencies. This position may be authorized for hybrid work. hybrid eligibility will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Adviseur Integraal Capaciteitsmanagement
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Adviseur ICM houd je je bezig met vraagstukken rondom Integraal Capaciteitsmanagement. Je werkt op het snijvlak van zorg, bedrijfsvoering, planning en data. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar afzonderlijke afdelingen, maar juist naar de samenhang tussen patiëntstromen, personeel, middelen en beschikbare capaciteit.
Je verzamelt en analyseert gegevens en vertaalt deze naar inzichten die management en andere betrokkenen ondersteunen bij het maken van keuzes. Je werkt daarbij aan tactische en operationele capaciteitsvraagstukken binnen je eigen aandachtsgebied.
Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • data over patiëntstromen, bezetting, personeel en middelen verzamelen, analyseren en interpreteren;

  • ondersteunen bij het opstellen en monitoren van capaciteitsplannen op afdelingsniveau;

  • knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden in capaciteit en processen signaleren en vertalen naar concrete voorstellen;

  • verbeterinitiatieven begeleiden die gericht zijn op een efficiëntere inzet van beschikbare capaciteit en resources;

  • management en andere stakeholders adviseren over capaciteitsvraagstukken en mogelijke scenario's;

  • rapportages en dashboards ontwikkelen en opstellen als stuurinformatie voor besluitvorming;

  • bijdragen aan evaluaties en managementinformatie;

  • samenwerken met verschillende disciplines om Integraal Capaciteitsmanagement verder te verankeren binnen Maastricht UMC+.

Daarbij krijg je ruimte om binnen de afgesproken richtlijnen en beleidskaders zelf invulling te geven aan de aanpak, werkwijze en inhoud van je analyses en adviesproducten.

Hoe ziet je werkomgeving eruit?

Integraal Capaciteitsmanagement, kortweg ICM, richt zich op de integrale afstemming tussen patiëntstromen en de beschikbare capaciteit van Maastricht UMC+. Daarbij gaat het onder andere om mensen, middelen en materialen.
Het doel is om vraag en aanbod zo goed mogelijk op elkaar af te stemmen, zodat beschikbare capaciteit optimaal wordt benut en patiënten op het juiste moment de juiste zorg kunnen ontvangen.
Binnen ICM wordt onder andere gewerkt aan vraagstukken rondom:

  • klinische capaciteit;

  • opnameplanning;

  • operatiekamercapaciteit;

  • personele inzet;

  • poliklinische capaciteit;

  • capaciteit van Beeldvorming en andere diagnostiek.

Je werkt daarbij samen met onder andere afdelingshoofden, teamleiders, zorgprofessionals, collega's vanuit Financiën en Bedrijfsvoering, planning en BI/ICT. Vanuit verschillende perspectieven werk je samen aan één gezamenlijk vraagstuk: hoe zetten we de beschikbare capaciteit zo goed mogelijk in voor onze patiënten?

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die analytisch sterk is, snel verbanden legt en het interessant vindt om zorg, data en bedrijfsvoering met elkaar te verbinden. Je hoeft nog geen ervaren adviseur te zijn; belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent, gestructureerd werkt en complexe informatie kunt vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en adviezen.
Je beschikt over:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van bedrijfskunde, gezondheidswetenschappen, zorgmanagement, technische bedrijfskunde, econometrie, data-analyse of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • interesse in capaciteitsmanagement, zorglogistiek en bedrijfsvoering binnen een complexe zorgorganisatie;

  • analytisch vermogen en vaardigheid in het interpreteren van data, ontwikkelingen en knelpunten;

  • het vermogen om organisatorische en inhoudelijke verbanden te herkennen;

  • vaardigheid in het opstellen van heldere adviezen, rapportages en notities;

  • goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden;

  • een zelfstandige, nauwkeurige en samenwerkingsgerichte werkhouding.

Om succesvol te starten in deze rol, is het belangrijk dat je de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst (minimaal B2-niveau) in verband met het contact met onder andere patiënten en collega's. Daarnaast is het een voorwaarde dat je in Nederland mag werken (EU/EER-nationaliteit of een geldige werkvergunning).

Salaris

​Afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring bedraagt het salaris minimaal € 3.897,- en maximaal € 5.341,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime aanstelling. Dit salaris is exclusief onregelmatigheidstoeslagen vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.

Arbeidsovereenkomst

Het betreft een tijdelijk arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar voor gemiddeld 36 uur per week conform artikel 2.4.2 van de Cao umc.

Wat bieden wij

Bij het Maastricht UMC+ zorgen wij ervoor dat je alles hebt om jouw bijdrage te leveren aan de ultieme zorg. Daar horen de juiste arbeidsvoorwaarden bij. Lees hier wat wij je bieden.

Heb je nog vragen?

Voor meer informatie over de functie of de opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden mag je contact opnemen met Nol Visschers, Directeur ICM, bereikbaar op tel. 043-3877918 of via e-mail nol.visschers@mumc.nl Een dag meelopen? Ook dat behoort tot de mogelijkheden!

Voor informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure volg je deze link. Algemene informatie over arbeidsvoorwaarden en werken bij het Maastricht UMC+ vind je hier. Het antwoord op jouw vraag niet kunnen vinden? Neem dan contact op met team Recruitment.

Sollicitaties voor deze vacature kunnen worden ingediend tot en met 22 november.

Wij werven onze kandidaten zelf en werken niet samen met externe bureaus voor deze vacature.

title: Asset Management Business Analyst 1
description:
The Business Analyst I supports Strata business teams by gathering, organizing, and analyzing data that informs operational and strategic decisions across project development, construction, and operating assets.

The role builds and maintains reports, dashboards, models, and regional budgets; tracks key performance indicators (KPIs); and translates business questions into clear, data-driven findings for stakeholders.

The Business Analyst I works under close direction on projects of limited complexity and develops a working understanding of the business model, objectives, and challenges through collaboration with internal IPP teams, other Strata business units, and external stakeholders.

The role includes occasional travel to other Strata offices or project sites.

Summary:

We’re leading the industry in sustainable energy careers. We understand that our employees are the lifeblood of the company. We strive to align company goals with those of our employees. We're constantly innovating to make a difference for our customers, our employees, and our planet. Our mission is to make a difference by developing cost-efficient alternatives to traditional energy sources, without long-term dependence on government subsidies. We’re leading the industry in sustainable energy careers. We hope you’ll join us.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from internal systems (for example, ERP, HRIS, project management, and financial tools) and external industry sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
  • Build, maintain, and refresh recurring reports and dashboards (for example, Power BI and Excel) that track KPIs, project status, and business results
  • Analyze data using statistical methods, trend analysis, and basic modeling to identify patterns, variances, and opportunities for operational improvement
  • Translate stakeholder requests into defined analysis requirements; document data sources, definitions, and assumptions
  • Prepare clear summaries, charts, and presentation materials that communicate findings to managers and business leaders
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and planning activities by assembling historical data and maintaining supporting models under the direction of senior team members
  • Research market, industry, and competitor information to support business planning and benchmarking
  • Identify data quality issues and partner with system owners to resolve discrepancies
  • Collaborate with internal IPP teams, other Strata business units, and external stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver analysis
  • Maintain the confidentiality of sensitive business, financial, and employee data
  • Support ad hoc analysis requests and special projects across departments
  • Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business analytics, finance, statistics, economics, engineering, information systems, or a related quantitative field
  • Minimum of two years of related experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics; relevant internships and co-op roles count toward this experience
  • Intermediate to strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data cleanup
  • Working knowledge of BI and data visualization tools (for example, Power BI or Tableau)
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Detail-oriented with demonstrated ability for accuracy
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Exposure to SQL, Python, or R for data extraction and analysis
  • Interest in or experience with renewable energy, construction, or other project-based industries

Physical Requirements/Work Environment:

Office

  • Works in an office environment
  • Sits for extended periods and works at a computer
  • Stands, bends, and twists, and lifts up to 20 pounds
  • Communicates effectively in person, by phone, and by video
  • Positions based at Strata's Durham, NC headquarters are fully on-site and require full-time, in-office attendance.

Perks and Benefits: we offer medical/dental/vision insurance plans, PTO, and 401K with a company matching portion.

About Us
Strata Clean Energy is a leading developer, EPC, and service provider for utility-scale solar and storage systems in the United States. We control and self-perform all processes from our nationwide solar and storage developments, to construction, O&M, and Asset Management.

Our employees are empowered to drive our business in a collaborative, creative, and passion-driven environment that fosters long-term professional growth. There is a lot to learn at Strata, but we’re here to help you give your best and have a good time doing it.

At Strata, you’re part of something big. We’re leading the industry in sustainable energy careers. We are driving innovation to make a difference for our customers, our employees, and our planet. Join us in powering the future.

Strata Solar is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Strata Solar is an equal employment and affirmative action employer whereby we do not engage in practices that discriminate against any person employed or seeking employment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other status or characteristic protected under applicable law.

title: Associate, Direct Lending
description:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate, Direct Lending.

This role sits within an established private credit platform with plans to build a scaled Direct Lending business across the UK, Europe and North America. You’ll help evaluate new investments for Investment Committee and support the ongoing monitoring and reporting of portfolio loans. The work is analytical and hands-on - from reviewing information memoranda and due diligence reports to stress-testing financial models and assessing investment risks. You’ll also support fundraising through investor materials, DDQs and RFPs and contribute to investor discussions. Success means sound investment recommendations, strong portfolio monitoring and clear, timely reporting across stakeholders.

If you want to work on private credit transactions from first look through to portfolio monitoring this role offers end-to-end exposure in a scaled and growing platform. You’ll contribute to investment decisions that aim to meet capital deployment and return objectives while operating within clear risk and policy frameworks.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In this role you’ll:

  • Originate and screen new direct lending opportunities across the UK and Continental Europe
  • Evaluate information memoranda, business plans and third-party due diligence to assess credit quality
  • Build, test and stress financial model assumptions and run scenario analysis to support investment decisions

title: Teamleider / Projectleider Energie, Bedrijfsstoffen & Monitoring
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Teamleider / Projectleider geeft je direct leiding aan een 15-tal collega’s welke zich bezig houden met het opwekken van energie & bedrijfsstoffen en het monitoren van deze. Met jouw team lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de bedrijfscontinuïteit van het Maastricht UMC+. Ook de beheersing van de energiekosten en het bereiken van de duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen behoren tot je aandacht.

Je geeft leiding aan het taakgebied, stimuleert en inspireert je medewerkers om het beste uit zichzelf te halen, zodat de afdelingsdoelstellingen gehaald worden. Zo ben je o.a. verantwoordelijk voor de interne communicatie (overlegstructuur), verzuimmanagement en roosterplanning. Je maakt activiteitenplannen voor het eigen taakgebied / hoofdproces en bewaakt en rapporteert de voortgang. Je bent integraal verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering binnen jouw taakgebied (personeel, financieel, kwaliteit en veiligheid). Je bereidt operationeel beleid voor, volgt innovaties op de voet en participeert waar nodig in FB-brede of zelfs overstijgende projecten.

Als projectleider zorg je samen met je collega’s voor de juiste projectaanpak in de uitvoering van het MJOP(D), waarbij de winkel altijd geopend is. Je initieert en geeft leiding aan vervangings- of uitbreidingsprojecten binnen het eigen taakgebied.

De procesgroep techniek & duurzaamheid is een regie-organisatie. We werken veel met externe firma’s, waarbij we partnership nastreven. Je hebt als teamleider een belangrijke rol in het contract- en leveranciersmanagement met deze partijen.

Hoe ziet je werkomgeving eruit?

De procesgroep Techniek & Duurzaamheid is één van de vier procesgroepen van het Facilitair Bedrijf. Samen houden we ons ziekenhuis, alle benodigde (medische) apparatuur en voorzieningen in topconditie, zorgen we voor een duurzame energievoorziening en geven vorm aan ons groene beleid.

Binnen de procesgroep is er naast jouw team ook het team Gebouw- & Installatiebeheer en Medische Techniek. Samen met je collega teamleiders runnen jullie de dagdagelijkse gang. Je legt verantwoordelijkheid af aan de manager Techniek & Duurzaamheid.

Jouw team bestaat uit diverse professionals die de opwekking en distributie van energie & bedrijfsstoffen monitoren, op een veilige en efficiënte wijze beheren en in stand houden. Je geeft ook leiding aan de meldkamer techniek welke 24h bezet is volgens een opbouwend 5 ploegenrooster. We werken samen, helpen en motiveren elkaar, geven feedback waar nodig en zorgen samen voor een prettige werksfeer.

Meer weten over de Procesgroep Techniek & Duurzaamheid? Kijk dan dit filmpje!

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Als teamleider / projectleider heb je een HBO opleidingsniveau verkregen door een relevante afgeronde HBO opleiding of verkregen door aantoonbare ervaring.

Je beschikt over:

  • Minimaal 5 jaar leidinggevende ervaring;

  • Een coachende en verbindende stijl van leidinggeven;

  • Kennis en ervaring met energie, bedrijfsstoffen en monitoring;

  • Het vermogen om te schakelen tussen operationeel, tactisch en strategisch niveau;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel schriftelijk als verbaal;

  • Ervaring met contract- en leveranciersmanagement;

  • Analytisch vermogen, plannings- en organisatietalent;

  • Kennis en ervaring met projectmanagement in een technische omgeving;

  • Je bent empathisch en hebt organisatiesensitiviteit;

  • Je kunt je makkelijk aanpassen aan veranderlijke omstandigheden;

  • Je bent flexibel en wendbaar.

Tevens wordt er verwacht dat je deelneemt aan de consignatiedienst en 4x per jaar aan de noodstroomtesten welke op zaterdagochtend plaatsvinden.

Om succesvol te starten in deze rol, is het belangrijk dat je de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst (minimaal B2-niveau) in verband met het contact met onder andere patiënten en collega's. Daarnaast is het een voorwaarde dat je in Nederland mag werken (EU/EER-nationaliteit of een geldige werkvergunning).

Voldoe jij aan deze functie-eisen? Dan gaan wij voor jou!

Salaris

Afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring bedraagt het salaris minimaal € 4.987,- en maximaal € 6.825,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime aanstelling. Dit salaris is exclusief onregelmatigheidstoeslagen, vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.

Arbeidsovereenkomst

Het betreft een arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar voor gemiddeld 36 uur per week conform artikel 2.4.2 Cao umc, zijnde een tijdelijk contract vooruitlopend op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd als bedoeld in lid 3 van artikel 2.3 Cao umc.

Wat bieden wij

Bij het Maastricht UMC+ zorgen wij ervoor dat je alles hebt om jouw bijdrage te leveren aan de ultieme zorg. Daar horen de juiste arbeidsvoorwaarden bij. Lees hier wat wij je bieden.

Heb je nog vragen?

Voor meer informatie over de functie of de opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden mag je contact opnemen met de Manager Techniek & Duurzaamheid, Peter Webers bereikbaar op tel. 043-3875508 of via e-mail peter.webers@mumc.nl.


Voor informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure volg je deze link. Algemene informatie over arbeidsvoorwaarden en werken bij het Maastricht UMC+ vind je hier. Het antwoord op jouw vraag niet kunnen vinden? Neem dan contact op met team Recruitment.

De sollicitatiegesprekken zullen in week 50 worden gehouden.
Sollicitaties voor deze vacature kunnen worden ingediend tot en met 27 november.

Wij werven onze kandidaten zelf en werken niet samen met externe bureaus voor deze vacature.

The Opportunity:
As a CACI-SOAS USAREUR-AF All Source Analyst you will support US Army Europe/Africa G2 and other Intelligence related mission partners, as a key team member of a complex program that provides professional services in support of advisory and analysis efforts associated with Intelligence Warfighting Function (IWfF)mission areas. The USAREUR-AF TMISS Team will research, analyze, and produce near- and long-term all source assessments on terrorism / counterterrorism, and multi-discipline counter-intelligence issues in response to CG USAREUR-AF’s priority intelligence requirements and to enable U.S. and foreign partner counterintelligence operations.


You will be a member of a team that supports the Intelligence Directorate of the Army Component Command of both the US European Command and US Africa Command.

Responsibilities:
As a CACI SOAS USAREUR-AF All Source Analyst you will embed at either Clay Kaserne in Wiesbaden Germany,), Vicenza Italy, or Camp Bondsteel, Kosovo and may travel within both theaters as required, to perform services at locations within the USEUCOM or USAFRICOM AOR or Area of Interest (AOI) to meet mission requirements in both CONUS and OCONUS locations.


These positions are contingent upon SOFA approval or commensurate work-Visa requirements at the primary place of duty. Employee must be willing to work shifts, overtime, and/or deploy to austere or hostile fire zones as required


Other duties as an All-Source Analyst will include but are not limited to:

  • Provide leadership and mentor junior analysts.

Indications and warning analysis will be performed, ensuring that Government leadership is promptly informed of new threat reporting and associated analysis.
  • Conducts SIGINT Communications analysis in accordance with all laws and directives in support of the USAREUR-AF counterintelligence and security mission.
  • Deliver complex briefings to command, staff, and subordinate units regarding threats to force protection within the USAREUR-AF AOR.

  • Update the CI database and establish/maintain a USAREUR-AF AOR Foreign Intelligence Security Services (FISS) Combined Intel Picture (CIP).

  • Use common U.S. Intelligence Community tools and techniques to research and analyze classified information, including the ability to query record message traffic, conduct signals intelligence analysis, perform geospatial intelligence analysis, engage in link analysis, and conduct open-source analysis.
  • Research and ensure PAI in compliance with Army, COCOM, Intelligence Oversight, and local guidelines.
  • Conduct formal evaluations and oversight of intelligence reports and identify source-directed requirements to address intelligence gaps.
  • Contribute to intelligence collaboration among U.S. interagency partners and foreign counterparts.
  • Write, review, and provide quality control for analytical products for potential foreign release, with an understanding of the processes required to request approval from the originator for foreign release and obtain approval from the foreign disclosure officer for sharing with partners.

title: Senior Counsel, Artificial Intelligence & Data Privacy
description:
The Senior Counsel, Artificial Intelligence & Data Privacy will lead and advise on global data protection and AI governance across the global jurisdictions in which AECOM operates, ensuring compliance with international privacy laws and emerging AI regulation, mitigating legal risk and supporting responsible innovation.

The role is also the embedded legal partner to AECOM's AI Engineering teams located across Europe. It helps those teams develop and deploy AI-driven products quickly while protecting AECOM's intellectual property, its clients and the people whose data it handles, giving clear, practical answers and streamlining the legal review and compliance process.

The postholder will be the gateway and quarterback between the AI teams and the wider global AECOM legal team, and a senior, business-facing partner to leaders across the business. A cultural fit with the AI teams is essential, and a technology or product background is valued.

1. Lead product counsel embedded within AI development teams

  • Act as the embedded legal partner to the AI Engineering teams across the whole product lifecycle, managing legal design and compliance issues, and making pragmatic, risk-based calls rather than adding process.
  • Build self-service playbooks, decision guides, standard templates and pre-approved positions so that engineers and product teams can get most answers without waiting for legal review.
  • Support product launches into new markets with fast, risk-based guidance on local legal requirements, product terms and AI transparency obligations.
  • Advise on the IP position of AI development, including rights to training data, model and dataset licenses, open-weight model license terms (use restrictions and attribution), open-source software compliance, and ownership of AI-generated outputs.
  • Protect clients' confidential information and IP by setting clear rules for how client construction information may be used, including for model training and fine-tuning, and ensuring product behavior matches AECOM's contractual commitments.
  • Provide generalized legal support to the AI teams, including review & negotiation of vendor and other commercial agreements, contracts, and provide advice and counsel on general legal matters where needed.
  • Act as gateway and quarterback between the AI teams and the wider global legal team: bring in the right internal specialists, leadership at all levels, and external counsel across jurisdictions, and keep spend proportionate to the risk.
  • Guide the legal team and senior stakeholders on privacy, AI governance and regulatory developments, and give strategic advice on integrating privacy and AI compliance into product development and operations.
  • Lead and coordinate legal professionals within the AECOM legal function with full or partial responsibility for related tasks and deliverables.

2. Global privacy and AI regulatory compliance

  • Advise on global privacy laws, including GDPR and UK GDPR, US federal and state laws such as CCPA/CPRA, LGPD in Brazil, PIPEDA in Canada, the Australian and New Zealand Privacy Acts, and key Asian regimes such as Singapore's PDPA. Advise on lawful basis, DPIAs, cross-border transfers and data residency.
  • Advise on AI regulation and governance, including the EU AI Act, UK AI principles, emerging US federal and state AI rules, and emerging risk frameworks, turning them into practical requirements that teams can build into their normal way of working.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of the company's privacy and AI governance frameworks, policies and procedures.
  • Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments and AI Impact Assessments for new projects and technologies, and recommend technical and organizational measures to mitigate privacy and AI-related risks.
  • Establish procedures to respond to client AI-related requests and restrictions, ensuring contractual and regulatory obligations are met promptly and effectively.
  • Track and interpret legal and regulatory developments and enforcement trends in AI, IP and data protection across AECOM's markets, and brief internal stakeholders on what matters and what needs action.
  • Represent the company in regulatory inquiries and investigations related to data privacy and AI.
  • Deliver privacy and AI governance training to employees and business units and promote a culture of privacy and responsible AI by design and default.
  • A senior, experienced, qualified lawyer, with a law degree and admission in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • Deep knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR and US privacy laws, with experience of cross-border data transfers, and of emerging AI regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act and how they apply to products in practice.
  • Deep expertise in intellectual property and technology commercial work, including software, data and technology licensing, SaaS, enterprise client and vendor agreements, and open-source licence compliance.
  • Hands-on experience advising on AI products, including training data rights, model licensing and AI-specific contract terms.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation and advisory skills.
  • Ability to manage complex, cross-border projects and orchestrate legal support across multiple jurisdictions, working with in-house specialists and external counsel, and to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • A track record of working at pace in fast-moving product or engineering teams, explaining legal risk clearly and pragmatically, and giving straight answers that enable delivery rather than block it. A technology or product background is valued, and a cultural fit with the AI teams is needed.
  • Experience in a large global organization, working across regions, business units and enterprise governance and compliance processes.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, IAPP AIGP or other AI governance credentials.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with patent strategy for software or machine learning inventions.
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering and construction (AEC) sector, including how design and construction information is owned and licensed.
  • Technical literacy in how machine learning models and LLMs are trained, fine-tuned and deployed, including the difference between hosted and self-hosted models.

title: Production Scheduler (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRODUCTION SCHEDULER (STARSHIP)

The Production Scheduler for SpaceX's Starship program drives efficient production by developing rate-based schedules, identifying part shortages, projecting long-term departmental needs, and tracking constraints across builds while collaborating with teams to set and execute daily/weekly goals that align with overall rate targets.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in production scheduling for a given production work center, including identifying need dates for all part shortages and projecting long-term high-level rate needs for the department
  • Create a rate-based schedule for your hardware and define/track constraints across your build for the next 6+ missions
  • Use an established schedule to create and generate stakeholder buy-in on various scenarios to determine optimal hardware allocation between new/refurb hardware that take into account customer needs, current mission manifest, and customer quality requirements
  • Work with production teams to set, track, and execute daily and weekly goals for the work center that take into account personnel and equipment constraints but support overall rate targets
  • Build strong relationships with internal suppliers and establish high-accuracy means of communication for both estimated hardware needs and completion dates
  • Manage the scheduling and prioritization of your hardware at shared resources that are common to multiple departments at SpaceX
  • Negotiate with peers in other departments for correct overall priority and seek creative solutions that drive the optimal business outcome
  • Monitor MRP systems and leverage SQL Queries to identify hardware shortages for upcoming builds and lead the charge to pull this hardware into your production area
  • Identify, develop, and implement opportunities for increased scheduling automation across the Starship Ship Engineering department with a focus on reducing the manual operations required to develop, track, and update overall schedules
  • Drive down near-term and future schedule risk by conducting work-center level capacity analysis, identifying model and communication gaps that cause schedule slips, and leading initiatives (reactive and proactive) that mitigate those risks
  • Lead efforts to uncover root-cause and develop permanent resolution on issues found during product builds as required to eliminate internal and external blockers to deliver product on time
  • Drive conversations around assembly-level & integration misalignment
  • Identify and support improvement opportunities for product yield, quality, safety, cost and team efficiency

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of manufacturing scheduling, planning or operations; OR 3+ years of professional experience with manufacturing scheduling, planning or operations
  • Experience using ERP/MRP systems in a production environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed and accuracy
  • Self-motivated, quick learner, and ability to prioritize efforts to meet customer and company goals
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external supplier/customer relationships in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment
  • Technical knowledge and skills in coding and computer applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, VBA, Smartsheet, SQL, Confluence, JIRA, Power BI, etc.)
  • Strong track record of implementing continuous improvement efforts, ideally using problem solving frameworks including lean principles, six sigma, or Kaizen concepts
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary and cross-functional teams working on strategic problems
  • Project management professional certification

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be available for all shifts, extended hours, and/or weekends as needed
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods - 8 hours minimum

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00
Level 2: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: Head of AI, FMUK
description:
Vision, creative leadership and innovation

  • Articulate a compelling, ambitious vision for how AI can enhance creativity and storytelling at FMUK, from originations and development through to delivery and audience, and bring editorial, production and executive leaders with you.
  • Champion creative innovation: explore how AI could open up new formats, creative workflows, ways of developing and pitching ideas, and new audience and commercial opportunities, in partnership with creative leaders, talent and buyers/clients.
  • Build and run an innovation pipeline: scan emerging technologies, creative practice and competitor activity, run structured pilots and test-and-learn programmes, and make clear, evidence-based decisions on what to scale, adapt or stop.
  • Act as a visible ambassador for FMUK's approach to AI, internally and externally, setting a tone that is optimistic, ethically grounded and respectful of creative talent and human authorship.

Strategy, governance and the Group

  • Own FMUK's AI strategy, setting a bold multi-year vision, and translate it into a prioritised roadmap that balances quick wins with longer-term, transformational bets, with clear objectives, owners, milestones and measures of success.
  • Advise and challenge the FMUK Executive Team on strategic opportunities, how AI could shape FMUK's competitive position and ways of working, investment, dependencies and risks, and report regularly on progress, benefits and decisions required.
  • Represent FMUK on the Global AI Board, actively shaping Group direction and ensuring FMUK's priorities and experience inform Group activity while retaining local accountability for FMUK strategy, investment and delivery.
  • Own responsible-AI governance for FMUK: set a clear, principled position on the creative and ethical use of AI that protects talent, contributors and IP, and ensure compliance with Group policy, legal requirements and production obligations, working with Legal and Business Affairs, Data Protection, Information Security and HR.
  • Scan developments in AI, creative technology and the wider industry, anticipate emerging opportunities and risks, and turn them into clear, timely perspectives and strategic choices for FMUK.

Enablement

  • Direct the identification and prioritisation of production use cases where AI or automation enhances creativity and quality or improves speed, efficiency or cost, across development, scheduling, budgeting, production paperwork, archive, post-production, graphics, transcription, logging and content creation.
  • Create space for creative experimentation: sponsor pilots, labs and showcases that let producers, editorial and creative teams explore what AI can do for their programmes in a safe, supported environment, and amplify what works.
  • Direct the identification of process and ways-of-working improvements across FMUK's corporate and operational functions, working with functional leaders on use cases with clear operational or financial benefit.
  • Ensure every initiative is grounded in a genuine production need and reflects creative judgement, production realities and buyer/ client requirements.
  • Ensure implementation includes process redesign, training, creative upskilling and change management, not just tool deployment, and that successful approaches are scaled across FMUK.
  • Hold the senior relationships with company CEOs, editorial leaders and Heads of Production, acting as a trusted thought partner who brings ideas and inspiration as well as delivery.

Team, investment and adoption

  • Lead, inspire and develop the FMUK AI team, setting a clear vision and objectives, managing performance, creating clear accountability across production enablement, productivity enablement and technical delivery, and fostering a culture of curiosity and ownership.
  • Oversee local investment in tools and initiatives, with clear criteria for prioritisation, production impact, deliverability, cost and risk, visibility of benefits realised, and space for exploratory, higher-risk innovation where the learning is the value.
  • Chair the FMUK AI Champion Network and, with Internal Comms and the People Team, build engagement, confidence and enthusiasm among colleagues with varying levels of AI knowledge, inspiring them to experiment and share what they learn.
  • Coordinate with Global AI, IT, engineering, procurement and external partners where specialist capability is needed, and foster a culture of curiosity and responsible experimentation with clear accountability.

Essential

  • A deep understanding of how programmes are developed, produced, post-produced and delivered, and of the pressures production teams work under, gained in production or by working closely alongside it.
  • Creative and strategic vision: the imagination to see what AI could mean for the future of storytelling, production and the business, and the ability to articulate a compelling, credible vision that inspires creative, production and executive audiences alike.
  • A track record of leading change, innovation or process improvement in a complex or federated organisation, and of taking bold ideas from concept through to implementation.
  • The credibility to work with CEOs, senior editorial leaders, Heads of Production and corporate functions, and the judgement to balance creative ambition with commercial, legal and operational considerations.
  • Influence and communication: an engaging communicator and storyteller who can bring creative talent, sceptics and senior leaders on the journey, and who handles the sensitivities around AI with empathy and credibility.
  • Commercial judgement: able to assess anticipated benefits, investment requirements and delivery risk, and to prioritise accordingly.
  • An informed, active and curious interest in AI, automation and emerging creative technology, with the ability to see where it could take the business and to explain it in plain production and business language.
  • Sound judgement on the creative, legal and ethical implications of AI in content production.
  • Experience leading and inspiring a team, setting direction and creating the conditions for others to innovate and deliver.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience developing business cases and managing project or innovation budgets.
  • Experience of creative or R&D innovation, such as labs, incubators, pilots or new-format development, or of building partnerships with technology companies, start-ups or academic institutions.
  • Experience working across multiple production companies, labels or genres, or across both production and corporate environments.
  • Experience establishing champion networks, communities of practice or cross-functional working groups.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, intellectual property, data protection or production compliance.

Our benefits include generous company pension, summer Fridays, audience tickets, employee assistance program, access to free courses and training, EV scheme, cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and volunteer days.

Fremantle is part of RTL Group, a global leader across broadcast, content and digital, itself a division of the international media giant Bertelsmann.

title: Drupal Technical Lead
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

What does a Drupal Technical Lead do at WPP Production?

A Drupal Technical Lead at WPP Production is responsible for leading development teams and driving the technical direction of enterprise-grade Drupal solutions. The role involves defining and implementing architecture for both monolithic and headless (decoupled) CMS platforms, while ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications. They collaborate closely with product, design, and QA teams to define requirements and delivery plans, oversee API and microservices development, and ensure smooth integration between front-end systems and CMS layers. In addition, they enforce coding standards and best practices, guide technology decisions including CMS selection, participate in Agile delivery processes, and proactively manage technical risks to ensure successful project execution.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee complex cloud migration and transformation projects, ensuring minimal downtime and smooth transitions
• Contribute to Architecture Review Board (ARB) and Change Advisory Board (CAB) discussions
• Provide accurate technical estimations and inputs for RFPs and solution design
• Define and document end-to-end system architectures, ensuring scalability and performance
• Ensure security, compliance, and governance standards are implemented across systems
• Drive integration of Drupal with enterprise platforms and non-Drupal technologies
• Monitor system performance and implement optimizations to meet SLAs
• Promote Drupal adoption and advocate best practices across teams and stakeholders
• Mentor teams, conduct code reviews, and enable continuous skill development

Requirements

• Strong expertise in Drupal 9+, including core APIs, hooks, and custom module development
• Experience with decoupled CMS architectures and headless Drupal implementations
• Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js
• Backend development experience with PHP, Node.js, .NET, or Java
• Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns
• Database expertise: MySQL, PostgreSQL
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized environments
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies

Drupal Expertise
• Extensive experience building and maintaining Drupal 9+ applications
• Expertise in custom module and theme development
• Strong understanding of Drupal theming layer and responsive design
• Hands-on experience with headless Drupal and API-driven content delivery
• Proficiency with GraphQL / JSON APIs for frontend integration
• Deep knowledge of Drupal Configuration Management across environments
• Experience designing content workflows and moderation systems
• Strong understanding of roles, permissions, and security best practices
• Experience with multilingual and multisite Drupal implementations
• Performance optimization using Drupal Cache API, Varnish, Memcached
• Database tuning and performance analysis for large-scale Drupal applications
• Ability to evaluate and select appropriate contributed modules

Bonus
• Experience contributing to the Drupal community (patches, modules, etc.)
• Exposure to non-Drupal architecture and enterprise system integrations

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. title: Pomoćni radnik za optičke mreže (m/ž)
description:
Markoja d.o.o. zapošljava više pomoćnih radnika za optičke mreže (m/ž) za rad na izgradnji telekomunikacijske infrastrukture na području cijele Hrvatske.

Tražimo odgovorne i motivirane osobe koje vole praktičan rad, spremne su na terenski rad i žele naučiti nove vještine u području telekomunikacija.

U ovoj ulozi sudjelovat ćeš u izgradnji podzemnih optičkih mreža, polaganju kabela, pripremi infrastrukture i izvođenju priključaka za krajnje korisnike, uz podršku iskusnih kolega.

Ovo je dobra prilika za osobe koje žele steći iskustvo u telekomunikacijskoj industriji i razvijati svoje vještine kroz praktičan rad na terenu.

Što ćeš raditi?

  • sudjelovati u povlačenju i polaganju optičkih kabela kroz kabelsku kanalizaciju (DTK) i mikrocjevi
  • pomagati pri strojnom upuhivanju optičkih kabela i pripremi kabelskih trasa
  • sudjelovati u ugradnji optičkih zdenaca i izvođenju podzemnih priključaka
  • pomagati pri uvođenju optičkih kabela u stambene i poslovne objekte (FTTH)
  • sudjelovati u montaži završnih korisničkih kutija i pripremi instalacija
  • rukovati ručnim i električnim alatima potrebnima za izgradnju mreže
  • pomagati pri pripremi, utovaru i istovaru materijala i opreme
  • održavati urednost radnog prostora te brinuti o alatu, opremi i službenom vozilu
  • pridržavati se propisanih mjera zaštite na radu i sigurnosnih postupaka
  • surađivati s ostalim članovima terenskog tima u svakodnevnim aktivnostima

Potrebno obrazovanje, znanja i vještine

  • spremnost na fizički rad na otvorenom, kabelskim trasama i zdencima
  • spremnost na kontinuirani terenski rad i putovanja na području Hrvatske
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • odgovornost, pouzdanost i savjestan pristup radu
  • sposobnost rada u timu i pridržavanja uputa voditelja
  • spremnost na učenje i usvajanje novih praktičnih vještina
  • pažljivo rukovanje alatom i opremom
  • pridržavanje pravila zaštite na radu

Poslodavac ti nudi

  • stalni radni odnos u stabilnoj tvrtki
  • redovita i stabilna primanja
  • plaćene prekovremene sate i dodatke za terenski rad
  • osiguran i plaćen smještaj tijekom rada na terenu
  • terenski dodatak (dnevnice) i pokrivene troškove prijevoza od sjedišta tvrtke
  • kvalitetne alate, radnu odjeću i odgovarajuću zaštitnu opremu
  • potrebne edukacije i osposobljavanja o trošku tvrtke
  • uvođenje u posao uz podršku iskusnih kolega
  • mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja i napredovanja u području telekomunikacija
  • rad u organiziranom terenskom timu

Ako voliš praktičan rad, spreman si na terenski rad i želiš sudjelovati u izgradnji optičke infrastrukture diljem Hrvatske, pošalji nam svoj životopis putem MojPosao prijave.
