title: FabHotels - Business Intelligence & Growth Lead
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION - Business Intelligence & Growth Lead

Who We Are

FabHotels has built India's largest tech-enabled budget hotel network with 1,400+ properties across 80+ cities.

We're not just another hotel chain - we are using technology, automation, and smart data to completely reimagine how affordable hospitality works.

TravelPlus is India's largest hotels-focused corporate travel management platform for enterprise clients. Our platform delivers both process excellence - workflow automation, policy compliance, GST-compliant invoicing, real-time analytics, and expense management; and service excellence - dedicated relationship managers, 24/7 human concierge, and active hotel supplier management. To serve distinct customer groups and optimise inventory within this segment, we maintain a strategic asset-light private-label portfolio comprising FabHotels and Via brands, which cumulatively included 1,400+ onboarded properties.

Who?

Founded by Wharton & Bain alumni, Vaibhav Aggarwal & Adarssh Mnpuria, FabHotels has raised >$70Mn. till date and is backed by leading VC firms Goldman Sachs, Accel, Qualcomm & RB Capital.

About the Role

The role will own the Business Intelligence and Growth charter, combining advanced analytics, AI-led automation, business strategy and program execution.

The individual will be responsible for building scalable analytical frameworks, developing intelligent business solutions, identifying revenue and profitability improvement opportunities, and translating complex data into actionable business strategies.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, business acumen and the ability to lead a team while driving high-impact, cross-functional initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Intelligence & Analytics:

- Lead the Business Intelligence function and establish a robust framework for data-driven decision-making across business functions.

- Develop and manage business dashboards, performance trackers and KPI frameworks using Power BI and other BI tools.

- Leverage SQL and advanced analytical techniques to extract, analyse and interpret large datasets.

- Identify business trends, performance gaps, operational inefficiencies and growth opportunities through data analysis.

- Build predictive models and analytical frameworks to support business planning, forecasting and strategic decisions.

- Provide actionable insights to senior leadership on revenue, profitability, pricing, inventory and business performance.

2. AI-Led Innovation & Automation:

- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning and automation to solve business problems and improve operational efficiency.

- Conceptualise and implement AI-powered solutions for business intelligence, process automation, customer experience and performance optimisation.

- Drive AI-led initiatives such as automated call quality assessment, intelligent pricing recommendations, predictive analytics and performance monitoring.

- Work with technology teams to develop and deploy scalable AI-driven products and analytical solutions.

- Explore emerging AI tools, technologies and frameworks to continuously improve business processes and decision-making.

3. Growth Strategy & Business Performance:

- Partner with business leadership to identify and execute growth initiatives focused on revenue enhancement, profitability and operational efficiency.

- Drive data-backed pricing strategies, inventory optimisation and demand forecasting.

- Analyse customer behaviour, conversion funnels, sales productivity and business performance to identify opportunities for growth.

- Build analytical models to improve inside sales productivity, lead conversion, customer acquisition and retention.

- Develop frameworks to measure the effectiveness and ROI of growth initiatives.

- Own end-to-end execution of strategic growth projects and ensure measurable business impact.

4. Program & Stakeholder Management:

- Lead high-impact, cross-functional strategic initiatives from conceptualisation to implementation.

- Define project objectives, milestones, success metrics and execution roadmaps.

- Collaborate with Product, Technology, Sales, Operations and Finance teams to drive implementation.

- Work closely with senior leadership to translate business requirements into analytical and technology-led solutions.

- Monitor project outcomes and ensure timely execution with clear ownership and accountability.

5. Team Leadership:

- Build, manage and mentor a team of business analysts and data professionals.

- Establish a culture of analytical rigour, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.

- Set clear performance objectives and ensure effective delivery of analytics and growth projects.

- Develop the team's technical and business capabilities through continuous learning and exposure to emerging technologies.

Desired Skills & Experience

- 5 - 7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Growth Analytics, Data Science, Strategy or related roles.

- B.Tech / B.E. from a reputed engineering college with a strong academic foundation.

- Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Power BI, including complex queries, data modelling, dashboard development and reporting automation.

- Practical experience in AI-driven projects, AI tools, automation, predictive analytics or machine learning applications.

- Demonstrated experience in conceptualising and implementing technology-led business or growth initiatives.

- Experience in managing and mentoring teams.

- Strong understanding of business metrics, revenue drivers, profitability, pricing strategies and operational performance.

- Ability to independently drive projects from problem identification and solution design to implementation and measurable outcomes.

- Strong stakeholder management, communication and problem-solving skills.

What We Are Looking For

- A strong analytical thinker with the ability to connect technology, data and business outcomes.

- Someone who is hands-on with data and technology rather than limited to managing dashboards or delegating analysis.

- A proven track record of implementing AI-led or automation projects that have delivered tangible business impact.

- Someone who has worked on growth initiatives and can demonstrate measurable improvements in revenue, conversion, productivity or profitability.

- A proactive leader who can manage teams while remaining closely involved in solution design and execution.

Why Join Us?

- Opportunity to work directly with senior business leadership on high-impact strategic initiatives.

- Ownership of AI-led transformation, business intelligence and growth projects.

- Opportunity to build scalable analytical solutions that directly influence business performance.

- A fast-paced environment with significant scope for innovation, ownership and professional growth.

title: AI Product Manager - BIM, Construction & Project Controls
description:
Job Summary:

The AI Product Manager, BIM, Construction & Project Controls owns the AI products that help a global real-estate business design and build with less rework, fewer delays and better information. The role covers building information modelling (BIM), design coordination, site delivery, quantity takeoff, scheduling, earned value and project risk.

This is a field-facing role. Its products work with 3D models, drawings, site photos, scans and schedules, and its users are project teams on site with little time for new tools. The post holder must turn messy project data into products that site teams actually use, while respecting contract roles, design responsibility and safety at every step.

Key Responsibilities:

Product strategy:

- Own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for AI in BIM, design coordination, construction delivery and project controls.

- Prioritise opportunities by impact on rework, delay and site effort, and by the quality of available project data.

- Track the construction-technology market (model checking, takeoff, reality capture, schedule analytics) and lead vendor assessments.

BIM and design coordination:

- Define AI agents that read models and drawings to find clashes and discrepancies between drawings, specifications and models before tender and construction.

- Specify design-compliance checks against local building codes and company design standards.

- Set information requirements for consultants and contractors in line with ISO 19650, including model standards, level of detail and open data exchange (IFC).

Construction delivery:

- Define agents that draft, route and chase RFIs, submittals, inspection requests and non-conformance reports.

- Specify progress-monitoring products that compare site evidence (photos, drone surveys, laser scans, daily reports) with the model and schedule.

- Include safety use cases where they add value, such as permit-to-work checks and incident triage.

Quantities and project controls:

- Define agents for quantity takeoff and bills of quantities from models and drawings, and for measuring work done.

- Specify schedule quality checks, critical-path analysis and delay-risk prediction.

- Automate earned-value reporting, monthly progress reports, risk registers and portfolio dashboards.

- Supply measured quantities, progress and schedule data to the development-finance products for budgets and payments.

Field adoption:

- Design products for site use: mobile-first, quick to capture, and built into existing meetings and reports.

- Pilot each product on one or two live projects with a named site champion before rolling out.

- Build test sets from real project data such as marked-up drawings, past clashes, closed RFIs and historic schedules.

Governance:

- Make sure a competent person reviews every safety-related output before anyone acts on it.

- Respect contract roles and design responsibility: products flag issues, and the designers and engineers of record decide.

- Protect design data and site images under contract confidentiality and data-protection laws, and keep a record of what each product checked for use in claims.

Qualifications & Experience:

Essential:

- Bachelor's degree in Civil, Structural or MEP Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or Quantity Surveying.

- At least 10 years' experience, including 6 or more in construction delivery, BIM management, planning or project controls.

- Hands-on experience in at least two of: BIM coordination, scheduling and project controls, quantity surveying.

- Delivery of large residential, commercial, mixed-use or high-rise projects, including time on site.

- Working knowledge of construction contracts (e.g. FIDIC, JCT, NEC), RFIs, inspections and change processes.

- At least 3 years leading digital-construction or construction-technology products or programmes, with one or more delivered into live use.

Desirable:

- Master's degree in Construction Management, Digital Construction or BIM.

- Professional qualification such as PMP, PMI-SP, AACE PSP, MRICS or a recognised BIM certification.

- Experience with reality capture: laser scanning, drone surveys and 360-degree site imagery.

- Experience with digital twins or handing BIM data over to facilities management.

- Projects delivered in more than one country.

Technical Skills:

- BIM: model authoring and coordination tools (e.g. Revit, Navisworks), common data environments, IFC and openBIM, and ISO 19650.

- Quantities: takeoff tools (e.g. CostX) and measurement standards (e.g. NRM).

- Project controls: scheduling software (e.g. Primavera P6), earned value management, schedule quality checks (e.g. DCMA 14-point) and risk management.

- Project platforms: construction management and document control systems (e.g. Procore, Unifier, Aconex).

- AI fluency: how large language models, computer vision for drawings and site images, and AI agents work, and where they fail.

- Data: structuring model, schedule and site data for analysis; basic SQL and dashboard tools (e.g. Power BI).

- Product delivery: requirements, acceptance criteria, Agile methods and backlog tools (e.g. Jira).

Core Competencies:

- Site credibility: comfortable on site and respected by engineers, supervisors and planners.

- Practical design sense: builds tools that fit how site teams actually work, not how they should work.

- Spatial thinking: reads models, drawings and programmes fluently.

- Safety first: never trades safety or quality for speed.

- Influence without authority: brings contractors and consultants along to new data standards.

- Resilience: keeps pilots on track through site pressures and shifting priorities.

- Hands-on learning: tries new construction-technology tools and judges them in the field.

title: Senior Architect - Data Centres
description:
Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

We are a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and also Enterprise projects across Europe. These projects are led from our specialist data centre team based in the UK in conjunction with our local teams across Europe who ensure localisation and permitting delivery, but also other global design teams providing resource and capability to the projects.

We are seeking an experienced Architect or Architectural Technologist with a strong technical background in the design of large multi-disciplinary design projects, preferably data centres. The ideal candidate will be able to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary architectural and engineering teams.

The candidate must be strong in technical design content, with a CSA bias and in design management, digital technologies, and design workflow. They will be expected to oversee design activities and the production of design information and maintain the level of quality that is expected throughout these projects. They will have to manage this delivery to very demanding timelines and programmes with immovable deadlines.

The preferred location for this role is Belfast, given its position as a key hub of expertise. Dublin, Manchester, and London are also suitable locations. The role will require travel throughout the UK, Ireland, and Europe.

AECOM is listed as the 4th largest employer of architects worldwide in the World Architecture WA100 2025 survey, with over 1500 architects. We are currently expanding in the UK, so now is a great time to join our team and build your career for the future. We are at number 10 in the AJ100 list. AECOM employs around 7500 multi-disciplinary staff in the UK, and we offer architecturally led multi-disciplinary design services to our clients.

Project / Design Responsibilities

  • Senior Architect/Designer on a portfolio of projects.
  • Assist in coordinating the design across multi-disciplinary architectural and engineering teams, working closely with discipline leads to deliver integrated architectural and engineering outputs across projects.
  • Ensuring all internal governance is followed both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects.
  • Presenting to clients and prospective clients.
  • Ensuring CDM Safety in Design principles are applied throughout all design stages of a project.

Managerial Responsibilities

  • Organises own and others work to achieve set deadlines.
  • Responsible for the correctness, accuracy and multi-disciplinary coordination of the design documentation.
  • Ensures the quality of technical work produced meets AECOM’s Technical Excellence standards.
  • Interact with clients, contractors, local authority representatives and others using skills of persuasion and negotiation to resolve critical issues.
  • Make appropriate value judgements with respect to corrective work that supports the design concept and performance goals of the project.
  • For projects on site: Manage interface between Design Team / Site Team ensuring proper design support is provided in a timely manner.
  • Support Associate Directors and / or Directors with operational responsibilities which includes development and implementing Technical Excellence initiatives, management of resources (HR), training initiatives (CPD).
  • Where requested, engage with business reporting activities.
  • Ensure the latest software and digital techniques are utilised to increase productivity and identify where training opportunities for staff should be made available.

Specific Skills Required:

  • Must be proficient in the team management of, and use of, CAD. We use a range of CAD software, and training can be given to get you up to speed on the specific software needed for projects we are working on, which utilise AutoCAD & REVIT.
  • In particular our approach to design utilises 3D modelling in REVIT for workflow, and direct ‘hands on’ experience and current working knowledge of REVIT is required.
  • It would also be useful to have a working knowledge of Sketchup, Photoshop, InDesign, PowerPoint, Twinmotion and other presentation and render software. (Training can also be provided).
  • Familiarity with working in Common Data Environments (CDE) like Forma ACC, ProjectWise, Autodesk Docs, etc.
  • Creative, practical, adaptable and enthusiastic.
  • Ability to demonstrate attention to detail.
  • Ability to think in a methodical way to design, plan and organize parts of projects.
  • English language proficient, holding good communication skills to present information in speech, drawings and reports.
  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK.
  • Fully Qualified Architect or Technologist (Chartered or equivalent) and proven experience in working on large multi-disciplinary design projects, preferably in Data Centres
  • Willingness and interest to work in a range of areas under the guidance of Associate Directors and / or Directors. Our areas of design include: Data Centres, Nuclear, Transport, Rail, Aviation, Education, Health Care, Laboratory, Science, and Logistics.
  • Degree qualification, preferably with Diploma or Masters in a University Course, although the latter is not absolutely essential.
  • Some experience of various forms of building contract will be helpful.
  • An understanding and knowledge of the application UK Building Systems, Standards and Regulations and construction types.
  • IT literate, with knowledge of CAD software, and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, TEAMS, etc).
  • Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines.
  • A clear work history and proof of professional development and learning.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Project Manager/Estimator
description:
Project Manager / Estimator

Welcome to Empire Supply Company – A Crown Co. Company | $75,000+ Annually | Full-Time

At ESC, we're looking for a Project Manager / Estimator who is organized, detail-oriented, and takes ownership of projects from start to finish. We want someone who can balance accurate estimating, project coordination, and problem-solving while working alongside a dependable team.

Job Description

As a Project Manager / Estimator, you'll be responsible for preparing accurate project estimates, coordinating schedules and materials, and overseeing projects from initial planning through completion. This position plays a key role in ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to ESC's quality standards while maintaining strong communication between customers, vendors, and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare accurate project estimates, including material takeoffs, labor costs, and project pricing.
  • Review blueprints, shop drawings, specifications, and project requirements to determine scope and costs.
  • Manage projects from estimating and planning through production, delivery, and completion.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, coordinating timelines with shop production and customer deadlines.
  • Coordinate material purchasing, vendor quotes, and deliveries to ensure materials are available when needed.
  • Monitor project budgets, labor costs, and material expenses to maintain profitability.
  • Communicate with customers, vendors, and internal teams regarding project timelines, changes, and expectations.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to project scope, scheduling, materials, or production.
  • Track project progress, manage change orders, and maintain accurate project documentation.
  • Support improvements to estimating, scheduling, purchasing, and project management processes.

Job Requirements

We're looking for a dependable Project Manager / Estimator with strong organizational skills, construction or fabrication knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple projects while keeping quality, deadlines, and profitability in mind.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience in project management, estimating, construction, fabrication, or a related field.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, and project specifications.
  • Experience preparing estimates, material takeoffs, and project budgets.
  • Strong understanding of project scheduling, cost control, and resource coordination.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills when working with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Ability to work independently, make informed decisions, and take ownership of project outcomes.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in metal fabrication, structural steel, or manufacturing environments.
  • Previous experience managing fabrication or construction projects.
  • Knowledge of purchasing, vendor negotiations, and material procurement.
  • Experience with project management, estimating, or scheduling software.
  • Familiarity with CAD drawings and fabrication processes.
  • Experience tracking project profitability and managing change orders.

What's In It for You?

At ESC, we believe hard work should lead somewhere. As a Project Manager / Estimator, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of projects, contribute to company growth, and advance your career while enjoying the benefits of being part of the Crown Co. family.

Here's what we offer:

  • Competitive Compensation: Starting at $75,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Company-Paid Benefits: Group term life insurance and short-term disability.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan and HSA options.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • Free Gym Membership to The Wave Fitness.
  • Professional Development and opportunities for advancement.
  • A Team-First Culture: Built around grit, loyalty, integrity, a positive mindset, and enjoying the journey.

Apply today and join the ESC team!

title: Instructional Assistant - Resource Room
description:
BROOKINGS- HARBOR SCHOOL DISTRICT 17C


Azalea Middle School
INSTRUCTIONAL ASSISTANT
Special Education / Resource Room
7 hours

PURPOSE: The TA1/Instructional Assistant assists the Teacher in the delivery of an instructional program, through preparation of the classroom and materials, and through working with individual and small groups of students. The Instructional Assistant also provides supervision of student activities in order to ensure that the school maintains a safe and orderly environment.

REPORTS TO: Principal and/or Vice-Principal

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  1. Conducts oneself in the best interest of students, in accordance with the highest traditions of public education and in support of the District's Mission.
  2. Assists in the academic instruction and presentation of instructional materials by individually working with small groups of students, or individual students:
    • reinforcing instruction.
    • following up on specific language, spelling, reading, mathematics and other subject-area activities as directed by the Teacher.
    • monitoring and overseeing student tasks, practices and assignments in various subjects.
  3. Provides classroom support to the Teacher by setting up work areas and displays and distributing and collecting paper, supplies and materials.
  4. Supervises a variety of student activities including playground, cafeteria, bus loading, field trips, and other areas where students gather.
  5. Confers with teachers concerning lesson plans and materials to meet student needs.
  6. Prepares, administers, and scores various tests and assignments as directed, including proficiency placement tests.
  7. Provides assistance to students as the students review and complete classroom assignments, homework, and projects.
  8. Encourages acceptable student behavior and assists in maintaining classroom discipline. Guides and reinforces student understanding of classroom rules and procedures.
  9. Assists students by answering questions, providing proper examples of work expectations, and offering general guidance.
  10. Performs a variety of clerical duties using basic office equipment, computers, word processing software, spreadsheets, classroom software, and classroom computer programs:
    • Ordering, preparing, administering and correcting instructional materials.
    • Generating computer documents and duplicating materials.
    • Preparing lists and other documents, processing forms and applications.
    • Maintaining student records and files as directed.
    • Assembling materials, preparing individual profile charts, accounting for students.
    • Making phone calls of a general nature to parents.
    • Compiling information and materials and preparing reports as requested.
  11. Works with accuracy and attention to detail to meet deadlines.
  12. Understands and executes oral and written instructions, policies, and procedures.
  13. Maintains confidentiality.
  14. Maintains effective working relationships with other members of the school staff, students, and parents. Effectively works and communicates with students, parents, and staff from diverse cultures or backgrounds including those who speak limited or no English.

The statements contained above reflect general details as necessary to describe the principal functions of this job but should not be considered an all-inclusive listing of work requirements. Individuals may at times perform other duties as assigned which could include work in other functional areas to cover absences or relief, to equalize peak work periods or otherwise to balance the workload.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Must have completed two years of post-secondary education or an Associate's degree, preferably including coursework in working with children in an educational setting.
  2. In lieu of Item 1 above, must possess both of the following:
    • High School Diploma or equivalent, and
    • Passing score on a qualifying state or local academic assessment that measures knowledge of and the ability to assist in instructing reading, writing, and mathematics. (In order to qualify, this assessment must meet the requirements of the federal Elementary and Secondary Education Act. Information about qualifying assessments is available in the Human Resources office.)
  3. Must possess an understanding of child development principles and practices.
  4. Must be able to communicate effectively with other employees and students using tact, courtesy and good judgment.
  5. Must be able to collect data and perform basic mathematical functions.
  6. Must be able to communicate in written and spoken English with accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to understand and execute oral and written instructions.
  7. Must be able to operate standard office equipment such as computer, word processor, calculator and photocopier.


WORKING CONDITIONS:
The Instructional Assistant works primarily within the classroom and other areas of the school building and grounds where students may congregate. Although the primary work is indoors, the Instructional Assistant frequently works outdoors supervising students, in variable weather conditions including inclement weather. The incumbent must be able to stand and/or walk for long periods of time. The incumbent must be able to observe multiple students across large and small physical spaces and attend to individual student's needs while ensuring that other students are not unattended. The incumbent will need to walk quickly at times, and assume various physical postures associated with instruction and caring for students, including:

  1. sitting;
  2. pushing and pulling;
  3. lifting up to 25 lbs;
  4. bending, stooping, twisting, kneeling, reaching;
  5. speaking and hearing often in a noisy environment.

Potential exposures include, but are not limited to: blood-borne pathogens; aggressive behavior from students; cold and hot temperatures; and inclement and severe weather. The position involves high level of interaction with children from multiple and diverse backgrounds, many of whom have particular or unique physical and affective needs. Travel to multiple sites may be required. Occasional attendance at meetings or activities outside of the normal worksite may be required.

Work Year: 10 month
Employee Group: Classified BHEA TA1
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
Date Revised: June 1, 2015

title: Azure Consultant
description:
£65,000–£80,000 depending on experience | Hybrid — Birchwood, Warrington | Full-time, permanent — 37.5 hours per week

About Synextra

We’re Synextra, an independent Azure specialist helping businesses get more from their technology. Our customers include law firms, financial services organisations and other businesses where reliable, secure systems are essential to getting the job done.

We’re small by design, with technical depth, direct customer relationships and a strong sense of responsibility for the environments we build and manage. Customers work closely with the people making technical decisions, and our engineers have the opportunity to see their work make a real difference.

We’re looking for an Azure Consultant who enjoys understanding a customer’s problem, designing the right solution and getting hands-on to deliver it.

The role

You’ll design and build Azure solutions for customers, taking projects from discovery and architecture through implementation, testing and handover.

That could mean planning a migration, building an Azure landing zone, improving an existing environment or helping a customer move towards managed platform services. You’ll work across environments of different sizes and levels of maturity, making practical decisions about security, reliability, performance and cost.

You’ll also support our sales team with technical discovery, solution design and project scoping. You’ll help customers understand their options, explain the trade-offs and make sure our proposals reflect what it will actually take to deliver a good outcome.

The core of the role is customer architecture and project delivery. You’ll work alongside our cloud engineering, platform and security colleagues, drawing on their expertise and contributing your own.

What you’ll be doing

Understanding customers and designing solutions

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to understand business objectives, existing systems, dependencies and constraints.

  • Assess customer environments and recommend practical approaches to migration, modernisation and improvement.

  • Produce clear architecture diagrams and high-level and detailed designs that explain how the solution works and why you’ve chosen it.

  • Design Azure environments covering networking, identity, compute, storage, security, governance and resilience.

  • Build monitoring, backup, disaster recovery and ongoing support requirements into your designs from the outset.

  • Estimate Azure running costs and explain the implications of different design choices.

Building and delivering

  • Take technical ownership of customer projects, from an agreed design through to a working production environment.

  • Build and configure Azure infrastructure and services, using Terraform and automation to make deployments repeatable and maintainable.

  • Plan and deliver migrations, including dependency checks, testing, cutover and rollback arrangements.

  • Troubleshoot issues during implementation and work with colleagues, customers and third parties to resolve them.

  • Keep customers and project managers informed about progress, risks and decisions.

  • Deliver clear documentation and a thorough handover so our cloud engineering team can confidently support what you’ve built.

Supporting pre-sales

  • Join customer conversations alongside our sales team to explore requirements and shape appropriate solutions.

  • Contribute technical proposals, statements of work and realistic estimates of delivery effort.

  • Make scope, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions clear before a project starts.

  • Present recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders in straightforward language.

  • Challenge requirements constructively when a simpler, safer or more cost-effective approach would serve the customer better.

What you’ll bring

  • Practical experience designing and implementing Microsoft Azure solutions in production.

  • A strong understanding of Azure networking, identity, compute and storage, including how they connect to existing customer infrastructure.

  • Experience delivering migrations or infrastructure projects, with responsibility for technical decisions and outcomes.

  • Confidence leading customer discussions, asking useful questions and explaining your recommendations.

  • The ability to turn requirements into clear designs, implementation plans and documentation.

  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and scripting or automation.

  • Sound judgement about security, availability, recovery and cost.

  • The ability to recognise risks, ask for specialist input when needed and follow through on commitments.

You don’t need to know every Azure service. We’re interested in the depth of your understanding, the quality of your decisions and the work you’ve delivered.

You might already be working as an Azure Consultant, or be an experienced cloud engineer with substantial design and project delivery experience who wants greater involvement in customer discovery and architecture.

Useful additional experience

  • Working within a Microsoft partner, consultancy or managed service provider.

  • Supporting pre-sales, estimating project effort or writing statements of work.

  • Azure landing zones, the Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected reviews.

  • Azure Virtual Desktop, hybrid connectivity, Azure SQL or application services such as App Service and Azure Functions.

  • Delivering solutions for regulated organisations.

  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

How we work

We value people who take ownership, share their knowledge and care about the customer’s outcome. That means being honest about limitations, raising concerns early and keeping commitments.

You’ll have experienced colleagues to challenge ideas with, and the opportunity to improve our designs, deployment patterns and delivery practices. We want each project to leave both the customer’s environment and our own approach better than before.

What we offer

  • A salary of £65,000–£80,000, depending on experience.

  • Hybrid working from our Birchwood, Warrington office.

  • A permanent role with a 37.5-hour working week.

  • Funded Microsoft certifications and opportunities to deepen your Azure expertise.

  • Varied customer projects, with involvement from the first technical conversation through to delivery.

  • Direct access to technical leadership and the opportunity to influence how we design and build.

  • A specialist team where your contribution is visible and your judgement matters.

Apply through our careers site.

title: Senior Network Administrator
description:
Network Administrator

AECOM is seeking a Network Administrator to support the Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) District Six SunGuide Transportation Management Center (TMC) in Miami, Florida. The TMC operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, providing traffic management services throughout Miami-Dade and Monroe Counties. The successful operation of these services depends on a highly reliable, secure, and resilient telecommunications and IT network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will possess expert-level knowledge of Layers 1, 2, and 3 network engineering with extensive experience in enterprise networking, telecommunications, network security, and troubleshooting. Candidate must be comfortable working in a mission-critical, high-availability environment where network reliability, cybersecurity, and rapid incident resolution are essential. This is a full-time, on-site position reporting to the IT Manager.

Network Administration and Engineering

  • Configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including Extreme Networks Layer 2 and Layer 3 switches and Sophos firewalls
  • Provide expert-level troubleshooting of Layers 1, 2, and 3 network connectivity and performance issues
  • Configure and maintain network routing, VLANs, redundancy, and other network services to support continuous TMC operations
  • Support network high-availability configurations, redundancy, failover, and disaster recovery capabilities
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and security using network management platforms, including SolarWinds
  • Assist with network architecture planning, infrastructure upgrades, hardware replacements, and technology modernization initiatives
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, equipment configurations, and technical documentation

Telecommunications and ITS Integration

  • Troubleshoot telecommunications infrastructure utilizing fiber-optic cable, Ethernet, and wireless technologies
  • Support the integration, configuration, and troubleshooting of ITS field devices
  • Troubleshoot communication failures involving fiber-optic infrastructure, network switches, wireless systems, and ITS field devices
  • Support network connectivity between the TMC, ITS field locations, external agencies, and third-party systems
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot unicast, multicast, and anycast network communications, including video streaming and distribution
  • Assist with integrating new ITS technologies and telecommunications systems into the TMC network

Cybersecurity and Network Protection

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Sophos firewall policies, VPN tunnels, and network security configurations
  • Support cybersecurity initiatives, including vulnerability remediation, security updates, network segmentation, and infrastructure hardening
  • Network security assessments and the implementation of cybersecurity best practices
  • Support secure connectivity between the TMC, external agencies, contractors, and other authorized network partners
  • Network configuration changes follow established security procedures, documentation requirements, and change management practices

Systems Support and Technical Coordination

  • Assist with troubleshooting MS Windows Server environments and MS 365 applications including Outlook
  • Coordinate with internal IT personnel, FDOT representatives, vendors, and contractors to resolve technical issues
  • Plan and support the implementation and integration of new network technologies and infrastructure improvements
  • Participate in meetings for networking, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and ITS operations
  • Provide technical assistance during network outages and other critical operational events

    Minimum Technical Qualifications:

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related discipline
    • Eight years of experience in enterprise networking, telecommunications, network engineering, or network administration or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
    • Experience at an expert-level understanding of Layers 1, 2, and 3 network technologies
    • Experience in configuring, administering, and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching infrastructure
    • Experience supporting complex, high-availability network environments
    • Experienced and understanding in network redundancy, routing protocols, VLAN configurations, and network troubleshooting methodologies

    Demonstrated experience and proficiency or working knowledge in the following areas:

    • TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, routing, network redundancy, and troubleshooting
    • Extreme Networks switches and enterprise networking technologies
    • Sophos firewalls, firewall policies, VPN tunnels, network segmentation, and cybersecurity best practices
    • Fiber-optic communications, wireless networking, Ethernet connectivity, and telecommunications troubleshooting
    • Unicast, multicast, and anycast networking, including IP video distribution and streaming
    • SolarWinds and related network monitoring and diagnostic tools
    • MS Windows Server, MS 365, Outlook, and related MS applications
    • Network diagrams, equipment configurations, troubleshooting procedures, and change management documentation

    Possess or obtain the following certifications within 12 months of employment, subject to applicable training availability and certification eligibility.

    • Extreme Certified Associate (ECA)
    • Extreme Networks Certified Administrator (ENCA) - applicable switching technology
    • Extreme Certified Professional (ECP) - Extreme Switching
    • Sophos Firewall Certified Administrator
    • Sophos Firewall Certified Engineer (ET80), where eligible through the Sophos partner certification program
    • Equivalent or successor certifications may be considered with IT Manager approval

    Preferred:

    • Experience supporting FDOT TMCs or comparable traffic operations
    • Experience and knowledge of FDOT District Six ITS network architecture and telecommunications infrastructure
    • Experience with SunGuide ATMS
    • Familiarity with Operations Task Manager
    • Experience integrating and troubleshooting ITS field devices
    • Experience supporting large-scale fiber-optic networks and geographically distributed network infrastructure
    • Experience coordinating network integration projects with multiple vendors, contractors, and government agencies

title: Commercial Solutions Manager
description:
As Commercial Solutions Manager, you will help Milence turn energy & grid challenges into commercial opportunities. Reporting to the Regional Lead North, you will manage commercial projects and develop partnerships that help secure power for our charging hubs and support the continued expansion of our network. You will work at the intersection of energy, infrastructure and commercial development, developing partnerships with energy generators and other market participants and helping translate grid and energy challenges into practical commercial solutions.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work closely with colleagues across Site Acquisition, Grid, Energy, Legal, Finance and Commercial, coordinating different inputs and keeping opportunities moving from initial concept through to commercial agreement.

What you will do

  • Build energy partnerships: Identify and develop opportunities with energy generators, suppliers and other market participants that can help provide power to existing charging hubs or unlock new locations.

  • Turn challenges into opportunities: Work with Grid, Energy and Acquisition to understand power and grid constraints and help develop commercially viable solutions that support network expansion.

  • Build the business case: Bring together commercial, financial and technical inputs to prepare clear business cases, investment approvals and recommendations for decision-making.

  • Coordinate tenders: Support and coordinate Benelux tender activities with the Regional Lead, bringing together internal stakeholders, commercial inputs, documentation and approvals.

  • Progress agreements: Work closely with Legal, Finance and other stakeholders to support negotiations, contracting and project documentation, keeping opportunities moving towards execution.

  • Keep the commercial pipeline moving: Maintain clear opportunity overviews, reporting and project documentation, ensuring stakeholders understand priorities, decisions, actions and dependencies.

  • Spot new opportunities: Follow developments in energy markets, regulation and partnerships and identify opportunities that could help Milence optimise existing hubs or continue expanding the network.

  • Contribute beyond your core scope: Take on additional commercial projects and cross-functional workstreams as business priorities evolve, contributing additional expertise and capacity to initiatives supporting Milence's network and commercial objectives.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys bringing people together, solving commercial problems and turning opportunities into action.

You combine commercial thinking with strong organisational and analytical skills. You are comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can take information from different teams and turn it into a clear way forward.

You may have built your experience in energy, renewable energy, infrastructure, e-mobility, project development or commercial development. You do not need to be a grid engineer, but you should be curious about energy and comfortable understanding technical or grid-related information and translating it into commercial opportunities.

You bring:

  • Around 3–5 years of relevant experience in energy project development, energy product management, commercial project coordination, infrastructure or a comparable environment.

  • A bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent working and thinking level, ideally in areas such as Energy, Engineering, Business, Economics or Finance.

  • Experience coordinating projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several workstreams, priorities and deadlines.

  • Good commercial judgement and confidence working with business cases, financial information and commercial assumptions.

  • The ability to understand technical, grid or energy-related information and translate it into clear commercial documentation and recommendations.

  • Experience working with CRM, pipeline, reporting and project-management tools.

  • Strong written communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • The confidence to take ownership of agreed workstreams and influence progress without formal authority.

  • Professional fluency in English and Dutch.

What we offer

You'll be joining us at an exciting stage of growth where you can make a visible impact, work alongside passionate experts, and help solve some of the most complex challenges in the energy transition.

In return, we offer:

  • The opportunity to work on technology that contributes directly to a more sustainable future.

  • A high-impact role with significant ownership, autonomy and visibility across the business.

  • A collaborative, international and purpose-driven culture where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged.

  • The chance to work with leading industry partners, manufacturers and technology providers shaping the future of transport e-mobility.

  • Company annual incentive bonus plan.

  • Unlimited holiday policy.

  • Company pension plan.

  • A one-time home office allowance to create a comfortable and productive workspace.

  • Monthly phone allowance.

  • A 12-month fixed-term employment contract.

Ready to Charge the Future?

At Milence, we believe diverse perspectives drive better innovation and stronger outcomes. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, nationalities, identities and ways of thinking.

If you're excited about helping shape the future of charging technology and accelerating the transition to sustainable transport, we'd love to hear from you.

Come charge the future with us. Apply now and please submit your CV in English.

title: Project Manager Stadswarmte
description:
Wil jij technische projecten realiseren die zichtbaar bijdragen aan de warmtevoorziening in regio Rotterdam? Als Projectmanager Stadswarmte realiseer je warmtenetten en aansluitingen waarmee woningen en bedrijven van warmte kunnen worden voorzien. Je combineert techniek met stakeholdermanagement en levert zo een concrete bijdrage aan de energietransitie. There is a way.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Projectmanager Stadswarmte werk je aan meerdere warmte- en koude projecten in regio Rotterdam en Leiden, ieder in een andere fase. Van voorbereiding en engineering tot uitvoering en oplevering: jij zorgt samen met het projectteam dat plannen werkelijkheid worden.

Je:

  • stuurt projectteams met onder andere aannemers, werkvoorbereiders en opzichters aan;
  • bewaakt veiligheid, planning, budget, risico's en kwaliteit;
  • werkt samen met gemeenten, ingenieursbureaus, nutsbedrijven en andere belanghebbenden;
  • brengt technische, maatschappelijke en financiële belangen bij elkaar;
  • signaleert knelpunten vroeg en houdt de opdrachtgever op de hoogte van voortgang en belangrijke keuzes;
  • draagt bij aan verbeteringen waarmee we onze projecten steeds professioneler uitvoeren.

Daarmee werk je niet alleen aan technische infrastructuur, maar ook aan projecten die zichtbaar impact hebben op de ontwikkeling van de regio.

Locatie:
Rotterdam

Herken jij jezelf in het volgende profiel? Je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten en vindt het interessant om techniek, planning en verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen. Je hoeft niet ieder warmteconcept al tot in detail te kennen. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar de techniek en bereid bent je daarin verder te verdiepen.

Je hebt:

  • een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in civiele techniek, technische bedrijfskunde, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;
  • minimaal vijf jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan bij voorkeur drie jaar binnen infratechniek, weg- en waterbouw of warmte- en koude-infrastructuur;
  • ervaring met het aansturen van projectteams en projecten met een budget vanaf circa €500.000;
  • ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van verschillende belangen;
  • een zorgvuldige en gestructureerde werkwijze waarmee je grip houdt op risico's, planning en voortgang;
  • sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om de juiste prioriteiten te stellen.

Wij bieden De hoogte van jouw salaris wordt gebaseerd op je opleiding en relevante werkervaring.

Verder bieden we onder andere:

  • 8% vakantiegeld, een eindejaarsuitkering van 4,5% en een winstdeling tot 3,5%;
  • onder voorwaarden een auto van de zaak
  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer of €0,23 kilometervergoeding tot maximaal 50 km enkele reis;
  • een thuiswerkvergoeding van €3,05;
  • 20 vakantiedagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, 3,5 vitaliteitsdagen en 13 ADV-dagen bij een 38-uurscontract met een 40-urige werkweek;
  • pensioen bij ABP, waarbij Vattenfall 70% van de premie bijdraagt;
  • Mijn Budget Mijn Keuze en een opleidingsbudget voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling;
  • hybride werken, waarbij je in ieder geval 3 dagen per week op kantoor werkt


Solliciteren / Meer weten?
Klinkt dit interessant? We zien jouw sollicitatie graag uiterlijk 29 november 2026 tegemoet. Voor vragen over het recruitmentproces kun je contact opnemen met Thijs Suurmond, Corporate Recruiter, thijs.suurmond@vattenfall.com.

Bij Vattenfall zijn wij ervan overtuigd dat diversiteit een grote bijdrage levert aan onze organisatie. Daarom streven wij constant naar een harmonieuze balans tussen onze medewerkers op het gebied van leeftijd, seksuele geaardheid, geloofsovertuiging, genderidentiteit, (arbeids)beperking en culturele of etnische achtergrond.

De veiligheid van Vattenfall en haar medewerkers is essentieel. Daarom maakt een pre-employment screening deel uit van het selectieproces. De screening is gebaseerd op de rol die je gaat vervullen binnen Vattenfall. De screening wordt uitgevoerd door een derde partij, Validata.

We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

title: Transaction Monitoring Operations Officer
description:
Risk and Compliance is a global function that brings together all aspects of regulatory and financial crime risk management. Acting as risk stewards, and incorporating a range of specialist teams, we work together with the business and leverage advanced technology to help HSBC navigate a complex regulatory landscape and embed a sustainable approach to compliance risk management that supports safe growth and ensures fair outcomes for clients. Compliance aspires to continuously raise the bar and set leading standards across the industry to help HSBC safeguard its customers and the communities within which it operates.

Functional Description

FCI TM Operations(Transaction Monitoring) is one of the teams within FCI (Financial Crime Investigations). Transaction monitoring is a process to detect and limit potential financial crime risk exposure by analyzing cases generated by TM systems for multiple Line of Business products and identifying cases with potential financial crime. That includes, but not limited to below:
(i) Analysing the cases with the utilisation of internal system data sources and external sources available to establish whether the alerted activity is in line with the subject’s expected behaviour where case closure is warranted if no unusual activity is identified.
(ii) Action where unusual activity is identified that warrants a financial crime investigation and potential consideration by the appropriate Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) or delegated authority as to whether a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) or Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) is warranted.

People Responsibility: No

Reports To: VP, TM Operations/ SVP and Head of Investigation

Role Purpose

Responsible for conducting investigations in accordance with the procedures to fulfil regulatory requirements

Job Contents

  1. Conduct transaction monitoring and review customer activities to identify unusual or potentially suspicious transactions.

  2. Perform investigations on assigned alerts/cases, with guidance and training, in accordance with internal procedures and timelines.

  3. Prepare clear and structured case records, including investigation notes and summaries, to build strong analytical and documentation skills.

  4. Support quality checks to ensure investigation outputs meet internal standards and regulatory expectations.

  5. Assist in follow-up actions such as KYC/CDD refresh, Request for Information (RFI), and other related tasks to gain end-to-end case handling experience.

  6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. frontline, operations, regional teams), gaining exposure to different areas of the bank.

  7. Participate in routine risk control activities, including reviews of outsourced processes, to understand regulatory requirements and control frameworks.

  8. Support the preparation of management reports (MI) and contribute to AML-related projects, providing opportunities to develop project and stakeholder management skills.

Skills Requirements

  1. Education: Bachelor degree or above.
  2. Good command of English.
  3. AML/CFT related experience is preferred.

License/Qualification Requirement

  1. Domestic or international AML/CFT professional certificate issued by an institution recognized by the FSC.

title: Data Engineer
location: Burton on the Wolds, United Kingdom
description:
Why choose us?

BRUSH Group provides the energy solutions that help power our built world. From power transformers to switchgear and engineering solutions, for generations, the BRUSH brand has stood for engineering excellence. We are committed to supporting the global effort for industrial decarbonisation and sustainable development and have set ambitious objectives to achieve our target of net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050.

Data Engineer role

What's the role? The Data Engineer, working within the Group IT Data & AI team, is responsible for building, maintaining and optimising reliable data pipelines and data platforms that make accurate, governed data available across BRUSH Group. Working with business and technical stakeholders, the Data Engineer will connect source systems, transform and structure data through the medallion architecture, and deliver trusted data products within Microsoft Fabric. This is a hands-on delivery role owning the data platform, combining strong data engineering expertise with a focus on security, quality, documentation and continuous improvement,

  • + Design, build, test and maintain reliable data pipelines that ingest data from ERP, operational and third-party systems.
  • + Develop and maintain the Microsoft Fabric data platform using appropriate lakehouse/warehouse, pipeline and transformation capabilities.
  • + Implement processes to ensure data is accurate, complete and timely.
  • + Apply data governance, naming, metadata, retention and classification standards across the platform.
  • + Translate business and reporting requirements into scalable technical designs and well-defined data products.
  • + Provide trusted Gold-layer datasets and semantic-ready structures for BI, ML and AI use cases.
  • + Identify and deliver improvements to engineering standards, automation, deployment practices and platform efficiency.
  • + Evaluate new Microsoft Fabric capabilities and recommend adoption where they provide demonstrable business value.

Qualifications

  • + Degree or equivalent professional experience in data engineering, computer science, software engineering, mathematics or another relevant technical discipline.
  • + Evidence of continued professional development in modern data engineering, cloud data platforms and development practices.
  • + Microsoft certification, such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Azure Data Engineer Associate or an equivalent cloud data qualification. (desirable)
  • + Strong SQL skills, including querying, transformation, optimisation and troubleshooting across complex datasets.
  • + Practical knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, including Data Factory pipelines, Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake and notebooks.
  • + Ability to design scalable data models and apply medallion architecture, dimensional modelling and reusable data-product principles.
  • + Experience developing and maintaining a cloud-based lakehouse or data warehouse; Microsoft Fabric is strongly preferred.
  • + Experience implementing data quality, monitoring, reconciliation, metadata, lineage and role-based access controls.
  • + Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and working with analysts, developers, data owners and stakeholders.
  • + Experience supporting Power BI, analytics or AI use cases and helping a growing data function establish engineering standards.

Company Overview

BRUSH Group provide agile and adaptive engineering solutions and products, including consultancy services, design, and project management as well as award-winning product technology, to a wide range of projects. A chosen partner for national and regional power generation and distribution network operators, through innovation and a commitment to delivering solutions that address grid-resilience and drive system change, we support the global drive to net-zero, helping create a future-proof Infrastructure.

Benefits

  • + Competitive salary + Holiday allowance starting at 26 days per annum plus bank holidays (pro rata for part time roles)
  • + Flexible and Hybrid working options (role dependant)
  • + Life insurance - 4 x annual salary
  • + Enhanced Company Pension scheme
  • + 24/7 free and confidential Employee Assistance Programme
  • + GP24 Service - Access to remote, private GP services 24/7, 365 days a year plus Second Medical Opinions.
  • + BRUSHRewards - Discover plenty of ways to get more active and make great savings on everyday essentials as well as gifts for loved ones, holidays and special treats for yourself.
  • + Family friendly policies including Enhanced Maternity/Paternity
  • + Bike2work scheme
  • + Long Service Awards
  • + Developing our people is important to us - we support and encourage development by offering ongoing professional development and training.

title: Projectmedewerker Preventie & Vitaliteit
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Wil je bijdragen aan zorg waarin niet alleen behandeling, maar ook de vitaliteit van patiënten centraal staat? Krijg je energie van het organiseren en uitvoeren van projecten, samenwerken met verschillende stakeholders en het vertalen van plannen naar concrete acties op de werkvloer? Dan zoeken we jou.

Als projectmedewerker Preventie & Vitaliteit werk je primair aan twee initiatieven binnen Maastricht UMC+: het uitvoeren van een pilot van de Activeerkracht op twee verpleegafdelingen en de ziekenhuisbrede implementatie van verschillende beweeg- en voedingsinitiatieven. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze initiatieven goed worden voorbereid, uitgevoerd en geëvalueerd.

Je werkt binnen een projectteam dat gezamenlijk verantwoordelijk is voor 7 projecten die bijdragen aan de vitaliteit van patiënten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan de coördinatie en uitvoering van twee van die projecten. Binnen het team wordt flexibel samengewerkt. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met zorgprofessionals, onderzoekers, studenten en andere betrokkenen. Je houdt overzicht, bewaakt de voortgang en signaleert knelpunten. Je verbindt mensen en werkzaamheden en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling en duurzame inbedding van preventie en vitaliteit binnen het MUMC+.

Waar werk je aan?
Je werkt primair aan twee projecten die bijdragen aan het bevorderen van bewegen, gezonde voeding en herstel tijdens een ziekenhuisopname. Daarnaast draag je door je deelname aan het projectteam bij aan de5 andere lopende projecten, ook gerelateerd aan de vitaliteit van patiënten.

1- De Activeerkracht
De Activeerkracht is een zorgmedewerker die verpleegkundigen ondersteunt bij het stimuleren van gezond en herstelbevorderend gedrag bij patiënten. De Activeerkracht richt zich op bewegen, voeding en mentale gezondheid en vult de bestaande ondersteuning door onder andere verpleegkundigen, fysiotherapeuten, diëtisten, psychosociale zorg en voedingsassistenten aan.

De Activeerkracht informeert, stimuleert en begeleidt patiënten tijdens hun opname, biedt een luisterend oor en heeft een signalerende functie. Het initiatief wordt als pilot geïmplementeerd op twee verpleegafdelingen.

Om de pilot te evalueren, worden voor en tijdens de implementatie metingen uitgevoerd. Hiermee wordt onderzocht of patiënten door de inzet van de Activeerkracht meer gaan bewegen en meer eiwitten gaan eten. Je coördineert de uitvoering van de pilot en de metingen, begeleidt betrokken studenten en werkt samen met onderzoekers aan de dataverzameling en evaluatie.

2- Implementatie van beweeg- en voedingsinitiatieven
De afgelopen jaren zijn verschillende initiatieven ontwikkeld om bewegen en gezonde voeding tijdens een ziekenhuisopname te stimuleren. Deze initiatieven zijn echter nog niet overal binnen het ziekenhuis geïmplementeerd.

Je brengt samen met betrokken collega’s in kaart welke initiatieven op welke afdelingen passend zijn en coördineert de verdere implementatie. Je stelt hiervoor een implementatieplan op, stemt af met afdelingen en zorgprofessionals en volgt de voortgang. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de uitvoering, maar ook naar wat nodig is om de initiatieven onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse zorgpraktijk.

Wat ga je doen?
Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • zelfstandig coördineren en uitvoeren van de pilot Activeerkracht op twee verpleegafdelingen;

  • voorbereiden, plannen en bewaken van de verschillende projectactiviteiten, acties en deadlines;

  • nauwe afstemming met het projectteam (team Vitale Mens Zorginnovatielab), verpleegafdelingen, zorgprofessionals, onderzoekers en andere stakeholders over de uitvoering van de pilot;

  • begeleiden van studenten betrokken bij de uitvoering van de pilot;

  • coördineren en uitvoeren van de voor- en nametingen van de pilot;

  • in kaart brengen welke beweeg- en voedingsinitiatieven op welke afdelingen passend zijn;

  • opstellen en uitvoeren van een implementatieplan voor de ziekenhuisbrede invoering van beweeg- en voedingsinitiatieven;

  • afstemmen met de afdelingen en zorgprofessionals over de implementatie en signaleren en opvolgen van knelpunten;

  • monitoren van de voortgang en resultaten aan de hand van afgesproken indicatoren (KPI’s);

  • rapporteren over de voortgang en resultaten en deze bespreken in projectoverleggen;

  • bijdragen aan de evaluatie en verdere ontwikkeling van de initiatieven.

Hoe ziet je werkomgeving eruit?

Een veelzijdige werkomgeving
Je werkt binnen Maastricht UMC+ en maakt onderdeel uit van het programmateam Preventie & Vitaliteit. Vanuit deze rol draag je bij aan de implementatie van initiatieven die preventie en vitaliteit een structurele plek geven in de zorg voor patiënten.

Je hebt contact met uiteenlopende collega’s, zoals zorgprofessionals, projectleiders, onderzoekers, communicatiemedewerkers en studenten. Je beweegt je daarmee tussen de projectorganisatie en de dagelijkse praktijk op de afdelingen. Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig aan de slag te gaan en hebt tegelijkertijd korte lijnen met het projectteam en inhoudelijke experts.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Wat breng je mee?
We zoeken iemand die graag organiseert, samenwerkt en zaken voor elkaar krijgt. Je vindt het leuk om plannen om te zetten in concrete acties en krijgt energie van het begeleiden van veranderingen in de praktijk. Je hebt:

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een verpleegkundig of paramedische achtergrond, en/of ervaring met implementatie en projectmatig werken;

  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een verbindende houding; je legt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers op verschillende niveaus binnen de organisatie en weet uiteenlopende stakeholders bij elkaar te brengen.

  • een gestructureerde werkwijze: je houdt overzicht over verschillende activiteiten en deadlines, ook wanneer er meerdere acties en belangen tegelijkertijd spelen;

  • organisatiesensitiviteit: je hebt oog voor verschillende perspectieven en belangen en kunt constructief omgaan met weerstand en veranderingen in een complexe organisatie.

Ervaring binnen een ziekenhuis of andere complexe zorgorganisatie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

Om succesvol te starten in deze rol, is het belangrijk dat je de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst (minimaal B2-niveau) in verband met het contact met onder andere patiënten en collega's. Daarnaast is het een voorwaarde dat je in Nederland mag werken (EU/EER-nationaliteit of een geldige werkvergunning).

Voldoe jij aan deze functie-eisen? Dan gaan wij voor jou!

Salaris

​Afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring bedraagt het salaris minimaal €3.550,- en maximaal € 4.722,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime aanstelling. Dit salaris is exclusief vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.

Arbeidsovereenkomst

Het betreft een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar conform artikel 2.4.2 van de Cao umc. Het betreft een aanstelling van +/- 0.8 fte. Het exact aantal contracturen bepalen we in onderling overleg.

Wat bieden wij

title: Typhoon HIL Testing Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Typhoon HIL Testing Engineer responsible for developing, configuring, and executing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing solutions using Typhoon HIL real-time simulation platforms.

The role involves validating embedded controllers and power electronics systems through real-time simulation, developing test scenarios, automating test execution, and performing functional and integration testing of control algorithms and hardware interfaces.

The candidate should have hands-on experience with Typhoon HIL hardware and software tools, particularly TyphoonSim, Schematic Editor, HIL SCADA, and Python-based test automation.

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, and maintain HIL test benches using Typhoon HIL hardware platforms.

  • Develop real-time simulation models for power electronics converters, electrical machines, batteries, inverters, and grid-connected systems.

  • Configure and integrate Hardware Under Test (HUT), including embedded controllers, BMS, inverter controllers, PCS, and EMS controllers.

  • Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, and system-level test cases.

  • Create electrical circuit models using Typhoon HIL Schematic Editor.

  • Configure simulation models, I/O interfaces, signal conditioning, and communication interfaces.

  • Develop automated test scripts using Python and Typhoon HIL API.

  • Perform closed-loop testing of control algorithms and embedded software.

  • Validate controller responses under normal, boundary, abnormal, and fault conditions.

  • Perform fault-injection testing, protection testing, and transient response analysis.

  • Integrate and validate communication protocols such as CAN, CAN FD, Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, Ethernet, and other industrial communication interfaces.

  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot issues, and perform root-cause analysis.

  • Develop test reports, test specifications, and requirements traceability documentation.

  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, control systems, and system engineering teams.

Experience: 5–8 years
Domain: Electric Vehicles / Power Electronics / Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) / Energy Systems

Educational qualification:

  1. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Power Electronics, Instrumentation, or related disciplines.

  2. 5–8 years of relevant experience in HIL testing, power electronics validation, or embedded controller testing.

Mandatory/requires Skills :
Key Competencies

  • Strong understanding of power electronics and control systems.

  • Hands-on experience with Typhoon HIL hardware and software.

  • Strong Python programming and test automation skills.

  • Ability to develop real-time simulation models.

  • Good debugging and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Understanding of electrical systems, control algorithms, and embedded controllers.

Preferred Skills :

  1. Experience in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) validation.

  2. Knowledge of grid-connected and grid-forming inverters.

  3. Experience with solar PV systems and microgrid simulation.

  4. Knowledge of battery modelling, SOC/SOH estimation, and BMS algorithms.

  5. Experience in power converter control and digital control systems.

  6. Knowledge of IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, and industrial communication protocols.

  7. Experience with MATLAB/Simulink and integration of simulation models.

  8. Knowledge of IEC 62109, IEC 62933, IEEE 1547, and relevant grid codes.

  9. Experience in automated regression testing and CI/CD integration.
