title: Market Area Coordinator
description:
In this position...

The Market Area Coordinator (MAC) serves as the strategic market leader and primary connection point between Ford strategy, MarketSource execution, market intelligence, and dealer outcomes.
The MAC is responsible for translating Ford's technician workforce priorities into a coordinated market strategy, establishing priorities for the TCS team, allocating resources based on dealer need and opportunity, and ensuring measurable improvement in technician workforce outcomes.
The MAC provides strategic oversight and governance for six TCS resources while maintaining alignment with Ford Regional Teams, dealer leadership, training and education partners, New Ford Tech, and other relevant Ford business partners.

What you'll do...

Success in this role is measured by market-level dealer outcomes, technician workforce improvement, TCS effectiveness, program adoption, cost efficiency, and return on investment — not simply activity volume.

Key Responsibilities
1. Market Strategy & Workforce Planning
Own the workforce strategy for the assigned market and establish priorities based on dealer needs, workforce data, market intelligence, and Ford strategic objectives.

• Own market-level technician workforce priorities and strategic objectives.
• Identify high-risk and high-opportunity dealerships.
• Analyze market trends, workforce gaps, retention challenges, recruiting needs, training requirements, and technician capacity.
• Establish TCS priorities and market engagement strategies.
• Identify emerging workforce trends and risks before they become critical issues.
• Prioritize TCS resources toward dealerships and opportunities with the greatest potential impact.
• Develop and maintain a market-level view of technician supply, demand, retention, pipeline, capacity, and readiness.
• Translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations for Ford and MarketSource leadership.

2. TCS Leadership & Governance
Provide strategic direction, coaching, prioritization, and performance governance for TCS resources.

• Manage and provide strategic direction to TCS resources.
• Establish clear market priorities and expectations for TCS execution.
• Balance TCS workloads based on dealer complexity, geography, workforce need, and business opportunity.
• Ensure the appropriate TCS resource is assigned to each dealer opportunity.
• Review dealer assessments, engagement strategies, and action plans.
• Monitor execution against market priorities and performance objectives.
• Identify resource constraints and adjust assignments as market conditions change.
• Coach TCSs on consultative dealer engagement, workforce strategy, and outcome-based execution.
• Ensure TCS activity is focused on measurable dealer outcomes rather than activity volume.
• Identify and escalate performance or resource issues requiring leadership intervention.


3. Ford & Strategic Partner Alignment
Serve as the primary market-level connection point between MarketSource and Ford stakeholders. Build and maintain strong relationships with:

• Ford Regional Teams
• Dealer leadership
• Ford and Lincoln dealerships Training and education partners
• New Ford Tech
• Technical schools and colleges
• Relevant Ford business partners
• Other workforce and technician development stakeholders

4. Dealer Escalation & Strategic Intervention
Serve as the escalation point for significant or complex dealer workforce challenges.
Escalation areas may include:

• Critical technician shortages
• Significant technician retention issues
• Persistent 0–2 year technician attrition
• Major recruiting or pipeline challenges
• Significant training or certification gaps
• Technician capacity constraints
• Complex dealer workforce challenges
• Tools, equipment, diagnostic, or technology readiness concerns
• Operational issues requiring cross-functional support

The MAC will determine the appropriate level of intervention and coordinate resources to develop and execute solutions.

5. Market Performance & Accountability
Own the performance of the assigned market and ensure TCS activities translate into measurable dealer outcomes.
Monitor and report performance across:

• Technician retention
• Early-career technician retention
• Technician placements and growth
• Technician pipeline development
• Training and certification
• Technician capacity
• Service operations impact
• Tools, equipment, diagnostics, and technology readiness
• Program adoption
• Dealer action-plan execution
• Dealer satisfaction
• TCS productivity
• Cost per dealer
• Return on investment (ROI)

The MAC will establish market-level performance targets, monitor progress, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions when performance is off target.

6. Market Intelligence & Continuous Improvement
Use data, dealer feedback, and TCS insights to identify opportunities to improve the overall program.

• Aggregate TCS dealer intelligence into market-level insights.
• Identify common dealer workforce challenges and emerging trends.
• Identify successful practices that can be replicated across the market.
• Recommend process, program, or resource improvements.
• Use performance data to optimize TCS resource allocation.
• Provide leadership with actionable market intelligence and recommendations.
• Support continuous improvement of the TPS operating model.



You'll have...

• Associates degree required
• 2–5+ years of professional experience in automotive or manufacturing environment
• Ability and willingness to travel frequently (approximately 65%), including overnight and out-of-state travel
• Strong understanding of dealership Parts and Service operations, technician productivity, and service capacity
• Experience in project or program management and business planning
• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, follow through, and solve problems quickly
• Willingness to relocate now or in the future
• Valid, unrestricted driver’s license

Even better, you may have...

• Bachelor’s degree
• Experience in automotive service and support
• Strong communication, collaboration, organization, and presentation skills
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Teams, and SharePoint
• Familiar with Ford systems, including PTS and STARS

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

• Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
• Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance
• Established and active employee resource groups
• Paid time off for individual and team community service
• Generous vacation time, sick/personal time, and paid holidays, including between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day

This position is a salary grade 5 and ranges from $65,100-$109,300.

This position is a salary grade 6 and ranges from $74,300-$124,500.

Bij JDE Peet’s krijg je de kans om écht het verschil te maken. Je werkt hands-on en kunt je stempel drukken, terwijl je samenwerkt met een team dat gedreven is door één gemeenschappelijk doel. Je stage moet in je studiecurriculum zijn opgenomen en direct bijdragen aan je resultaten.

title: Estimating Coordinator
description:
It is the purpose of this position to provide administrative, purchasing, and estimating

support to the Estimating Department while developing the knowledge and skills necessary

to transition into an Estimator role. This position serves as a key link between estimating,

purchasing, manufacturing, vendors, and project teams.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

• Provide administrative support to the Estimating Department.

• Maintain estimating files, project records, vendor quotes, and bid documentation.

• Obtain vendor pricing and coordinate purchasing activities.

• Support preparation of customer quotations and bid packages.

• Gather cost information from production, purchasing, and vendors.

• Coordinate communication between estimating, engineering, manufacturing, and

purchasing.

• Participate in project and manufacturing meetings.

Role Summary and Impact

About WPP 650

Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.

Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. It’s demanding – but always rewarding.

WPP 650 is a bespoke agency unit within WPP, dedicated to serving the evolving communications needs of government clients. We bring together the best of WPP's talent, technology, and insights to deliver impactful, modern, and effective public communications. We are at the forefront of reimagining how government engages with its citizens.

This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.

About the role:

The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at WPP 650. We are the central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.

WPP 650 is looking for a Planning Executive to join our growing planning team, to support the planning team and give your career a flying start in the media industry.

In this role, you will:

Media planning craft:

  • Develop a baseline of media planning knowledge across channels.

Effective communication:

  • Work with your line manager to deliver your objectives and goals in line with your role and agency vision.

Core skills:

Practice Area Knowledge – Fundamental

  • Can run simple tasks independently and either present to clients direct or package for wider team.

  • Develops a broad understanding of industry tools, technology, techniques and systems as well as application.

Stakeholder Relationships – Fundamental

  • Has good understanding of agency and client and their business goals and challenges.
  • Builds a working knowledge of market trends effecting the client (and agency).​​​​​​​
  • Responds to stakeholder requests in an accurate, timely and professional manner and seeks to have a good understanding of client needs and challenges.

Effective Communication – Fundamental

  • Seeks relevant information to ensure own understanding of complex information.

  • Provides accurate information and learns how to simplify complex information.
  • Adapts communication style and method to the audience. ​​​​​​​
  • Applies subject matter knowledge to answer technical questions clearly and concisely and limits jargon.

Campaign Management – Fundamental

  • Manages the implementation of campaigns, including compliant approvals and finance. g PO and creative trackers

Ideas Creation – Fundamental

Comms Planning – Fundamental

title: Enterprise Records Management Lead
description:
Contingent Contract Award

US Citizenship Required


Connected Logistics is seeking to hire Enterprise Records Management Lead to serve as the USSOCOM Enterprise Knowledge Management Program senior records management advisor, helping Government stakeholders develop and implement enterprise governance, policy, standards, and procedures while performing hands-on daily records management activities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee SharePoint, Microsoft 365, enterprise content repositories, and other authorized records management platforms to support secure storage, organization, retrieval, preservation, and lifecycle management of official records and mission information.
  • Lead records management delivery within the USSOCOM Enterprise Knowledge Management program on multiple classified networks.
  • Coordinate records inventories, repository assessments, data migration, content consolidation, archival activities, and records disposition reviews.
  • Implement Microsoft Purview retention labels, records policies, access controls, audit capabilities, and information protection measures where authorized.
  • Serve as the contractor’s senior records management advisor, helping Government stakeholders develop and implement enterprise governance, policy, standards, and procedures while performing hands-on daily records management activities.
  • Collaborate with KM specialists, platform engineers, cybersecurity personnel, legal advisors, and Government records officers to improve repository architecture, enterprise search, taxonomy management, information accessibility, and compliance.
  • Provide functional leadership and technical direction to a distributed team of 13 specialists supporting USSOCOM Headquarters, Service Components, and Theater Special Operations Commands (TSOC).
  • Establish consistent enterprise practices, accommodate approved local requirements, and ensure records remain discoverable, appropriately protected, and managed throughout their lifecycle.
  • Advise Government records management and EKM leadership on enterprise governance, policy implementation, retention requirements, repository practices, and records management risks. Develop recommendations and draft guidance for Government review and approval.
  • Translate approved policy and records schedules into practical file plans, taxonomies, metadata standards, tagging rules, retention mappings, and operating procedures.
  • Coordinate daily work across 13 geographically distributed specialists; establish priorities, provide technical guidance, review work quality, resolve complex issues, and elevate decisions requiring Government authority.
  • Perform and oversee records inventories, classification, metadata validation, records capture and declaration, retention reviews, hold coordination, disposition preparation, and archival transfer support.
  • Assess Component and TSOC repositories and practices; identify gaps, document corrective actions, and support adoption of enterprise standards.
  • Work with platform engineers and administrators to implement and validate records controls across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and other platforms.
  • Support migrations and repository modernization by defining records requirements and validating preservation of metadata, permissions, retention information, holds, and record integrity.
  • Embed records requirements into new applications, workflows, document libraries, and reusable EKM solutions during discovery, design, testing, and release.
  • Develop SOPs, governance documentation, quality standards, compliance metrics, user training, and corrective action plans job aids, and role-based training with the organizational change management team; coach specialists and local content owners.
  • Maintain records management metrics, compliance evidence, risk and issue logs, and status reporting. Brief enterprise working groups and recommend improvements.
  • Support inspections, audits, eDiscovery requests, records preservation requirements, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

title: Asentaja Datakeskuksiin
location: Uusimaa, Espoo, Helsinki, Hyvinkää, Järvenpää, Kerava, Kirkkonummi, Lohja, Mäntsälä, Tuusula, Vantaa
description:
Haemme asentajia kansainvälisiin datakeskusprojekteihin

Jos mikään ei pidättele sinua paikoillasi, kiinnostaisiko monipuolinen työ vaihtuvissa kohteissa ja kansainvälisissä datakeskusprojekteissa?

Tässä tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan tekoälydatakeskusten tietoliikenneinfrastruktuuria, työskentelemään erilaisissa työympäristöissä ja kurkistamaan kulisseihin, joihin vain harvat pääsevät.

Tästä on kyse

Asiakkaamme hakee uusia työntekijöitä vaihtuviin datakeskusprojekteihin eri puolille Eurooppaa, Suomi mukaan lukien. Asiakkaamme on suomalainen kasvuyritys, joka toteuttaa kaapelointi- ja verkkoasennuksia merkittäviin datakeskushankkeisiin sekä muihin vaativiin toimintaympäristöihin.

Työsuhde solmitaan Visio Sähkö Oy:n kanssa. Tehtävässä on kuitenkin hyvä mahdollisuus siirtyä myöhemmin suoraan asiakasyrityksemme palvelukseen.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Työnkuva koostuu tietoliikennekaapeloinnista ja laiteasennuksista datakeskusympäristössä. Tehtävässä kädet pääsevät töihin, ja tarkkuudelle sekä sorminäppäryydelle tulee runsaasti käyttöä.

Työskentely edellyttää hyvää rutiininsietokykyä, sillä työvaiheet ovat tarkasti määriteltyjä. Samalla jokainen kohde on kuitenkin omanlaisensa, eikä työ teknologian jatkuvasti kehittyessä käy tylsäksi. Tässä tehtävässä pääset pysymään kehityksen aallonharjalla ja oppimaan uutta toimintatapojen sekä teknologioiden muuttuessa.

Työtä tehdään pääosin urakkaluontoisesti. Työpäivien pituus ja työajat voivat vaihdella projektin mukaan, ja työtä voidaan tehdä myös viikonloppuisin. Projektien kokonaiskestot vaihtelevat muutamasta kuukaudesta useisiin kuukausiin.

Työskentely tapahtuu tyypillisesti 2–3 viikon projektijaksoissa, joita seuraa Suomessa vietettävä lepojakso. Haemme tehtävään matkustusvalmiita työntekijöitä, mutta työkohde voi sijaita myös Suomessa. Työkomennukselle lähdetään pääosin yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

Tässä vaiheessa lienee jo selvää, että sopeutumiskyky, joustavuus ja uutteruus ovat tehtävän ehdottomia edellytyksiä. Vieläkö olet valmis tarttumaan haasteeseen? Hyvä, jatketaan!

Tarjoamme

Tämä on erinomainen mahdollisuus päästä rakentamaan tekoälyn infrastruktuuria eri puolilla Eurooppaa. Syvään päätyyn ei tarvitse hypätä kylmiltään, sillä työhön opastetaan käytännön kautta Vantaan toimitiloissa. Tukenasi on myös nuorekas ja hyvähenkinen työporukka, jossa opitaan yhdessä ja apua saa aina tarvittaessa.

Tuntipalkka, korvaukset ja matkaedut muodostavat erittäin kilpailukykyisen kokonaisuuden. Lisäksi tehtävässä voi olla mahdollista ansaita urakkapalkkioita tai projektikohtaisia korvauksia erikseen sovittavien ehtojen mukaisesti. Ahkerasta tekemisestä halutaan palkita.

Työnantaja hoitaa ulkomaanprojektien matkat ja hotellitasoisen majoituksen sekä korvaa ennalta sovitut paikalliset matkakulut.

Mikäli yhteistyö sujuu puolin ja toisin hyvin, sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet työllistyä suoraan asiakkaamme palvelukseen. Onkin useita, joille samaan tilaisuuteen tarttuminen on poikinut hienon uratarinan.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan Energia-, ICT- ja verkostoalan työehtosopimusta.

Etsimme

Haemme monipuolista joukkoa tekijöitä. Tehtävään voivat sopia niin kokeneet tietoliikenne-, sähkö- ja asennusalan ammattilaiset kuin vähemmällä kokemuksella tulevat henkilöt, joilla on motivaatio kohdallaan.

Mikäli vahvuuksiisi kuuluu käsillä tekeminen ja olet esimerkiksi tottunut rakentamaan tai virittelemään mopoja, tehtävä saattaa hyvinkin sopia myös sinulle. Hae siis rohkeasti!

Tehtävässä pärjää oppimishaluinen ja tiimihenkinen tekijä, joka työskentelee tehokkaasti turvallisuutta unohtamatta. Odotamme sinulta erinomaista tarkkuutta ja huolellisuutta sekä kykyä noudattaa asiakkaan ja työnantajan antamia ohjeita.

Tarkemmat hakukriteerit

• Soveltuva toisen asteen tutkinto
• Hyvä sorminäppäryys ja huolellinen työskentelyote
• B-ajokortti ja mahdollisuus oman auton käyttöön
• Hyvä suomen kielen taito; englannin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi
• Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti
• Nuhteeton tausta
• Valmius työskennellä projektiluonteisesti vaihtelevina työaikoina sekä ulkomailla

Onko meillä yhteinen visio?

Tällainen tehtävä voi ymmärrettävästi herättää kysymyksiä, mutta mikäli kiinnostuksesi heräsi, lähetä hakemuksesi järjestelmämme kautta. Tehtävän yksityiskohdat tarkentuvat rekrytointiprosessin aikana ja projektikohtaisesti.

Lisätiedot

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää sähköpostia rekrytoinnista vastaavalle henkilölle otsikolla ”Datakeskusasentaja”:

• Perttu Ikonen / perttu.ikonen(at)visiohr.fi

Jätäthän itsesi esittelyn ja varsinaiset myyntipuheesi kuitenkin hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio Sähkö – Ainoa lajissaan

Visio Sähkö on Suomen ainoa täysin sähköalaan erikoistunut henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Asiakkaitamme ovat sähköurakointiyritykset, teollisuus, ICT- ja datakeskusala, suunnittelutoimistot sekä muut sähköalan osaajia tarvitsevat toimijat. Emme vain välitä henkilöstöä, vaan tunnemme alan ja ymmärrämme, millaista osaamista työmailla oikeasti tarvitaan. Siksi pystymme löytämään sopivan työn niin kokeneelle ammattilaiselle kuin vastavalmistuneellekin, ympäri Suomen.

Visio Sähkö on osa Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys.

title: Research Study Assistant II- Gastro Procedure - Main
description:
About the Department

Join Henry Ford Medical Group, one of Michigan's largest physician organizations, dedicated to delivering coordinated care across primary and specialty practices throughout the region. Our team thrives on collaborative teamwork, access to leading clinical resources, and the opportunity to build lasting relationships with patients and communities. Be part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the health and well-being of those we serve.

Why Henry Ford Health

At Henry Ford Health, we are relentless advocates for exceptional care for our patients, communities, and each other. We come to do meaningful work and grow our careers, and we stay for the connection, support, and shared pride in making the impossible, possible.

General Summary

Under limited supervision, the Research Study Assistant II supports the coordination and execution of clinical and research studies in compliance with institutional policies, regulatory requirements, and applicable federal regulations. This role serves as a key resource for study operations, participant engagement, regulatory compliance, and data management. The Research Study Assistant II works closely with principal investigators, study teams, clinical staff, sponsors, and research participants to ensure studies are conducted accurately, efficiently, and safely. Direct interaction with research participants is a core responsibility of this position.

Research Operations & Regulatory Compliance

  • Supports the implementation and conduct of research studies in accordance with study protocols, institutional policies, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable federal regulations.
  • Maintains accurate and complete study records, regulatory documentation, and research data.
  • Assists with monitoring, documenting, and reporting adverse events, protocol deviations, and participant safety concerns under the direction of the Principal Investigator (PI) or project leadership.
  • Ensures research activities comply with established quality standards and standard operating procedures.
  • Participates in audit preparation and regulatory reviews as needed.

Participant Recruitment & Engagement

  • Assists with the recruitment, screening, enrollment, and retention of research participants.
  • Conducts participant outreach and coordinates study-related communications throughout the research lifecycle.
  • Evaluates participant eligibility and supports the informed consent process according to protocol requirements.
  • Schedules study visits, procedures, and follow-up activities while maintaining compliance with study timelines.
  • Serves as a point of contact for participants and responds to study-related questions and concerns.
  • Demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and cultural sensitivity when interacting with diverse patient populations.

Clinical Research Support

  • Completes and maintains study-related documentation, surveys, case report forms, and source documents.
  • Collects, processes, and tracks biological specimens such as blood, urine, and other research samples according to protocol requirements.
  • Assists investigators and study teams with study implementation and participant monitoring.
  • Supports collection, abstraction, and entry of clinical and research data into study databases and electronic data capture systems.
  • Coordinates with clinical departments, laboratories, and research teams to facilitate study activities and ensure timely completion of project deliverables.

Project Coordination & Administration

  • Organizes and maintains study files, regulatory binders, participant records, and study materials.
  • Utilizes study-specific databases and tracking systems to monitor participant activity, specimen management, and study progress.
  • Assists with investigator meetings, sponsor communications, and project-related administrative activities.
  • Supports training and onboarding of new research staff on study procedures and research operations.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure effective study execution and compliance with protocol requirements.

Data Management & Quality Assurance

  • Maintains accurate research databases and study records.
  • Reviews data for completeness and quality, identifying and resolving discrepancies when appropriate.
  • Assists with generation of reports and tracking metrics related to study performance and participant enrollment.
  • Remains current on research regulations, industry standards, and best practices in clinical research.

Option 1

  • High School Diploma or G.E.D.
  • Three (3) years of professional work experience, including at least two (2) years of research and/or healthcare experience.

Option 2

  • Associate's Degree in a healthcare, science, research, or related field.
  • One (1) year of research and/or healthcare experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating clinical or human subject research studies.
  • Knowledge of research regulations, GCP, HIPAA, and informed consent requirements.
  • Experience collecting and processing biological specimens.
  • Familiarity with electronic data capture (EDC) systems and research databases.
  • Healthcare, hospital, emergency department, or academic research experience.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Experience working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and diverse patient populations.

What We Offer

Join a team where you can grow your career, collaborate with dedicated professionals, and engage in mission-driven work that makes a difference. We provide opportunities for continuous learning and development in a supportive and innovative environment.

Join Our Team

Ready to make an impact? Apply now and be part of our mission to advance healthcare through research and exceptional care.

title: Head of Mission Operations & Ground Segment
description:
At ClearSpace, we believe in reusability, in affordability driving disruption, and that no progress is real unless it is sustainable.


Our company was founded in 2018 out of the realization that in-orbit servicing and space debris removal are vital services for the future of space exploration and operations. Today ClearSpace has assembled an expert engineering team and is leading the way toward sustainable space operations. From a garage in Switzerland, we now operate across UK and Europe, and are working with world-leading institutions and companies to bring our dream of a sustainable space ecosystem to life.



ClearSpace is on a mission to make space sustainable - by developing the world's first active debris removal service. At ClearSpace, Mission Operations and Ground Segment are strategic capabilities that shape mission design from the earliest phases and enable safe, reliable and efficient execution in orbit. We are seeking an exceptional Head of Mission Operations & Ground Segment to own and drive ClearSpace's end-to-end operational and ground segment strategy: building the organisation, defining the roadmap, delivering the infrastructure and operational readiness, and ensuring our missions can be commissioned, operated and supported safely throughout their lifecycle.


Role Purpose/Summary

Reporting to the CTO, the Head of Mission Operations & Ground Segment will own the Mission Operations and Ground Segment functions across ClearSpace's programmes - from early mission definition and concept of operations through launch preparation, commissioning, routine operations, critical RPO phases and end-of-life disposal. You will build and lead a world-class team, establish the architecture, processes and governance required to scale, and serve as the primary interface across System Architecture, Engineering, AIV/AIT, Programme Management, Quality, Security, customers and external service providers.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Embed operations and ground segment considerations from the earliest mission phases: shape mission architectures, operational concepts, autonomy strategies, fault-management concepts and spacecraft design using operational evidence, simulations and representative end-to-end testing
  • Define, own and evolve the ClearSpace Operations & Ground Segment roadmap, establishing the long-term vision, capability development plan and organisation required to support multiple concurrent missions
  • Build, lead and develop the organisation across two areas of capability: Mission Operations and Ground Segment; participate in recruitment, define roles and accountabilities, set objectives, develop talent and conduct performance reviews
  • Own the end-to-end operational lifecycle across all programmes, including mission analysis inputs, CONOPS, operational requirements, procedures, flight rules, staffing concepts, rehearsals, launch and early orbit phase, commissioning, routine operations, contingency operations and disposal
  • Own the Ground Segment architecture and delivery strategy, including mission control systems, flight dynamics, ground station services, communications networks, data processing, operational databases, simulators, security, monitoring and interfaces with customer or partner infrastructure
  • Establish and maintain operational readiness governance: define readiness criteria and evidence; lead operational reviews, simulations and rehearsals; ensure procedures, teams, facilities and systems are qualified and ready before each critical mission phase
  • Ensure safe execution of rendezvous and proximity operations and other safety-critical activities by establishing robust command authority, flight rules, collision-avoidance logic, escalation paths, contingency procedures and real-time decision-making processes
  • Serve as the primary Operations & Ground Segment interface with Engineering, AIV/AIT, Programme Management, Quality, Security, customers, agencies, launch providers and ground service suppliers; assess operational feasibility and cost of contractual commitments before contract signature and contribute to proposals and tender responses
  • Manage the make-or-buy strategy and supplier performance for ground segment products and services; own capacity planning and the relevant CAPEX/OPEX budgets while ensuring resilience, cybersecurity, configuration control and service continuity
  • Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence through automation, standardisation, lessons learned, reusable products and common processes; establish metrics for readiness, availability, reliability, response time, workload and mission performance


Must have:

  • Degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a closely related discipline; an advanced degree or Chartered Engineer (CEng) status is advantageous
  • 10+ years of experience in spacecraft mission operations and/or ground segment engineering in the space industry, with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role
  • Proven experience taking a mission from early definition through operational readiness, launch, commissioning and routine in-orbit operations
  • Demonstrated experience defining CONOPS, operational requirements, procedures, flight rules, simulations, rehearsals and readiness evidence for complex or safety-critical spacecraft missions
  • Strong knowledge of ground segment architectures, mission control systems, flight dynamics systems, ground station networks, TT&C, secure communications, data handling and spacecraft simulators
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external suppliers in a multi-programme environment, including resource planning, schedules, risks, budgets and service-level performance
  • Solid knowledge of applicable ECSS standards, space operations best practices, configuration and change control, cybersecurity principles and quality management systems; experience presenting to customers, agencies and senior leadership


Nice to have:

  • Experience in active debris removal, in-orbit servicing, rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO), space domain awareness, formation flying or other autonomous and safety-critical in-space missions
  • Experience designing or operating highly automated, lights-out or multi-mission control centres; familiarity with cloud-based ground systems, DevSecOps, operational data analytics and digital twins
  • Familiarity with NewSpace development approaches, small satellite platforms and agile programme management; experience building an operations capability in a scale-up environment is a strong advantage

title: Senior Product Manager – Robotics Software Platform
description:
Join the Zivid team!

Zivid is one of Norway's most ambitious technology companies, building the 3D vision and motion-planning software that give robots human-like sight and judgment. Our Zivid 2+ and Zivid 3 cameras deliver industry-leading accuracy, even on black, shiny, or transparent objects, and with Zivid Motion, our real-time, collision-aware motion-planning software, we're one of very few companies in the world delivering vision and motion together as a single platform. We serve the global robotics and automation market from six countries with 100+ employees and a global customer base.


We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own our robotics software platform and shape where it goes next.


JOB DESCRIPTION
Why this role exists: to turn Zivid Motion and our software into a platform that robot builders choose alongside our cameras.

You own Zivid Motion from day one, and you shape where the platform goes next: what we build, how it fits with our cameras and SDK, and how we position and price it. This is a zero-to-one role. The platform strategy is still taking shape, and you will define it together with our VP of Product and our technical leadership. You will also be a senior voice in a small, cross-functional Product team.


SCOPE

  • Own Zivid Motion end to end: roadmap, priorities, releases and customer feedback.
  • Define the platform: how motion planning, perception software and our cameras come together as one platform that integrators and robot builders build on.
  • Set the positioning, packaging and pricing model for our software.
  • Work closely with strategic customers to find the problems worth solving, and turn them into clear requirements for our engineering teams.
  • Work with the teams behind our SDK, vision system software and data infrastructure so the platform holds together.
  • Bring the platform to market with sales and marketing: launches, enablement and the story we tell.
  • Take part in leading the product team, and step in on other areas, such as our SDK, when needed.

The role reports to the VP of Product.


OUTCOMES FOR THE FIRST 12 MONTHS

You'll be evaluated on these outcomes, not on hours logged or activities completed.

  • Zivid Motion: A clear roadmap and release plan that you own, and that customers and sales understand.
  • Platform strategy: A written strategy for how out software platform and our cameras fit together, including packaging and pricing, agreed with leadership.
  • Voice of the customer: Your priorities are backed by evidence from strategic customers, not assumptions.
  • Shipped software: New Zivid Motion releases are in customers' hands, and the first platform capabilities are in development.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must-have

  • Credibility with both engineers and customers: you can go deep on the technical details with engineering, and explain what matters to customers and sales.
  • You can build something new from messy evidence: you find the signal in conflicting customer input, decide what to build (and what not to), and get a first version into customers' hands, whether a new product or a major new capability in an existing one.
  • A feel for developer products: you know what makes developers choose a product and stay with it, and you use their feedback to shape it.
  • The ability to get engineering, marketing, sales and customer success to deliver together, and keep it on track when dates or scope shift.
  • A structured, hands-on approach that keeps the many moving parts of a platform in good shape at once.

Nice-to-have

  • A background in robotics, perception, computer vision or edge AI.


WHAT'S HARD ABOUT THIS ROLE

The platform strategy isn't finished. You'll shape it while delivering on Zivid Motion, so you need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many customers know Zivid as a camera company, so part of the job is building the case for software, both with customers and inside Zivid. The role spans from deeply technical work with engineering to working directly with customers, and you need to be credible at both ends. And because we're a small, hands-on product team, you do the work yourself, from customer calls and pricing to release notes. If you want a mature roadmap to run, this isn't that role. If you want to build a platform from zero, it is.


WE OFFER

  • A pivotal role building a software platform in a fast-growing scale-up
  • Significant autonomy and career development opportunities
  • Exposure to cutting-edge 3D vision and robotics technology
  • Competitive compensation package, including sign-on stock options, competitive pension scheme and premium health insurance plan


OTHER DETAILS

Location: Oslo (Nydalen), Norway. This is an on-site position. We support relocation, visa application and language courses for employees moving to Norway.

Travel: The role includes regular travel to visit customers.

Application deadline: We encourage applications as soon as possible, but no later than November 30, 2026.

Start date: As soon as possible, subject to mutual agreement.



The official language of the company is English.



If you have specific questions about the position, they will be answered by Stian Lind Petlund, stian.petlund@zivid.com.

title: OT Network Engineer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

OT NETWORK ENGINEER

SpaceX is looking for an Operational Technology (OT) Network Engineer with experience in routing, switching, and wireless in industrial network environments. This employee will be a member of the IT Network Engineering team, which is responsible for maintaining a stable, reliable, and diverse network. This network supports the design, manufacturing, and launching of rockets, spacecraft, satellites, and human spaceflight. This position will design and support industrial and OT networks for production, test, site operations, and live data center build environments. The ideal candidate will be a great communicator, able to document work in a ticketing system, excel at multi-tasking, resolve issues to prevent failures, and enjoy a fast-paced high-tech environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and implement highly available networks, balancing routing and redundancy for production, test, and site requirements.
  • Design and validate resilient, scalable multi-site OT network topologies for critical facilities.
  • Evaluate, procure, and deploy network hardware: switches, firewalls, multiplexing, and SD-WAN appliances.
  • Develop and contribute to network automation tooling, including configuration analysis and scalable deployment.
  • Plan and coordinate network outage windows with stakeholders for software updates, hardware refreshes, and maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network issues. Publish root-cause analysis and host retrospective reviews.
  • Provide networking support during launch and test campaigns, including on-call or real-time support as the networking responsible engineer.
  • Tune network monitoring for operational telemetry and issue detection before impact.
  • Create and update network documentation: architecture overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures.
  • Work with cross-functional teams on network designs, including failure modes and redundancy.
  • Perform job walks with customers, vendors, and contractors to gather requirements and create implementation plans.
  • Segment industrial networks from campus and corporate networks. Maintain controls-network segmentation.
  • Author system and network architecture drawings, IP/VLAN schemes, and data flow diagrams.
  • Support on-site deployment, physical network cutovers, and new site commissioning.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional network engineering experience; OR 5+ years of professional network engineering experience and high school diploma or equivalency certificate in lieu of a degree.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Industrial, utility, or operational technology network engineering experience.
  • Understanding of the OSI model and network standards.
  • Cisco, Arista, and Juniper data center-class switches.
  • Wave Division Multiplexing (WDM) and fiber optics infrastructure.
  • Enterprise and media protocols.
  • Switch port security features, network segmentation, QoS, multicast, and redundancy protocols.
  • Network monitoring tools and layer-1 testing tools.
  • Scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Linux and Windows system administration.
  • GitOps and infrastructure as code, as a user and as a contributor.
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 design, deployment, and troubleshooting in latency-sensitive or industrial environments.
  • Functional experience with multiple network vendors in production or lab environments.
  • Hands-on configuration of managed industrial switches and routers.
  • Real-time systems, industrial control networks, or OT environments in aerospace, defense, energy, oil and gas, or similar high-reliability industries.
  • Industry-standard certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIS, or JNCIP.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.
  • Must have a valid driver's license.
  • Ability to lift heavy objects up to 35 lbs. unassisted.
  • Ability to provide 24x7 on-call support in emergency situations and participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.
  • Willingness to occasionally travel to other sites to support new company initiatives.

title: Web Developer
description:

* * *


CACI is seeking a Web Developer to help modernize and enhance a portfolio of 100+ web applications supporting a government customer. You’ll solve technical challenges across the development lifecycle using C#/.NET, JavaScript, SQL, and AWS while collaborating with fellow developers on code reviews, troubleshooting, and design decisions. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of development tasks, improve existing applications, explore cloud technologies, and apply AI-assisted tools to streamline coding, testing, and documentation while building reliable, maintainable software as part of a collaborative team.
Responsibilities
• Design, develop, enhance, test, and maintain web-based applications, including custom, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS), and government off-the-shelf (GOTS) solutions.

Qualifications
Required:
• Candidate must be a U.S. citizen.
• Minimum of four (4) years of relevant web development or software development experience.
• Demonstrated experience developing, enhancing, testing, and supporting web applications using HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, C#/.NET, and Bootstrap.
• Strong knowledge of SQL, web development principles, software-development practices, coding standards, and application security.
• Ability to analyze technical issues, evaluate impacts and dependencies, and develop effective solutions with minimal supervision.

Desired:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• AWS certification, such as AWS Certified Developer – Associate or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional.
• Experience working with SOAP and Restful webservices.
• Experience developing software with Python.
• Experience contributing to application architecture, system integration, modernization, or cloud-migration efforts.
• Experience with containerized or serverless applications and AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, RDS, or CloudWatch.
• Familiarity with Agile software-development methodologies and practices.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools.
• Experience supporting applications in government, Department of Defense (DoD), or Intelligence Community (IC) environments.
• Experience developing responsive, accessible web applications and applying Section 508 requirements.
• CompTIA Security+ certification.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About us:


We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to be a part of the DEVTALENTS team and contribute to the development of truly amazing solutions for businesses all over the world.

We support continuous growth, encouraging you to step beyond your comfort zone and develop technically and personally. We are looking for an experienced Senior Java Developer to join our team and provide technical leadership and mentorship.



Your Role:

  • Take ownership of end-to-end feature development, from design to deployment.

  • Make well-informed design decisions to ensure scalability, performance, security, and adherence to best practices.

  • Lead efforts in implementing and refining our microservices architecture, focusing on system integration and high availability.

  • Drive continuous improvement through code reviews, mentorship, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

  • Utilize data and user insights to inform technical strategies and deliver robust, high-quality solutions.

  • Proactively identify opportunities for enhancements, optimizations, and quality improvements across the stack.


Technical Expertise:

  • Proficiency in Java (version 17+), 6+ years of commercial experience.

  • Expert-level experience with the Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC), and Hibernate/JPA for ORM. Familiarity with Spring Security and other modern Java frameworks is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and containerization technologies, as well as CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab). Experience with Kubernetes and best practices in CI/CD is a bonus.

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational databases. Exposure to NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, and database performance tuning is advantageous.

  • Proficiency with JUnit, Mockito, and integration testing tools. Knowledge of performance testing and test automation frameworks is beneficial.

  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and microservices architecture. Understanding of DevOps tools (Terraform or CDK) and monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, Datadog, Sentry) is a nice-to-have.

  • Proven track record in designing scalable, microservices-based systems. Familiarity with distributed systems, high-availability designs, and event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ) is highly valued.

  • Higher education with a profile in Computer Science or related

Additional Skills:

  • Understanding of security best practices for Java applications and cloud environments.

  • Familiarity with authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT).

  • Knowledge of API design (RESTful or GraphQL) and container orchestration tools (Kubernetes).


Mindset & Approach:

  • Passion for continuous learning, tackling complex challenges, and driving innovation.

  • A collaborative spirit that thrives in cross-functional, agile teams.

  • Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A mentor who supports and elevates mid-level and junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.


What We Offer:

  • Significant impact on product development and architectural decisions.

  • A growth-oriented environment that encourages stepping out of your comfort zone, experimenting with new technologies, and advancing your technical expertise.

  • Ongoing training, workshops, and opportunities to stay at the cutting edge of technology.

Ideas Creation – Fundamental

title: Deputy Director of Operation & Maintenance
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Serves as a member of the executive leadership team and assists in directing wastewater treatment plants and collection system activities to ensure efficient operations and compliance with regulatory requirements and continuous improvement of operational and maintenance practices. Oversees the administration, planning, direction and coordination of any combination of the following departments: Southerly Wastewater Treatment Center including the Renewable Energy Facility, Easterly Wastewater Treatment Plant, Westerly Wastewater Treatment Center, Maintenance Services including the operation and maintenance of the collection system and all supporting departments, Process Control and Automation and Emergency Management. Oversees department budgets, hiring, performance management and other senior level duties. Performs other duties of a similar nature as may be required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

- Develops and oversees efforts related to the operation and maintenance of the Sewer District’s wastewater treatment plants, collection system and auxiliary facilities.

- Contributes to the development of the Sewer District’s strategic goals and objectives. Uses the organizational goals and objectives to assist in setting the department’s strategic direction that balances long-term goals with day-to-day organizational objectives and activities.

- Defines department goals and assists management with prioritizing resource utilization to accomplish tasks. Supports the development, tracking and reporting of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and the evaluation of progress against goals and targets. Establishes performance standards and operational plans to ensure regulatory compliance and safety

- Oversees the development of operating and minor capital budgets and ensures adherence. Provides guidance to ensure short and long-term planning meet necessary budget requirements. Recommends capital expenditures, materials and equipment purchases that comply with purchasing requirements.

- Critically examines information to assess feasibility, evaluate alternatives, review efficiency and identify data patterns or trends to improve efficiency of the operation and maintenance processes. Diagnoses problems and evaluates the quality of collection and wastewater treatment. Conducts research to explore new ideas and methods.

- Monitors wastewater industry information and trends and works to develop new and/or improved systems and processes. Identifies solutions to improve efficiency and safety, adapting business processes as necessary. Leads teams and assists leadership in the implementation of change management.

- Facilitates a culture of teamwork and provides resolutions for staff issues. Conducts annual performance reviews and sets performance goals for departments and individuals. Supports talent development efforts and participates in succession planning that seeks to align current and future organizational needs. Makes staffing recommendations in support of organizational needs and career path implementation. Holds grievance hearings, issues findings as required by union contracts and conducts disciplinary hearings.

- Assists with writing and implementing policies and procedures that ensure effective operations, maintenance and administrative functions that align with operational needs, legal and regulatory requirements and financial plans.

- Builds cross-functional relationships to support continuous improvement of operational and maintenance processes. Works collaboratively across all Sewer District departments to achieve performance targets.

- Facilitates coordination and collaboration with Engineering & Construction (E&C) on planning, design, construction and commissioning of capital improvement projects to ensure operational and maintenance needs are met.

- Serves in various roles within the Sewer District’s incident command structure during large-scale emergencies. Oversees emergency responses and serves as incident commander of those emergencies when necessary. Provides guidance for emergency response plans and participates in and develops crisis response drills.

- Develops and maintains partnerships with external organizations, regulatory agencies and other governmental agencies. Serves as a Sewer District representative in national, community and trade meetings.

- Performs other duties of a similar nature as may be required.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION

- Candidate must possess a bachelor’s degree preferably in Business Administration, Environmental Science, Natural Science, Engineering or a closely related field.

EXPERIENCE

- Candidate must possess eight (8) years of progressive responsibility in operating, maintaining and/or managing a utility, manufacturing facility or similar operation. Experience must include managing budgets and cultural change, implementing process improvements and efficiency initiatives and working with general public, agencies, communities and other external organizations.

- Experience must include five (5) years of supervising, managing and/or leading people, projects and/or processes.

- Previous wastewater collection and/or treatment operation and maintenance experience preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

LICENSURE AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Candidate must possess a valid driver’s license with a driving record in accordance with the Sewer District’s acceptable guidelines.

- Possession of an Ohio EPA Class II Wastewater or Collection System Operator certificate preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

- Candidate must possess knowledge of operating large-scale utilities or industrial facilities, strategic planning and implementation, and operation and maintenance administration. Knowledge of wastewater treatment applications, methods and practices is preferred.

- Candidate must possess effective written and verbal communication, organizational skills and decision-making abilities.

- Candidate must possess ability to manage projects, meet deadlines and tackle emergencies and difficult situations.

- Candidate must possess negotiation, conflict resolution and problem-solving skills to address issues and opportunities for improvement.

- Candidate must possess the ability to effectively plan, coordinate, establish and maintain effective working relationships and prioritize workloads based on available resources.

- Candidate must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.

- Candidate must possess strong team leadership and people management skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

During the course of performing the essential functions of this position, the employee must be able to analyze, communicate, comprehend, coordinate, make decisions, possess general intelligence, interact, interpret, negotiate, possess numerical intelligence, organize, problem solve, have resilience and perform tasks. Physical work will need to be performed, such as driving, reaching, sitting, standing, talking, typing and walking. Repetitive movements will need to be performed such as simple grasping with one hand. Ability to lift from floor to waist, waist to shoulder or floor to shoulder up to 10 lbs. on an occasional basis may be necessary. Position will require visual demands of accommodation, depth perception, far acuity and near acuity. Ability to withstand faint to moderate noise exposure for fifteen minutes or longer on an intermittent basis is required. Exposure to environmental conditions such as outdoor work is encountered in this position.

title: Director Adjunct de Magazin JYSK Craiova
description:
Esti pregatit/a sa motivezi si sa coordonezi o echipa alaturi de Directorul de Magazin? Si sa te asiguri ca echipa ta are cea mai buna atitudine de vanzari si ofera clientilor nostri o experienta extraordinara la cumparaturi?

Atunci tu poti fi Directorul Adjunct de Magazin (f/m) pe care il cautam!

CE ITI OFERIM

Ai posibilitatea sa te alaturi unei companii de retail care isi doreste sa fie prima alegere a angajatilor in retail. Noi avem un mediu dinamic unde ideile tale sunt ascultate si esti implicat. Noi consideram dezvoltarea ta ca fiind extrem de importanta. Ca Director Adjunct in pregatire pentru Director de Magazin vei avea parte de urmatoarele: De un program de training format din cinci saptamani de pregatire interactiva in toate ariile de care ai nevoie pentru a conduce un magazin JYSK, desfasurat pe o perioada de aproximativ 1 an. Vei avea traineri profesionisti din retail si resurse umane care te vor pregati pe tot parcursul programului. In timpul desfasurarii programului vei fi angajat ca Director Adjunct de Magazin si vei lucra in magazinul nostru din Craiova, JYSK Electroputere.

In plus, ca Ambasador JYSK vei avea parte de urmatoarele:

  • Oportunitati pentru propria dezvoltare si responsabilitate – ne propunem sa promovam intern 80% dintre manageri. Afla mai multe aici.
  • Concursuri interne intre magazine si bonusuri pe masura
  • Iesiri bianuale impreuna cu echipa
  • Bonus competitiv care rasplateste vanzarile si rezultatele extraordinare
  • Un program de lucru flexibil
  • 20% reducere la produsele JYSK si la produsele din grupul Lars Larsen
  • Tichete de masa, tichete de vacanta acordate in functie de vechime, asigurare medicala, bonus aniversar, petrecere anuala pentru toti angajatii
  • Zile de concediu in plus: dupa 3 ani - 23 zile, dupa 5 ani - 25 de zile, dupa 7 ani - 27 de zile

CE VEI FACE LA NOUL TAU JOB

Vrei sa inveti si sa te dezvolti? Esti pregatit sa iti incepi cariera intr-unul dintre cele mai bune programe de training din Romania in retail? Iti doresti sa ai posibilitatea de a coordona propriul magazin in 1-2 ani? Esti pregatit sa motivezi si sa coordonezi o echipa alaturi de Directorul de Magazin? Si sa te asiguri ca echipa ta are cea mai buna atitudine de vanzari si ofera clientilor nostri o experienta extraordinara la cumparaturi? Daca ai raspuns cu DA la intrebarile de mai sus, atunci TU esti Directorul Adjunct de Magazin pe care il cautam pentru a-l pregati sa intre in programul de dezvoltare - Director de Magazin in Training la JYSK in Bucuresti!

Cunoaste un Director Adjunct de Magazin si afla mai multe despre cum suntem noi ca angajator aici.

CE CAUTAM LA TINE

  • Ai experienta in a invata, motiva si dezvolta o echipa
  • Esti deschis la mobilitate pe o raza de 50 km in zona Craiova
  • Esti pozitiv si ii inspiri si pe ceilalti din jurul tau, creand astfel o atmosfera placuta in mediul in care lucrezi
  • Esti dispus sa iti asumi responsabilitatea de a oferi un serviciu excelent clientilor si de a obtine vanzari extraordinare
  • Intotdeauna te straduiesti sa iti imbunatatesti rezultatele
  • Esti capabil sa iti finalizezi sarcinile: iti pastrezi calmul in situatii stresante si poti coordona echipa pentru a atinge obiectivele stabilite
  • Esti incantat sa vinzi si ai abilitati extraordinare in vanzari
  • Te bucuri de timpul liber din timpul saptamanii si esti pregatit pentru clientii care isi fac cumparaturile in week-end.

ESTE ACEST JOB O OPORTUNITATE PENTRU TINE? Aplica acum!

Procesul de recrutare in Romania:

Toate aplicatiile sunt procesate de catre echipa de recrutare sau de catre manageri. Vei primi feedback despre procesul de recrutare pe adresa de e-mail sau la numarul de telefon cu care ai aplicat.

DESPRE NOI

Credem ca angajatii nostri sunt cheia succesului nostru. De aceea, ne straduim sa oferim oportunitati de dezvoltare, crestere si noi provocari in cadrul JYSK. Inca de cand fondatorul nostru, Lars Larsen, a deschis primul magazin in Danemarca, in 1979, JYSK si-a extins prezenta globala prin magazine fizice si online in intreaga lume.

Cele trei valori fundamentale ale JYSK – Bun Comerciant, Bun Coleg si Spirit Corporatist – exprima comportamentul si atitudinea la care ne asteptam sa le avem unii fata de altii. Avem incredere unii in altii si credem ca in JYSK ai parte de sustinere si incredere, dar si de libertate cu responsabilitate.

De asemenea, suntem mandri sa recompensam implicarea si efortul deosebit al angajatilor nostri. Cu atitudinea potrivita, oportunitatile sunt nelimitate in JYSK.

JYSK accepta pe toata lumea, indiferent de varsta, identitate de gen, rasa, orientare sexuala, etnie si experienta. Impreuna, ne asiguram ca avem o cultura incluziva care incurajeaza, sprijina si celebreaza vocile diverse ale angajatilor nostri. Pentru ca mai multe talente si personalitati unice ne ajuta sa formam o echipa mai puternica.

Pentru mai multe informatii, te rog sa intri pe pagina noastra de cariere.

Pentru a ne ajuta sa evaluam aplicatiile in mod corect si eficient, folosim un sistem automatizat care verifica si decide cat de bine se potriveste fiecare aplicatie cu rolul disponibil.
Acest sistem analizeaza raspunsurile oferite de tine la cateva intrebari pe care le folosim pentru a evalua aplicatia ta. Aceste intrebari au fost create de sistem si revizuite de echipa Talent Acquisition JYSK, iar fiecare intrebare si raspuns are o anumita valoare. Pe baza raspunsurilor tale, sistemul face o clasificare a candidatilor pentru a putea vedea cat de bine se potriveste profilul tau cu jobul nostru disponibil.
Acest lucru ne ajuta sa gestionam toate aplicatiile si sa ne asiguram ca toata lumea este tratata in mod egal. Rezultatul generat de sistem stabileste daca aplicatia ta trece la urmatoarea etapa. Dar nu iti face griji — decizia finala este intotdeauna luata de o persoana.

Daca doresti sa afli mai multe despre modul in care procesam datele tale personale si despre drepturile tale, te rugam sa consulti Politica de confidentialitate.

title: Birmingham Area – Job Pool
description:
WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, not just juice, sandwiches, coffee, and much more. When joining us, you step into a high-energy community where the music is loud, the bar is your stage, and your personality matters as much as your skills.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

  • Positive Attitude
  • Inclusion
  • Social Ties
  • Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new — you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you’ll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing, move through a clear Moneyball career path, and be part of a company where most leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!).

If you love fast-paced service, music, people, and the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that can take you across cities, countries, and roles.

THIS IS A TALENT POOL, NOT A JOB OPENING

We're not hiring for a specific store right now. By applying here, you're joining our Juicer talent pool, so you're first in line when a spot opens near you. If and when the right opportunity comes up, we'll reach out. No promises on timing, and no need to wait by the phone, but your application stays with us and we'll come back to you when there's a match.

STORES IN THIS POOL

This pool covers the stores below. When a Juicer position opens in any of them, you'll be among the first we reach out to.

  • 26-28 Colmore Row
  • Birmingham Bullring
  • Birmingham Grand Central John Lewis

JOB SUMMARY

As a Juicer at JOE & THE JUICE, your primary responsibilities are guest service and preparing food, juices, coffee, and sandwiches. You'll help ensure the bar always looks clean, welcoming, and ready for our guests. You'll report to your Store Manager, and as part of the team, your tasks may evolve alongside the store's needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Make every guest feel welcome and taken care of, from the moment they walk in.
  • Every juice, sandwich, and coffee we make follows a product manual, but there's one ingredient that's the same across all of them: it tastes better made with passion.
  • Keep your station and the bar spotless, because a clean bar is part of the experience too.

WHO YOU ARE

Behind every bar, on every shift, there's a Juicer who shows up with energy and makes someone's day a little brighter. That's the standard here, not one person doing it well, but all of us doing it together.

  • You show up with a "happy to be here" attitude, and you help build it, shift after shift, for the people around you.
  • You treat your teammates like family and your guests like they matter, because they do.
  • You're humble enough to learn, honest enough to be trusted.
  • You take pride in the work, even when no one's watching.
  • You're not here because a juice bar is going to change your life. Or maybe it will, most of our leaders started exactly where you're standing now. You're here because you're always looking to add one more tool to your toolbox, and this happens to be a place where you can find more than a few.

If that sounds like you, you're already one of us. Come prove it.

GOOD TO KNOW

  • How the pool works: Submit your application and we'll keep it on file. When a Juicer position opens near you, we reach out to people in the pool first.
  • No prior experience needed. Bring the right attitude and we'll teach you the rest.
  • Show up on time and looking sharp, it's part of respecting your team and your guests.
  • We'll walk you through our policies and procedures as part of onboarding, so you're never left guessing.

ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

JOE & THE JUICE is a healthy fast-casual concept founded in Copenhagen in 2002; since then, we have grown to more than 500 locations across 20 countries and now employ more than 4,500 people worldwide. From day one, our ambition has been to prove that there should be no trade-off between taste and health.

We serve high-quality, freshly prepared juices, shakes, coffee, and sandwiches in relaxed, contemporary concept cafés that combine convenience with distinct urban atmospheres. JOE & THE JUICE goes beyond products towards the full experience around the bar, creating a consistent universe for guests and Juicers in all our locations.

We invest heavily in internal development through our Moneyball career system and a culture where most leaders, including C-suite, VPs, and directors, have started behind the bar. We continue to evolve our people-centric and sustainability agenda that is part of our Nordic heritage and our commitment to a better future.

title: Manager - Finance Operations
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager, Finance Operations.

Purpose of the role

The role is responsible to assist the users by addressing their finance queries and resolving their issues in a timely manner. The role holder should also perform routine maintenance activities to maintain the reference data, perform month end opening and close activities, actively work on clearing the accounting/reporting exceptions and rejects ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. The role holder should also collaborate closely with the change team to facilitate a smooth transition of activities from project phases to BAU operations. Also to ensure the uninterrupted operation of systems by proactively managing and resolving incidents.

In this role, you will:

  • Exercise oversight on General ledger and/or FR Consolidation functionalities and its usage in alignment with organisational protocols. Monitor and evaluate performance metrics to ensure alignment with the target set as per the SLA/KPI.
  • Review, oversee, update/maintain the Process manuals and Standard Operating Processes. Oversee and analyse production system support tasks performed during Daily, Monthly, Quarterly and Year-end close.
  • Provide efficient and effective functional SME input for the Finance Operations supporting the line finance users and business partners. Manage production issues & resolution and communicate & escalate any challenges to Finance/Business Users, Regional IT teams in a timely manner.
  • Provide strategic oversight and guidance in Support activities including assisting in UAT of new enhancements, transition of changes from project to BAU and other advisory roles.
  • Coordination with IT and other pertinent upstream and downstream. Provide expert-level guidance and advisory oversight on the resolution of Complex User Queries. Facilitate strategic alignment Business & GFOC management with timely system updates.
  • Partnering with the Change team with various system updates and changes. Responsible for the coordination and governance of controls used in the system.
  • Conceives Idea and spread awareness in respect of implementing various automation tools to reduce manual efforts. Participate in testing and support end users for UAT / Go-Live approval identifying opportunities for process re-engineering/ improvements, drive changes independently with minimal directions.

To be successful you will:

  • MCA / BE / MBA / M Com. Qualified Accountant (Chartered, ACCA or CIMA) with overall 7-10 years’ work experience
  • 5+ years of experience of working on Finance Systems
  • Knowledge of General ledger and/or FR Consolidation systems is must. Knowledge of SOX and Audit Controls related to process management.
  • Update/maintain the Process manuals and Standard Operating Processes.
  • Ability to comprehend, interpret and transform huge volume of finance data.
  • Experience of Process Streamlining using automation tools (like Xceptor/PYTHON/Appian). Ability to quickly learn & understand the multiple ledger systems within FSO
  • Good understanding of multiple GL systems within HSBC - FTP, Fusion. HUB, PSGL & AssureNET(Cadency) and/or Consolidation systems e.g. Saracen including architecture and data flow. Demonstrates HSBC Values with utmost professionalism.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior Associate, OOH Solutions
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

In this role you will be responsible for the development of OOH and print campaigns across a variety of WPP Canada clients. We are seeking someone who has a point of view to drive holistic media plans that deliver results. This position work closely with senior management and agency partners to create and evaluate media strategies based on business goals and the competition.

Your Impact:

  • Day-to-day responsibility involving the planning of OOH and print campaigns
  • Present media plan recommendation and POV’s to planning teams
  • Oversee campaign management from initial campaign briefing through to post campaign reporting and analysis
  • Decision making on campaign optimization and strategic changes
  • Ensure media plans deliver on client objectives, are strategic and meet efficiency goals
  • Assist with tracking media expenditures to ensure agency and client budget compliance
  • Maintain strong relationships with agency planning teams/Manage client requests – i.e. plan changes, budget changes, provide marketplace information
  • Working closely with Associate Director and Manager
  • Mentor and train team's coordinator
  • Investigate industry news and information to further enhance knowledge of the media industry

Skills and Experience Your Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3+ years of related experience, traditional media planner, and in media, investment or strategy teams within an established media agency
  • University or College degree/diploma in Media, Marketing, Business, or related field; OR equivalent professional work experience
  • Experience working with a range of clients
  • Demonstrates a deep understanding of the OOH (digital, static and programmatic) and print landscape
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite

About You:

  • Demonstrates accuracy and attention to detail
  • Ability to communicate concisely and clearly both orally and in writing
  • Self-starter who demonstrates initiative
  • Ability to manage multiple projects
  • Ability to delegate and oversee Coordinator workload
  • Team player who can step in and help drive strategy against a landscape that is in constant change
  • Thrives in fast paced environment

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week.
