title: Housing Advice and Options Manager
description:
6 Month Contract With A Local Authority


Job Purpose

To lead and manage the Housing Advice and Options Service, ensuring the delivery of a high-quality homelessness prevention, assessment and housing advice service that reduces homelessness and minimises the use of temporary accommodation.

The postholder will be responsible for the strategic development, operational management and performance of the service, ensuring statutory homelessness duties are met in accordance with legislation, case law and best practice. The role will drive partnership working, service improvement and homelessness prevention initiatives, whilst providing expert advice to senior leaders and elected members on housing options and homelessness matters.



Key Responsibilities

Service Management & Leadership

  • Lead and manage the Housing Advice and Options Service.
  • Provide leadership and direction to:
    • 5 Team Leaders
    • 1 Senior Landlord Liaison Officer
    • 1 Reviews Officer
  • Ensure the service delivers high-quality housing advice and homelessness prevention outcomes.
  • Monitor service performance and ensure compliance with statutory duties.
  • Motivate, mentor and develop staff to achieve high standards of service delivery.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and customer-focused practice.

Homelessness Prevention & Housing Options

  • Ensure the Council fulfils its statutory responsibilities under homelessness legislation.
  • Oversee homelessness assessments, prevention and relief duties.
  • Ensure robust and timely triage of homelessness applications.
  • Promote upstream prevention activities to prevent homelessness at the earliest opportunity.
  • Support customers to access settled housing solutions and reduce reliance on temporary accommodation.
  • Ensure customers receive accurate housing advice based on their housing circumstances, eligibility and housing options.

Strategy, Policy & Service Development

  • Lead the development and implementation of the Homelessness and Rough Sleeping Strategy.
  • Develop and review housing advice, homelessness and related service policies.
  • Ensure policies and procedures remain compliant with legislation and best practice.
  • Contribute to wider directorate and corporate transformation programmes.
  • Develop innovative approaches to homelessness prevention and housing solutions.

Performance & Quality Assurance

  • Manage service performance, outcomes and KPI delivery.
  • Monitor homelessness trends and identify service improvement opportunities.
  • Oversee data collection, reporting and performance management frameworks.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for senior managers, leadership teams and elected members.
  • Ensure effective quality assurance and compliance processes are in place.

Partnership Working

  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with:
    • Housing Providers
    • Support Services
    • Voluntary Sector Organisations
    • Health Services
    • Adult Social Care
    • Children's Services
    • Statutory Agencies
  • Lead multi-agency approaches to homelessness prevention and housing support.
  • Ensure service level agreements, protocols and data-sharing arrangements are maintained and effective.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Manage service budgets and monitor expenditure.
  • Forecast financial pressures and implement corrective action where required.
  • Ensure value for money in service delivery and procurement activities.
  • Support funding applications, grant bids and associated projects.
  • Monitor commissioned services and partnership arrangements.

Governance & Strategic Advice

  • Provide specialist advice to:
    • Head of Housing Solutions
    • Assistant Director
    • Corporate Leadership Team
    • Councillors
  • Support strategic decision-making relating to homelessness and housing services.
  • Prepare committee reports and briefing papers.
  • Represent the service at meetings and governance forums.


Requirements

Essential

  • Degree-level qualification, relevant housing qualification or equivalent experience.
  • Detailed knowledge of:
    • Housing Act 1996
    • Homelessness Reduction Act 2017
    • Homelessness Legislation
    • Housing Allocations
    • Relevant Case Law and Statutory Guidance
  • Significant experience managing housing advice, homelessness or housing options services.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience managing budgets and financial resources.
  • Experience developing housing policies, strategies and service improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working with vulnerable individuals, families and homeless households.
  • Strong understanding of homelessness prevention and housing solutions.
  • Experience working effectively within political and financial constraints.
  • Excellent partnership working and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience producing reports and presentations for senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to think strategically and deliver operational outcomes.

Desirable

  • Chartered Institute of Housing (CIH) Membership.
  • CIH qualification.
  • Experience leading homelessness transformation programmes.
  • Experience managing grant-funded projects and funding bids.
  • Experience within a senior local authority housing management role.


Additional Information

  • Location: Kettering and/or Corby, North Northamptonshire
  • Hours Per Week: 35 Hours
  • Payment Frequency: Bi-Weekly Payments

· A proactive mindset and strong stakeholder management skills;

· A structured way of working and the confidence to make well-founded decisions;

· Experience with ERP systems and Microsoft Office;

· Strong communication skills in both Dutch and English, written and spoken;

· A Bachelor's degree or an equivalent HBO level of thinking and working.

Your daily responsibilities include

As an Outsourcing Engineer, you are responsible for managing product transfer projects for existing customers to other Neways locations, such as Neways Slovakia; Malaysia and Czech Republic. You are responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing these transfer projects from start to finish.

For each project, you build and lead a multidisciplinary team consisting of Manufacturing Engineers, Quality Engineers, Test Engineers, and Planners. You work closely with the receiving manufacturing sites and serve as the main point of contact for project progress, planning, production challenges, and quality-related matters.

You ensure effective communication and alignment between all stakeholders involved in the transfer project.

Your success is measured by ensuring products are transferred and manufactured according to customer specifications while achieving agreed Quality, Logistics, Technology and Cost (QLTC) objectives. You report to the Outsourcing Manager and are part of a team of 3 Outsourcing Engineers, 1 Manufacturing Quality Engineer (MQE) and 1 Supply Chain Engineer

Your key responsibilities further include

  • Leading product transfer projects within the Neways PMO project framework;

  • Assessing manufacturing readiness and ensuring receiving production sites are prepared for successful product transfers;

  • Managing product transfers through a structured transfer process, including BOM and routing analysis;

  • Identifying critical manufacturing processes and optimizing them together with the receiving production site;

  • Evaluating and implementing product changes in collaboration with Account Management and Manufacturing Engineering, including updates to work instructions;

  • Visiting international Neways manufacturing sites (approximately 5-10% of your time).

title: General Manager
description:
What you'll do...

  • Lead the pre-opening and post opening planning and execution phase, in collaboration with the corporate team, including the development of the Operating Budget, Marketing & Sales Plan, and Capital Budget, ensuring full alignment with brand and ownership expectations.
  • Fully own the commercial performance of the property, including P&L, revenue generation, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery of net operating income targets.
  • Establish, monitor, and manage annual budgets, ensuring accurate forecasting and alignment with financial goals, while maintaining control of labor and expense guidelines to optimize profitability.
  • Develop and execute strategic action plans to achieve or exceed revenue and profitability targets across all restaurant and bar outlets, ensuring strong commercial performance.
  • Play a key role in hiring decisions, ensuring the attraction, selection, training, and development of top talent, while building strong succession pipelines and team capability.
  • Establish priorities and lead key operational initiatives such as the preparation, presentation and subsequent achievement of the hotel's annual Operating Budget, Marketing & Sales Plan and Capital Budget.
  • Execute the highest brand standards across all operations, ensuring consistent quality of service, product excellence, and adherence to SOPs, including health, safety, and regulatory compliance.
  • Provide hands-on leadership to all Heads of Department, fostering a high-performance culture, strong team engagement, and consistent people management practices.
  • Foster strong collaboration with corporate and brand teams to ensure alignment on standards, strategy, and operational execution.
  • Champion continuous improvement initiatives across all operations to enhance efficiency, guest experience, and overall performance.
  • Oversee all quality evaluation processes and strive to improve all qualitative metrics.
  • Ensure full compliance with all applicable local laws and regulations, including liquor licensing, health, and sanitation standards.
  • Build and maintain a strong local presence for the property, strengthening community relationships and positioning the restaurant/hotel within the destination.
  • Oversee reporting processes, ensuring timely and accurate submission of payroll, revenue reports, schedules, forecasts, and operational action plans.
  • Serve as the central communication hub between guests, team members, ownership, brand representatives, and key external partners.
  • Be front-facing and high-touch with our guests, involved in handling guests throughout their journey and setting the example for the team to engage in excellent guest experience and recovery at every turn.
  • Work hand in hand with the Area General Manager and partner for anything strategy, financials, performance and more, related to the property.
  • Be a part of the evolution of Ennismore as it expands further in the Latin America and Americas region.

And everything else in-between…

What we're looking for...

  • You are an experienced General Manager, a commercially savvy operator and have prior experience in a similar role. A minimum of 4 years’ experience as a Hotel General Manager.
  • You have significant experience in high-end Lifestyle hotels ideally in Mexico or similar leisure markets.
  • You have experience leading successful openings, transitions and resort properties, and luxury & lifestyle properties where the experience is branded from beginning to end.
  • You are comfortable in the spotlight but always remain humble and kind.
  • You have a passion for hospitality, you inspire an enthusiastic guest-centered approach.
  • You can turn any situation around into a positive experience for all, guests and team alike.
  • You think big and encourage your team to believe.
  • You are comfortable with the strategic as well as day to day detail.
  • You are a natural at leading and managing others, and you lead by example, creating an environment where your team can be their best self.
  • You have an aptitude to perform numerical analysis of data and formulate conclusions and solutions.
  • You are able to easily identify and utilize emerging trends and technology to generate revenue.
  • You exhibit a professional attitude, diplomacy and an ability to handle difficult situations.
  • You are highly responsible, reliable and ethical. A reputation for honesty and integrity.
  • You get things done, independently and skilled at taking decisive action.
  • You’re a strong team leader, a natural at managing and inspiring others in a way that gets the best out of them.
  • You combine analytical and methodical thinking with high attention to detail and a solution-focused approach.
  • You make people feel good - your team, guests and colleagues alike. You make a positive impact.
  • You are an excellent relationship builder, confident in working with other teams and leaders; you’re passionate about what we can achieve together.

What's in it for you...

  • The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building scale globally.
  • The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
  • Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
  • Great discounts across the entire Ennismore family
  • A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.

title: Data Analytics Specialist
description:
Data Analytics Specialist

About Capco

Capco is a global technology and management consultancy specialising in financial services. We work with leading banks on data, technology, and transformation projects.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join an international project for a leading global bank.

The project focuses on data and regulatory reporting within the corporate clients segment.

You will work with large and complex datasets, analyse and transform data, investigate data quality issues, and collaborate closely with business and technical teams.

Experience within banking industry would be highly appreciated.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyse, transform, and validate large datasets using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
  • Investigate data quality issues and identify their root causes.
  • Develop and validate data transformations and ETL processes.
  • Work with data related to corporate clients, financial products, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, business analysts, and other stakeholders.
  • Use Git and GitHub for version control and team collaboration.
  • Document data mappings, transformation rules, and analytical findings.
  • Support data preparation for regulatory and management reporting.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience working as a Data Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, aggregations, and data validation.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, particularly Pandas.
  • Practical experience with PySpark and large-scale data processing.
  • Experience using Git and GitHub.
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets.
  • Understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, and data quality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and fluent English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in banking or financial services.
  • Understanding of ESG, regulatory reporting, SREP, or EBA reporting.
  • Knowledge of corporate banking, credit risk, or financial exposures.
  • Experience with Jupyter Notebook or Prophecy.

What We Offer

  • UoP contract
  • Hybrid working model.
  • Opportunity to work on an international banking project.
  • Access to modern data technologies.
  • Collaborative working environment and professional development opportunities.
  • Opportunity to develop knowledge of ESG and regulatory reporting.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter screening
  2. Capco technical interview
  3. Client interview

Location: Kraków or Warsaw - hybrid model, with office attendance depending on project needs.

title: Residential Supervisor
description:
The Residential Supervisor is responsible for providing instruction and support to their team of staff ensuring the health and safety of the persons served in their home, workplace and within the community. This individual is also responsible for the support, development, and engagement of their assigned team of staff of Trivium Life Services. The Residential Supervisor reports to the LTSS Manager or Market Director.


Essential Duties


This position includes, but is not limited to, the following essential functions:

  • Lead, as well as provide support and supervision to a team of assigned staff in support of persons served and ensure the implementation of their goals.
  • Establish high standards of conduct and job performance for the team, lead by example.
  • Build trust and partnership with employees to drive high performance, engagement, and a strong organizational culture.
  • Effectively assign, direct, control, evaluate performance, coach, and hold accountable assigned team.
  • Conduct effective staff and one-on-one employee meetings.
  • Develop and/or support the scheduling for direct care staff to ensure supports are available to persons served.
  • Communicate staff schedule needs/changes in a timely manner and arrange for replacements.
  • Ensure tracking and billing of direct service hours and ensure accuracy efficiency and cost effectiveness.
  • Assist in the hiring process and coordinate and conduct onboarding of new staff, as well as be involved in ongoing training opportunities in the form of regular staff and small group team meetings.
  • Maintain open communication channels and keep leadership aware of client and/or staff support needs.
  • Coordinate with direct care staff and ensure the scheduling of clients’ medical appointments, including transportation.
  • Supervise the area of medication management.
  • Practice compliance with employment law guidelines and mandates.
  • Oversee the execution of medication management plans.
  • Support staff in the implementation of behavioral plans.
  • Ensure timely documentation of client interactions and support interventions in the form of progress notes, incident reports, communication log, and other as needed and instructed by direct support staff.
  • Be responsive to and provide emergency intervention for all persons receiving supports.
  • Ensure clients receive assistance with social security including work incentives, wage reporting, benefit counseling, and assist with the management of personal finances (as needed and desired).
  • Ensure support for persons served in locating and securing adequate and desired housing options, including advocating on their behalf with landlords, assisting in arranging moving in/out of apartments, and supporting consumer’s desires to purchase their own homes.
  • Ensure assistance for persons served in applying for and maintaining low-income assistance such as housing support, food stamps, and energy assistance; and assist with reporting taxes or securing tax assistance.
  • Work a shift per an established schedule and be flexible to work outside the shift parameters based upon the needs of the business.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisory personnel.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Builds and develops internal and external relationships. creates partnerships, builds trust, share ideas, and accomplishes work.
  • Embrace change and sets goals that align with the company’s vision.
  • Encourages and inspires others through positivity, vision, confidence, challenges, and recognition.
  • Able to gather and evaluate information that leads to smart decisions.
  • Provide clear communication and share information regularly and concisely.
  • Hold themselves and their team accountable for their performance.
  • The ability to follow and lead by example the Company’s mission to empower individuals and to actively seek out opportunities for an enhanced quality of life.
  • Embrace the values and philosophy of Trivium Life Services.
  • Effectively direct and monitor the work of others.
  • Present oneself as a positive role model.
  • Ability to be flexible as to schedule and hours as the position requires.
  • Must be familiar with all HIPAA regulations and employ safeguards as directed by HIPAA laws and the Trivium Life Services Compliance Officer.
  • Must have a valid Chauffeur’s license (or equivalent) and maintain a driving record that is acceptable to Trivium Life Services auto insurance company.
  • Certification in First Aid and CPR.
  • Must secure and maintain a private phone.
  • Be committed to self-development

Physical Demands


While performing the responsibilities of the Residential Supervisor job, the employee is required to talk and hear. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

The employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers, to handle or feel and to manipulate keys on a keyboard. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Must be able to assist in transferring persons served using 1, 2, or 3 persons transfers as specified in each Person-Centered Plan. Vision abilities required by this job include close and distant vision.


Working Conditions


Working conditions are normal for an office environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate. Work will require weekend and/or evening work as needed. Occasional conditions will vary as it will be necessary to be in various locations, homes of persons served, their families and funding agencies. The employee must be able to travel between locations, and occasionally attend seminars which may require an overnight stay.

title: Magistrate-Family Division
description:
ELKHART COUNTY GOVERNMENTAL POSITION VACANCY NOTICE

MAGISTRATE-FAMILY DIVISION

DEPARTMENT: Elkhart County Judiciary

HIRING RANGE: Follows Indiana Judicial Salary Guidelines

BENEFITS OFFERED: Full State Benefits Offered

DATE TO BE FILLED: ASAP

HOURS & DAYS OF WORK: As Assigned

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: Within Elkhart County (Please complete the driving page on Application) State and National Conferences as required



LOCATION OF POSITION: Elkhart County Judicial Center


JOB SUMMARY:
Responsible for acting as an appointed magistrate for the family division. This position would preside over the following case types: Juvenile Paternity, Domestic Relations, Reciprocal Support, Adoptions, Guardianships, Protection Orders, Grandparent Visitation, Miscellaneous Civil, and at times, Juvenile CHINS, Juvenile Delinquency, Juvenile Status, Juvenile Miscellaneous, Juvenile Termination, and Juvenile Protection. Additionally, this position may conduct evidentiary hearings or bench. See: IC § 33-23-5.

Take and certify affidavits or depositions, order issuance of subpoenas, compel attendance of witnesses, punish contempt of court, issue warrants, set bail, and enforce court rules.

Report findings in evidentiary hearings or trials. Verify certificates for the authentication of records of a proceeding conducted by the magistrate.

Supervises and manages assigned court staff.

Performs related duties as assigned.

Role Purpose

The Corporate Senior Finance Performance Expert provides Group-level financial expertise and performance oversight across investment governance and property-related performance and cost management.

The role owns and develops financial governance, methodologies and analytical frameworks for CAPEX investments and Property Management, ensuring robust investment decisions, transparency of performance, effective cost control and consistent financial standards across the Group. It acts as a senior finance partner to business and functional stakeholders, translating financial and operational data into actionable insights and recommendations.

  • Support consistent application of investment evaluation methodologies and governance standards across the Group.

  • Establish consistent approaches for monitoring changes in business activities, facility footprint and related operational metrics over reporting periods.
  • Establish and maintain data collection processes, reporting standards and data maintenance procedures to ensure accurate and consistent Property Management reporting.
  • Monitor and analyse property-related costs, identifying trends, variances, inefficiencies and opportunities for cost optimisation.
  • Coordinate and support Property Management budgeting and forecasting processes, challenging assumptions and ensuring alignment with business plans and operational developments.
  • Analyse actual performance against budget and forecast, investigate significant deviations and identify potential corrective actions.
  • Define, develop and calculate Property Management KPIs to monitor operational efficiency, utilisation and financial performance.
  • Act as a senior finance partner to Property Management and operational stakeholders, providing financial insights, challenging assumptions and supporting informed decision-making.
  • Identify and support cost optimisation initiatives, assessing their financial impact, expected benefits and implications for operational performance.​

Our expectations:​

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Professional qualifications such as ACCA, CIMA, CPA, CFA or equivalent are advantageous.
  • 8+ years of experience in FP&A, Controlling, Investment Controlling, or Business Finance roles.
  • Strong knowledge of CAPEX governance, investment evaluation, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and cost and performance controlling.
  • Proven ability to independently review and challenge investment business cases, analyse financial and operational performance, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience in property-related financial controlling, cost optimisation, and working with senior stakeholders across complex corporate environments is highly desirable.
  • English knowledge B2 - Upper Intermediate.​

title: Data Analyst / BI Specialist
description:
An established food and beverage organisation based in Paarl is seeking an analytical professional to champion data transformation and modernise business reporting. Working within the Systems team on a full-time, hybrid schedule (incorporating one day per week on-site with core working hours and schedule flexibility), the appointed specialist will coordinate data initiatives across SQL architectures, ZAP BI environments, and emerging AI technologies. The position provides an avenue to engineer certified datasets, structure prompts and targets for AI agents, establish robust data governance guardrails, and advance technical skills in Python and enterprise analytics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance BI dashboards, data models, analytical reports, and ZAP BI environments.

  • Demonstrated capability to audit, validate, and verify the accuracy of AI-generated SQL and reporting outputs against compliance standards.
  • Foundational working knowledge of Python for data manipulation (including pandas and basic automation scripts), accompanied by an appetite for technical expansion.
  • Working understanding of data governance frameworks and data quality assurance methods.
  • Sharp analytical capability, systematic attention to detail, and confident communication skills.
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant professional analytical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

Required Software Skills:
  • Microsoft Power BI

  • SQL
  • Python
  • Syspro
  • ZAP BI
  • Zap Datahub



Benefits

  • Flexible hybrid working model (one designated office day per week in Paarl).
  • Opportunity to advance expertise in cutting-edge analytics, modern data engineering, and applied AI frameworks within a supportive enterprise team.

title: Founder's Office - Product and GTM
description:
The Role: Founder's Office - Product and GTM

This is not a strategy-only role. This is a high-ownership execution and product operator role where you will:

- Run 0-1 / 1-N programs that connect product building with growth and customer acquisition

- Break ambiguity into structure: problem, plan, milestones, measurable outcomes

- Execute relentlessly

- Own outcomes end-to-end across Product, Growth Marketing, Sales/RevOps, and Partnerships

You will work closely with the Founder/CEO/Function Heads, and will be accountable for business impact, not activity.

What You'll Own:

1. Product Program Ownership (Core):

- Own mission-critical product programs: new modules/features, integrations, onboarding flows, analytics, reliability initiatives, internal tooling.

- Translate business/GTM needs into crisp product requirements and execution plans.

- Drive execution across Product/Engineering/Design with tight timelines and high quality.

- Ensure shipping is adopted and creates measurable impact.

2. Growth Marketing and Customer Acquisition Programs:

- Run growth initiatives that move acquisition and activation: landing pages, lead magnets, outbound/ABM experiments, performance marketing pilots, website conversion improvements.

- Partner with Growth/Marketing to define funnels, experiments, success metrics, and iteration cadence.

- Build repeatable playbooks for what works.

3. GTM Enablement and Revenue Programs:

- Own cross-functional GTM programs: funnel efficiency, lead qualification, pipeline hygiene, pricing/packaging experiments, sales productivity, partnerships motions.

- Work with Sales/RevOps to improve conversion, cycle time, win-rates, and expansion plays.

- Ensure GTM decisions are backed by data and executed with discipline.

4. Cross-Functional Execution and Cadence:

- Run cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, Sales, Ops, and People.

- Set clear owners, timelines, dependencies, risks, and decision points.

- Unblock teams, drive follow-through, and keep programs moving without drama.

5. Data, Metrics and Operating Rhythm:

- Build simple, powerful dashboards for leadership.

- Own weekly/monthly reviews: insights, decisions, action items, and closure.

- Turn data into clear narratives.

What We're Looking For (Non-Negotiables):

1. You're a Strong Operator:

- You execute extremely well and finish what you start.

- You're comfortable in ambiguity and can independently figure things out.

- You push projects to completion with high standards.

2. You're Structured and Rigorous:

- You think in outcomes, priorities, trade-offs, and milestones.

- You bring order to chaos without over-engineering.

- You communicate crisply and drive alignment.

3. You're Outcome-Driven:

- You measure success in results, not effort.

- You build momentum, show progress, and make impact visible.

- You proactively take ownership.

Experience and Background:

4-8 years of experience in one or more of:

- Product programs

- Growth teams / Growth marketing ops

- Consulting with strong execution exposure

- Startup operator roles where you shipped cross-functional outcomes

Mandatory Requirements:

- Prior SaaS experience

- Tier 1 educational background

Additional Skills:

- Strong comfort with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and first-principles problem solving

- High learning velocity; able to context-switch across product and GTM without losing depth

Benefits:

Impact and Growth: Step into a high-impact role where you will directly influence the company's strategy and success. You'll get front-row experience in building a startup, working side-by-side with the founder to tackle our most critical challenges.

Learning and Mentorship: Work closely with an experienced founding team and gain exposure to all facets of running a tech startup. This role is often a fast-track for future entrepreneurs and leaders, offering mentorship, learning opportunities, and personal growth that few other positions can match.

Dynamic Culture: Join a small but passionate team in a fast-paced, collaborative, and flexible work environment. We value initiative, creativity, and the open exchange of ideas. You'll have the autonomy to shape your work and the support to thrive.

title: Senior Architect - Data Centres
description:
Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

We are a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and also Enterprise projects across Europe. These projects are led from our specialist data centre team based in the UK in conjunction with our local teams across Europe who ensure localisation and permitting delivery, but also other global design teams providing resource and capability to the projects.

We are seeking an experienced Architect or Architectural Technologist with a strong technical background in the design of large multi-disciplinary design projects, preferably data centres. The ideal candidate will be able to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary architectural and engineering teams.

The candidate must be strong in technical design content, with a CSA bias and in design management, digital technologies, and design workflow. They will be expected to oversee design activities and the production of design information and maintain the level of quality that is expected throughout these projects. They will have to manage this delivery to very demanding timelines and programmes with immovable deadlines.

The preferred location for this role is Belfast, given its position as a key hub of expertise. Dublin, Manchester, and London are also suitable locations. The role will require travel throughout the UK, Ireland, and Europe.

AECOM is listed as the 4th largest employer of architects worldwide in the World Architecture WA100 2025 survey, with over 1500 architects. We are currently expanding in the UK, so now is a great time to join our team and build your career for the future. We are at number 10 in the AJ100 list. AECOM employs around 7500 multi-disciplinary staff in the UK, and we offer architecturally led multi-disciplinary design services to our clients.

Project / Design Responsibilities

  • Senior Architect/Designer on a portfolio of projects.
  • Assist in coordinating the design across multi-disciplinary architectural and engineering teams, working closely with discipline leads to deliver integrated architectural and engineering outputs across projects.
  • Ensuring all internal governance is followed both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects.
  • Presenting to clients and prospective clients.
  • Ensuring CDM Safety in Design principles are applied throughout all design stages of a project.

Managerial Responsibilities

  • Organises own and others work to achieve set deadlines.
  • Responsible for the correctness, accuracy and multi-disciplinary coordination of the design documentation.
  • Ensures the quality of technical work produced meets AECOM’s Technical Excellence standards.
  • Interact with clients, contractors, local authority representatives and others using skills of persuasion and negotiation to resolve critical issues.
  • Make appropriate value judgements with respect to corrective work that supports the design concept and performance goals of the project.
  • For projects on site: Manage interface between Design Team / Site Team ensuring proper design support is provided in a timely manner.
  • Support Associate Directors and / or Directors with operational responsibilities which includes development and implementing Technical Excellence initiatives, management of resources (HR), training initiatives (CPD).
  • Where requested, engage with business reporting activities.
  • Ensure the latest software and digital techniques are utilised to increase productivity and identify where training opportunities for staff should be made available.

Specific Skills Required:

  • Must be proficient in the team management of, and use of, CAD. We use a range of CAD software, and training can be given to get you up to speed on the specific software needed for projects we are working on, which utilise AutoCAD & REVIT.
  • In particular our approach to design utilises 3D modelling in REVIT for workflow, and direct ‘hands on’ experience and current working knowledge of REVIT is required.
  • It would also be useful to have a working knowledge of Sketchup, Photoshop, InDesign, PowerPoint, Twinmotion and other presentation and render software. (Training can also be provided).
  • Familiarity with working in Common Data Environments (CDE) like Forma ACC, ProjectWise, Autodesk Docs, etc.
  • Creative, practical, adaptable and enthusiastic.
  • Ability to demonstrate attention to detail.
  • Ability to think in a methodical way to design, plan and organize parts of projects.
  • English language proficient, holding good communication skills to present information in speech, drawings and reports.
  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK.
  • Fully Qualified Architect or Technologist (Chartered or equivalent) and proven experience in working on large multi-disciplinary design projects, preferably in Data Centres
  • Willingness and interest to work in a range of areas under the guidance of Associate Directors and / or Directors. Our areas of design include: Data Centres, Nuclear, Transport, Rail, Aviation, Education, Health Care, Laboratory, Science, and Logistics.
  • Degree qualification, preferably with Diploma or Masters in a University Course, although the latter is not absolutely essential.
  • Some experience of various forms of building contract will be helpful.
  • An understanding and knowledge of the application UK Building Systems, Standards and Regulations and construction types.
  • IT literate, with knowledge of CAD software, and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, TEAMS, etc).
  • Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines.
  • A clear work history and proof of professional development and learning.

Must have worked on Data Centres to be considered.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

closing date: Wednesday 18 November 2026 salary: £50,299 to £51,698 per annum location: Bishop Auckland, Hybrid, Seaham

Are you ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Here at believe housing, we’re firmly into one of the most exciting chapters in our story, with an ambitious programme of transformation now well underway – reshaping how we think, work and create exceptional value and experiences for our customers and colleagues. And we’re looking for people who want to be at the heart of its next phase.

Our recently established Target Operating Model (TOM) programme brings together new technologies, reimagined services and change across every part of the business, with our workstreams underway and our programme approach continuing to mature.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love solving real problems, and want to help strengthen and shape something brilliant for our customers, this is your moment.

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our team on a fixed‑term contract until April 2029.

We believe in life without barriers, if you think you’d be great in the role, we want to hear from you. We’re interested in your skills, experience and personal values and we’re committed to being a supportive and inclusive employer.

A flexible approach that works for you

We’re a family‑friendly organisation, and we encourage everyone to ‘work the believe way’; keeping things simple, focusing on what matters and removing unnecessary tasks.

Your working arrangements will be flexible, based on the needs of the role, our customers and your preferences (agreed with your manager). Our offices are in Seaham and Bishop Auckland, and this role will require an on‑site presence for part of the week.

About the role

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building and optimising scalable data pipelines that reliably support business and analytical needs. You’ll apply structured, evidence‑based problem‑solving to identify trends, diagnose root causes and generate meaningful insights, ensuring that all data outputs are accurate, consistent and supported by robust validation and automated quality processes.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable SQL-based data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes and integrations across an on-premise database system
  • develop, optimise and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, views and transformation processes to support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence
  • support the organisations transition toward Microsoft Fabric, contributing to the development of cloud-based data pipelines, lakehouses and modern data engineering solutions
  • implement data quality, validation, monitoring and error‑handling processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity and reliability of organisational data
  • collaborate with Data Analysts, BI developers, IT teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective, business‑focused data solutions
  • monitor, troubleshoot and optimise data processes and infrastructure, ensuring performance, reliability, scalability and operational efficiency
  • maintain technical documentation, data engineering standards, security, governance and best practices, ensuring compliance with organisational policies and relevant regulatory requirements within the social housing sector.

Our people are our greatest strength, and we’re committed to helping you grow, stay curious, and thrive. At believe housing, we’ve created a supportive, inclusive culture where ideas are welcomed and development is encouraged.

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and we know that great experiences start with empowered colleagues. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing, motivate you, and help you do your best work.

We offer a competitive salary of £50,299 to £51,698 per annum and:

  • Up to 33 days annual leave, plus four volunteering days
  • access to our healthcare scheme
  • flexible working that supports your wellbeing
  • a positive, inclusive culture where growth and development are genuinely encouraged.

If you share our values and believe you can bring something special to this role, we’d love to hear from you.

We are a Disability Confident Employer. If you need any adjustments or support throughout the recruitment process, please let us know.

Interview date: To be confirmed.

title: Financial Modelling Expert - PE/Credit/Debt - FinTech
description:
At Outsized, we match clients in financial services and management consulting to high-quality independent consultants and boutique firms for the execution of their key projects.

A leading fintech company is hiring finance experts to build, review, and improve high-quality financial modelling work. This is a remote role and can be full-time or part-time depending on availability and fit. This role forms part of the fintech's initiative to strengthen modelling standards and analytical capabilities for real-world finance challenges in dynamic digital finance environments.

As a consultant, you will build, review, and refine sophisticated models that translate messy source data, business realities, transactions, forecasts, and financing structures into clear, defensible analytical frameworks - directly impacting investment decisions, credit assessments, risk management, and strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities:

- Build detailed financial models from scratch across domains including Private Credit, Private Equity, and Debt Capital Markets.

- Review and enhance models developed by other experts, identifying weak assumptions, broken logic, missing schedules, and oversimplified analysis.

- Develop realistic scenarios, assumptions, and supporting materials, including revenue, cost, working capital, capex, debt, covenant, valuation, and sensitivity schedules.

- Transform incomplete or messy information into structured, high-integrity analytical outputs.

- Clearly explain and defend modeling choices, logic, and key drivers to stakeholders.

- Contribute to the creation or improvement of modeling best practices, tests, case studies, or training materials where relevant.

Your Background:

- 2 - 8+ years of hands-on, relevant finance experience with a proven track record of personally owning and building real financial models (not just template work or formatting).

- Deep domain exposure in at least one of the following: private credit, credit, private equity, or debt capital markets.

- Advanced Excel modeling skills and expert-level understanding of core finance concepts including cash flow, valuation, leverage, liquidity, capital structure, and domain-specific mechanics.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently with ambiguous problems, messy data, and high-stakes analytical deliverables.

- Strong attention to detail combined with clear written and verbal English communication skills.

- Nice-to-have: Experience in debt, restructuring, commercial real estate, structured finance, or familiarity with AI tools, automation, and data workflows.

Other Info:

This is a fully remote opportunity available on a full-time or part-time basis depending on availability and fit. Projects are flexible with potential for ongoing engagement or extension based on performance and demand. Immediate or near-term start is preferred for strong candidates.

title: Membership Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Membership Coordinator

Department: The Club at the Biltmore


Reports To: Membership Manager


Position Summary

The Membership Coordinator supports the daily administrative operations of The Club at The Biltmore, primarily serving fitness memberships and the broader Club experience, including member events and benefits throughout the property. The position provides responsive service to current and prospective members and maintains accurate membership information.


The Membership Coordinator assists the Membership Manager with membership inquiries, sales follow-up, renewals, member communications, event coordination, recordkeeping, and billing support, while delivering service consistent with The Biltmore Hotel standards.


Responsibilities

Membership Sales and Retention

· Assist the Membership Manager with prospect outreach, membership inquiries, appointment scheduling, and follow-up communications.

· Support membership sales initiatives by tracking inquiries, referrals, and follow-up activity.

· Provide information about Premier memberships and refer prospective members to the Membership Manager for sales discussions and enrollment.

· Assist with membership renewals by preparing notices, contacting members as directed, and updating renewal records.

· Build positive relationships with members and assist with retention and member engagement activities.

· Respond promptly to membership inquiries by telephone, email, website, and other communication channels, escalating issues as appropriate.

· Schedule and assist with property tours for prospective members and explain Club benefits and offerings within established guidelines.


Membership Operations and Administration

· Support the daily administrative operations of the Club and maintain organized, efficient departmental processes.

Work under the direction of the Membership Manager, completing assigned administrative tasks, communicating priorities, and providing timely status updates.

· Maintain accurate membership records, contracts, and account information within Agilysys and other applicable systems.

· Prepare and process new membership applications, account activations, membership cards, and related documentation in accordance with established procedures.

· Assist with billing inquiries, payment records, collection follow-up, and coordination with the billing function as directed.

· Manage incoming inquiries, appointment calendars, correspondence, and routine departmental administrative needs.

· Compile membership activity data and assist in preparing monthly sales reports, biweekly commission reports, and other departmental documentation.

· Prepare purchase order documentation and assist with tracking membership-related event revenue and payments.

· Maintain organized membership files, records, and departmental databases.

· Coordinate with Golf and other hotel departments, as directed, to help maintain accurate membership eligibility and access records.


Member Relations and Guest Experience

· Serve as a welcoming first point of contact for routine member inquiries, requests, and assistance.

· Document member concerns and refer complaints requiring resolution or management approval to the Membership Manager.

· Maintain the membership complaint log and track follow-up actions as directed.

· Maintain courteous and professional relationships with members, prospective members, and hotel departments.

· Assist with VIP membership requests and promptly escalate special arrangements to the Membership Manager.

· Provide personalized, attentive service consistent with The Biltmore Hotel luxury hospitality standards.


Member Events and Communications

· Assist with Club membership events, including monthly gatherings, themed events, wine dinners, tasting receptions, and other membership functions.

· Support event planning logistics with hotel departments, including menus, décor, supplies, reservations, and banquet event order details.

· Process event reservations, registration, attendance lists, and payments according to established procedures.

· Assist with event setup, check-in, hosting, and member engagement.

· Research event resources and vendors and coordinate logistical details as assigned.

· Prepare and distribute membership newsletters, promotional communications, renewal notices, and quarterly mailings as directed.


Departmental Collaboration and Performance

· Coordinate with Golf, Food and Beverage, Finance, and other departments to support Club membership administration.

· Assist with membership promotions, outreach, and other initiatives developed by the Membership Manager.

· Support external networking or promotional events when assigned.

· Maintain membership sales and activity trackers and provide updates to the Membership Manager.

· Follow departmental policies, Biltmore Standard Operating Procedures (BSOPs), and established service expectations.

· Perform additional administrative and member-service responsibilities as assigned by the Membership Manager.

title: Facilities & Administration, Sr. Director | Cairo or Alexandria

Sutherland is seeking an experienced Sr. Director/Sr. Leader of Facilities & Administration who will focus on facilities operations, maintenance, infrastructure, office fit-outs, new-site readiness, contractor management and facilities cost optimization. If you have strong facilities leadership experience - want to hear from you!

1. Role Overview

Lead Facilities Management and Administration operations across Egypt, ensuring reliable infrastructure, efficient workplace services, regulatory compliance, creating better employee experience and uninterrupted support for 24/7 business operations.

The role requires strong operational leadership, financial and commercial acumen, vendor management, established professional relationships with Egyptian government authorities and local stakeholders.

C. Governance, Compliance & Risk

D. Financial & Commercial Management

  • Drive cost optimization, financial discipline, and operational efficiencies.
  • Monitor expenditure, budget variances, vendor payments, and financial commitments.
  • Develop business cases, management dashboards, and cost improvement initiatives.

E. Vendor & Contract Management

  • Lead vendor selection, negotiations, contracts, and performance management.
  • Oversee outsourced services, including maintenance, security, housekeeping, catering, and transportation.
  • Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual compliance, and service quality.

  • Lead and develop Facilities and Administration team
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and service excellence.
  • Partner with business leadership, HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, Legal, Securities and Compliance.
  • Manage relationships with landlords, government authorities, vendors, and external stakeholders.

H. Sustainability & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive energy efficiency, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives.
  • Leverage technology, automation, and digital monitoring to improve operations.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance productivity, service quality, and cost efficiency.

3. Key Performance Indicators

  • Operational Excellence: Infrastructure uptime, service reliability, and business continuity.
  • Financial Performance: Budget adherence, cost optimization, and savings.
  • Compliance: Statutory compliance, audit outcomes, and risk management.
  • Government Liaison: Timely approvals, renewals, and resolution of local administrative matters.
  • Vendor Management: SLA performance, service quality, and commercial efficiency.
  • Workplace & Transportation: Service reliability, safety, employee satisfaction, and cost efficiency.
  • People Leadership: Team performance, development, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Sustainability: Energy efficiency and resource optimization.
  • Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline
  • 12+ years of experience in Facilities Management, Property Management, Administration, or Infrastructure Operations, including senior leadership responsibilities.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale, multi-site, 24/7 operations, preferably in IT/ITES, BPO, or multinational organizations.
  • Strong technical understanding of building infrastructure, maintenance, and operational continuity.
  • Demonstrated expertise in OPEX/CAPEX management, cost optimization, vendor negotiations, and contract management.
  • Strong knowledge of Egyptian regulations, government procedures, and local administrative requirements.
  • Established professional network and proven experience working with Egyptian government authorities and local stakeholders.
  • Experience managing transportation, security, workplace services, and administrative operations.
  • Strong leadership, commercial judgment, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Fluency in Arabic and English is essential.

5. Core Competencies

  • Strategic and operational leadership
  • Financial and commercial acumen
  • Government and stakeholder relationship management
  • Infrastructure and facilities expertise
  • Governance, compliance, and risk management
  • Vendor negotiation and contract management
  • Crisis management and business continuity

title: Senior Product Manager – 3D Vision Hardware
description:
Join the Zivid team!

Zivid is one of Norway's most ambitious technology companies, building the 3D vision and motion-planning software that give robots human-like sight and judgment. Our Zivid 2+ and Zivid 3 cameras deliver industry-leading accuracy, even on black, shiny, or transparent objects, and with Zivid Motion, our real-time, collision-aware motion-planning software, we're one of very few companies in the world delivering vision and motion together as a single platform. We serve the global robotics and automation market from six countries with 100+ employees and a global customer base.


We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to take long-term ownership of our 3D cameras.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Why this role exists: to keep our 3D cameras the best choice for robot builders, from launch to end-of-life.

You take long-term ownership of the Zivid 2+ and Zivid 3 camera families and our accessories: you run their lifecycles, lead launches and decide what comes next, so our customers keep getting the best 3D vision for their robots. You will be part of a small, cross-functional Product team, and if you're passionate about cutting-edge hardware and tackling new challenges hands-on, we're excited to have you on board.

SCOPE

  • Own the Zivid 2+ and Zivid 3 camera families and accessories end to end: roadmap, datasheets, documentation, lifecycle and end-of-life.
  • Plan and run product launches together with engineering, operations, marketing and sales.
  • Work closely with strategic customers and integrators to understand their applications, and turn what you learn into clear requirements for new cameras and features.
  • Collect customer feedback from the field and act on it, together with sales and support.
  • Contribute to our next generation of cameras.
  • Give sales and customer training the product knowledge they need.
  • Influence product strategy, roadmap and prioritization with data-driven insights.

The role reports to the VP of Product.

OUTCOMES FOR THE FIRST 12 MONTHS

You'll be evaluated on these outcomes, not on hours logged or activities completed.

  • Product lines: You own the Zivid 2+ and Zivid 3 families end to end, with up-to-date roadmaps, datasheets and lifecycle plans.
  • Launch: You have led at least one product launch from plan to market.
  • Customers: You have working relationships with our strategic customers and integrators, and their feedback reaches you in a structured way.
  • What's next: You have turned what you learned from customers into clear requirements for the next camera or feature, and they're on the roadmap.
  • Enablement: Sales and support have the product knowledge and material they need.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must-have

  • Credibility with both engineers and customers: you can go deep on the technical details with engineering, explain what matters to customers and sales, and settle the trade-offs between them.
  • The ability to turn messy, conflicting customer input into clear requirements, and to say no with good reasons.
  • A track record of getting engineering, operations, marketing and sales to deliver together, and keeping the plan on track when dates or suppliers slip. Launches, releases and major projects all count.
  • A structured, hands-on approach that keeps several product lines in good shape at once.
  • Follow-through: you stay with products and projects long after the exciting part is over, and keep track of what you've committed to.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with 3D vision, stereo cameras or optics.
  • Experience with industrial or B2B products.
  • Experience from a hardware product company.

WHAT'S HARD ABOUT THIS ROLE

You'll run mature product lines and new launches at the same time, so prioritizing is constant. Hardware timelines depend on suppliers and production, and launches move. The role spans from deeply technical work with engineering to working directly with customers, and you need to be credible at both ends. And because we're a small, hands-on product team, you do the work yourself, from datasheets to sales training. If you want to focus on strategy only, this isn't that role. If you want to own products in the field and see them succeed, it is.

WE OFFER

  • A pivotal role owning core products in a fast-growing scale-up
  • Significant autonomy and career development opportunities
  • Exposure to cutting-edge 3D vision and robotics technology
  • Competitive compensation package, including sign-on stock options, competitive pension scheme and premium health insurance plan

OTHER DETAILS

Location: Oslo (Nydalen), Norway. This is an on-site position. We support relocation, visa application and language courses for employees moving to Norway.

Travel: The role includes regular travel to visit customers.

Application deadline: We encourage applications as soon as possible, but no later than November 30, 2026.

Start date: As soon as possible, subject to mutual agreement.


The official language of the company is English.


If you have specific questions about the position, they will be answered by Stian Lind Petlund, stian.petlund@zivid.com.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (DevOps)
description:
£65,000–£80,000 per year | Hybrid, Warrington | Full-time, permanent | 37.5 hours per week

About Synextra

Synextra is an independent Azure specialist supporting regulated UK businesses, including law firms, mortgage lenders and financial services organisations. We’re small by design, with a focus on technical depth, customer service and taking responsibility for the environments we run.

Alongside our managed cloud services, our AI engineering team builds agent products for those same customers. We’re looking for an experienced Azure engineer who enjoys solving difficult operational problems and delivering engineering work alongside developers.

The role

You’ll work across our cloud engineering team, client projects and AI engineering team, combining deep Azure troubleshooting with planned development and automation work.

Our customers run a wide variety of environments in Azure, from virtual machines, networking and identity through to managed application services and modern cloud platforms. You’ll be someone our wider cloud engineering team can turn to for the most complex or significant Azure issues—helping investigate faults, restore service and understand what needs to change to prevent a repeat.

Alongside that operational responsibility, you’ll contribute to development sprints: building environments in Terraform, improving deployment pipelines, implementing monitoring and developing the platforms that support our AI products.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys that breadth. You’re comfortable getting into the detail of a difficult customer incident, sharing your expertise with other engineers and taking planned work through implementation, review, testing and release.

What you’ll be doing

Supporting customers and our cloud engineering team

  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex and high-impact Azure incidents across customer environments.

  • Troubleshoot across infrastructure and application services, including compute, networking, DNS, identity, storage and service dependencies.

  • Work alongside other engineers to investigate faults, restore service and communicate clear findings and next steps.

  • Follow significant incidents through to root cause, turning findings into improvements in configuration, monitoring, automation and operational guidance.

  • Share your expertise through practical troubleshooting, technical reviews and mentoring.

  • Participate in an on-call rota as part of delivering production systems.

Delivering projects and sprint work

  • Build and maintain Azure environments using Terraform, including reusable modules, state management and drift remediation.

  • Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.

  • Work with developers to refine requirements, break work into manageable tasks and deliver changes through pull requests, testing and release.

  • Automate recurring tasks and replace manual processes with dependable, repeatable solutions.

  • Contribute to technical designs and help make practical decisions about reliability, security, performance and cost.

  • Produce clear documentation and handovers so the wider team can confidently support what you build.

Working with our AI engineering team

  • Build and operate the Azure environments supporting our AI products and customer deployments.

  • Develop deployment pipelines across development, testing and production, including isolated client environments.

  • Implement networking, identity, secrets management and access controls.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting and visibility into service performance and cost, including AI consumption.

  • Help developers investigate production issues and turn operational experience into better engineering practices.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong hands-on Azure experience across both IaaS and PaaS, with a track record of diagnosing complex production faults.

  • A solid understanding of how compute, networking, DNS, identity and storage interact, and confidence investigating problems that cross those boundaries.

  • Practical experience with Azure application services such as App Service, Container Apps, Functions or API Management.

  • Experience writing and maintaining Terraform, including modules, state management and safely changing existing environments.

  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and working through Git branches, pull requests and code review.

  • The ability to write useful automation in PowerShell, Python or another scripting language.

  • Clear communication with customers and colleagues, sound judgement during incidents and the ability to deliver agreed engineering work independently.

You don’t need to have used every Azure service. We’re interested in the depth of your understanding, how you investigate unfamiliar problems and the work you’ve delivered.

Useful additional experience

  • Working in an MSP, consultancy, SaaS business or development team.

  • Supporting regulated customers or operating across multiple customer environments.

  • Azure Monitor, Application Insights, KQL or OpenTelemetry.

  • Multi-tenant architecture and tenant isolation.

  • Deploying or operating AI and LLM-based services.

  • Relevant Microsoft certifications, such as AZ-104, AZ-305 or AZ-400. We’ll fund relevant certifications you want to work towards.

How we work

Customer support and planned engineering delivery are both substantial parts of this role. You’ll work with colleagues across the teams to agree priorities, communicate when urgent work affects delivery and follow tasks through to a proper conclusion.

We value people who stay calm when something breaks, ask good questions and share what they learn. Your contribution will be visible in the reliability of our customer environments, the quality of what we deliver and the capability of the engineers around you.

What we offer

  • A salary of £65,000–£80,000, depending on relevant experience and capability.

  • Hybrid working based at our Birchwood Park office in Warrington.

  • A permanent, full-time role working 37.5 hours per week.

  • Funded relevant Microsoft certifications.

  • Varied technical work across customer environments, cloud projects and AI products.

  • Direct access to leadership and the opportunity to influence technical decisions and working practices.

Apply through our careers site.
