title: West London - Job Pool
description:
WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, not just juice, sandwiches, coffee, and much more. When joining us, you step into a high-energy community where the music is loud, the bar is your stage, and your personality matters as much as your skills.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

  • Positive Attitude
  • Inclusion
  • Social Ties
  • Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new — you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you’ll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing, move through a clear Moneyball career path, and be part of a company where most leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!).

If you love fast-paced service, music, people, and the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that can take you across cities, countries, and roles.

THIS IS A TALENT POOL, NOT A JOB OPENING

We're not hiring for a specific store right now. By applying here, you're joining our Juicer talent pool, so you're first in line when a spot opens near you. If and when the right opportunity comes up, we'll reach out. No promises on timing, and no need to wait by the phone, but your application stays with us and we'll come back to you when there's a match.

STORES IN THIS POOL

This pool covers the stores below. When a Juicer position opens in any of them, you'll be among the first we reach out to.

  • 184 Portobello Road
  • 45 Westbourne Grove
  • 94 Holland Park Avenue
  • Paddington Square - Unit 18
  • 178 Chiswick High Road
  • 809 Fulham Road
  • Hammersmith Broadway Unit 1A

JOB SUMMARY

As a Juicer at JOE & THE JUICE, your primary responsibilities are guest service and preparing food, juices, coffee, and sandwiches. You'll help ensure the bar always looks clean, welcoming, and ready for our guests. You'll report to your Store Manager, and as part of the team, your tasks may evolve alongside the store's needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Make every guest feel welcome and taken care of, from the moment they walk in.
  • Every juice, sandwich, and coffee we make follows a product manual, but there's one ingredient that's the same across all of them: it tastes better made with passion.
  • Keep your station and the bar spotless, because a clean bar is part of the experience too.

WHO YOU ARE

Behind every bar, on every shift, there's a Juicer who shows up with energy and makes someone's day a little brighter. That's the standard here, not one person doing it well, but all of us doing it together.

  • You show up with a "happy to be here" attitude, and you help build it, shift after shift, for the people around you.
  • You treat your teammates like family and your guests like they matter, because they do.
  • You're humble enough to learn, honest enough to be trusted.
  • You take pride in the work, even when no one's watching.
  • You're not here because a juice bar is going to change your life. Or maybe it will, most of our leaders started exactly where you're standing now. You're here because you're always looking to add one more tool to your toolbox, and this happens to be a place where you can find more than a few.

If that sounds like you, you're already one of us. Come prove it.

GOOD TO KNOW

  • How the pool works: Submit your application and we'll keep it on file. When a Juicer position opens near you, we reach out to people in the pool first.
  • No prior experience needed. Bring the right attitude and we'll teach you the rest.
  • Show up on time and looking sharp, it's part of respecting your team and your guests.
  • We'll walk you through our policies and procedures as part of onboarding, so you're never left guessing.

ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

JOE & THE JUICE is a healthy fast-casual concept founded in Copenhagen in 2002; since then, we have grown to more than 500 locations across 20 countries and now employ more than 4,500 people worldwide. From day one, our ambition has been to prove that there should be no trade-off between taste and health.

We serve high-quality, freshly prepared juices, shakes, coffee, and sandwiches in relaxed, contemporary concept cafés that combine convenience with distinct urban atmospheres. JOE & THE JUICE goes beyond products towards the full experience around the bar, creating a consistent universe for guests and Juicers in all our locations.

We invest heavily in internal development through our Moneyball career system and a culture where most leaders, including C-suite, VPs, and directors, have started behind the bar. We continue to evolve our people-centric and sustainability agenda that is part of our Nordic heritage and our commitment to a better future.

title: AI Product Manager - Feasibility, Underwriting & Investment
description:
Job Summary:

The AI Product Manager, Feasibility, Underwriting & Investment owns the AI products that help a global real-estate business decide where, what and when to invest. The role turns market research, site screening, feasibility studies, financial underwriting and investment-committee work into agentic AI tools that make decisions faster, more consistent across markets and fully traceable.

The incumbent combines deep real-estate investment experience with product management skills. They decide what to build, write the requirements AI engineers deliver, and prove through evidence that each product improves decision quality. Investment decisions always stay with people and the investment committee; the products give them better evidence, sooner.

Key Responsibilities:

Product strategy:

- Own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for AI in market research, site acquisition, feasibility, underwriting and investment approval.

- Prioritise opportunities by value to investment decisions, data availability, risk and ease of adoption.

- Assess build, buy and partner options across real-estate data, valuation and investment-analytics vendors.

Market and site intelligence:

- Define AI agents that collect and summarise market evidence: comparable sales and rents, supply pipelines, absorption, pricing trends and demographics.

- Specify site-screening tools that test land and assets against zoning, planning, access, infrastructure and the company's investment criteria.

Feasibility and underwriting:

- Define agents that draft feasibility studies, including highest-and-best-use, product mix, pricing and phasing options.

- Specify underwriting tools for development appraisals, residual land value, IRR, NPV, equity multiple and profit on cost.

- Automate sensitivity, scenario and probability analysis on sales prices, absorption, construction cost, financing cost, currency and timing.

- Lead the creation of standard underwriting templates and assumption libraries so that deals in different markets can be compared like for like.

Investment committee and due diligence:

- Define agents that draft investment papers and risk summaries, with every figure traced to its source and model version.

- Specify challenge tools that test a deal's assumptions against benchmarks and past deals before it reaches the committee.

- Define due-diligence agents that review legal, technical, environmental and commercial documents in data rooms and flag material issues.

Evidence and learning:

- Back-test products on past deals, comparing what was assumed, what was approved and what actually happened.

- Feed actual cost, schedule and sales results from delivered projects back into assumptions and models.

- Run new products in parallel with the existing process before they are used for live decisions.

Governance:

- Apply model risk management: model inventory, validation, version control and change logs.

- Protect confidential and price-sensitive deal information, and respect market-data licensing terms and data-protection laws.

- Make sure no product approves an investment; approvals stay with the committee and delegated authorities.

Qualifications & Experience:

Essential:

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Business, Engineering or a related field.

- At least 10 years' experience, including 6 or more in real-estate investment, acquisitions, underwriting, feasibility or development appraisal.

- Hands-on experience building and challenging development appraisals and investment models.

- Experience preparing investment-committee papers and managing acquisition due diligence.

- At least 3 years in product management, analytics or investment-technology roles, with one or more data or AI products delivered into live use.

- Experience of investing across more than one country or region.

Desirable:

- Master's degree such as an MBA or MSc in Real Estate Finance.

- Professional qualification such as CFA, MRICS or CAIA.

- Experience with real-estate funds, joint ventures or capital raising.

- Knowledge of valuation standards (e.g. RICS Red Book, IVS) and ESG or climate-risk underwriting.

Technical Skills:

- Investment modelling: expert in Excel-based development and investment models; familiar with appraisal software (e.g. Argus).

- Market and location data: real-estate data providers, transaction databases and GIS tools for site analysis.

- Quantitative methods: forecasting, regression, scenario and Monte Carlo analysis, and model validation.

- AI fluency: how large language models, retrieval, document intelligence and AI agents work, and where they fail.

- Product delivery: writing requirements and acceptance criteria, Agile methods and backlog tools (e.g. Jira).

- Data: basic SQL, data-quality assessment and dashboard tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau).

- Responsible AI: explainability, model risk management and data protection (e.g. GDPR).

Core Competencies:

- Investment judgement: knows what a committee needs to see and what changes a decision.

- Analytical rigour: challenges every assumption, including the AI's, and asks where each number comes from.

- Comfort with uncertainty: thinks in ranges and probabilities, not single-point answers.

- Influence: persuades senior investors with evidence, including when it contradicts their view.

- Discretion: handles confidential and price-sensitive information with care.

- Standard-setting: brings different markets to one consistent way of underwriting.

- Global outlook: follows capital-market and local real-estate trends across regions.

title: Ford Racing Vehicle Engineering Lead, Feature & Software Delivery
description:
Racing is where our story began.

In 1901, Henry Ford climbed into a car he built himself—"Sweepstakes"—and beat America's most famous driver. He wasn't a racer, but he had to win. He did. Ford Motor Company was born from that victory.

That fighting spirit lives on in Ford Racing today. We're the engineers, strategists, and competitors who bring Ford's track-tested edge into every vehicle we build. Every track, every stage, every proving ground—that's where we prove ourselves.

The result: one of the world's most iconic brands, legendary nameplates, and a team unmatched in the industry.

Our mantra: Race to win, engineer to lead.

If you're a competitor, innovator, or performance obsessive, Ford Racing is where you belong. Help us write the next chapter.

In this position...

The Vehicle Engineering – Features & Human Factors Engineer will lead the integration of customer needs, human-centered design, HMI, selectable drive modes, ergonomics, and vehicle features across Ford Racing programs. This role provides customer-centric design direction to ensure vehicle interfaces, drive mode behaviors, and feature interactions deliver intuitive, engaging, and differentiated experiences that reflect the expectations of performance vehicle customers.

Working closely with Design, Marketing, Customer Insights, Program, Design & Release, hardware, software, and other engineering teams, this individual will translate customer insights into vehicle-level requirements, guide system-level design decisions, resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, and validate the complete vehicle experience. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical capabilities with a passion for performance vehicles, emerging technologies, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

This role is hybrid and requires at least 4 days per week onsite in Allen Park, MI.

What you'll do...

  • Provide customer-centric design direction for HMI layouts, driver interactions, selectable drive modes, feature behaviors, and vehicle settings to deliver intuitive, consistent, and engaging experiences tailored to performance vehicle customers.
  • Translate customer insights, behaviors, and needs into vehicle-level requirements, measurable engineering targets, and differentiated user experiences.
  • Collaborate with Design, Marketing, Customer Insights, Program, hardware, software, and other engineering teams to align feature content and system-level requirements with overall vehicle objectives.
  • Lead human factors research, task analysis, usability evaluations, and customer testing to assess HMI, drive mode selection and feedback, feature discoverability, and overall ease of use.
  • Lead customer experience reviews and validate vehicle functionality, usability, and intended driving experiences using analytical tools, prototypes, and physical vehicles.
  • Facilitate cross-functional technical tradeoffs and resolve design or engineering issues while maintaining customer experience, safety, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage program feature documentation, engineering systems, and deliverables to achieve program milestones and engineering gateways on time and with quality.
  • Establish and maintain human factors guidelines, incorporate emerging technologies and industry best practices, and drive continuous improvements in vehicle engineering and validation efficiency.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3 years of experience in automotive product development, feature delivery, HMI, human factors engineering, ergonomics, or vehicle usability testing.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems, facilitate decisions, and build strong working relationships.
  • Ability to work primarily onsite at the Roush 57 facility nearly every weekday.

Even better, you may have...

  • Understanding of performance vehicle customers, their expectations and priorities, and the factors that drive an exceptional driving experience.
  • Experience providing customer-centric design direction for vehicle interfaces, selectable drive modes, driver controls, or vehicle feature interactions.
  • Knowledge of automotive systems, human-centered design, task analysis, cognitive psychology, human-computer interaction, and usability evaluation.
  • Experience with customer research, usability testing, software development processes, over-the-air updates, or connected vehicle features.
  • Familiarity with applicable automotive safety standards, regulations, and human factors guidelines.
  • Strong analytical, communication, presentation, leadership, and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated initiative, adaptability, creativity, and a collaborative approach.
  • Passion for performance vehicles, emerging technologies, and delivering intuitive, differentiated customer experiences.

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.
  • Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more.
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more.
  • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases.
  • Tuition assistance.
  • Established and active employee resource groups.
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service.
  • Generous vacation time, sick/personal time, and paid holidays, including between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day.

This position is a salary grade 5 - 8 and ranges from $65,100 - $166,200.
Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

Internal applicants: moving into this role may result in an adjustment to your current compensation based on the posted pay range for this role, taking into consideration your qualifications and other relevant factors.

  • Maximize colleagues' productivity and morale while maintaining discipline in accordance with hotel policies and local labour legislation.

  • Conduct daily training sessions and maintain accurate training records.

  • Assist the Executive Pastry Chef in developing and standardizing bakery recipes to ensure consistent quality and effective food cost control.

  • Maximize team productivity and support effective workforce planning to control payroll costs.

  • Monitor operating expenses and implement corrective measures when necessary.

  • Identify guest preferences, market needs, and emerging bakery trends to continuously enhance the hotel's product offerings.

  • Monitor market trends and competitors' bakery products to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.

  • Understanding of ultra-luxury guest expectations and brand alignment.

  • Experience in project coordination, scheduling, and document control during pre-opening stages.

  • Experience in Pre- Opening is a plus.

  • Regional Experience is a must.

  • A proactive, anticipatory approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Impeccable grooming and personal presentation aligned with luxury standards.

title: Information & Technology (IT) Specialist
description:
IT Specialist

The IT Specialist is responsible for providing technical support, maintaining IT infrastructure, and ensuring the smooth operation of technology systems across hotel, waterpark, and associated facilities. The role supports hospitality applications, guest-facing technologies, business systems, and operational technology to ensure uninterrupted business operations and an excellent guest experience.

  • Maintain appropriate access controls and user permissions.
  • Support antivirus, endpoint security, system patching, and security monitoring.

title: (CAN) Dairy Frozen Associate Overnight Full Time
description:
Position Summary...

Working as a Dairy/Frozen Associate at Walmart Canada is a great opportunity to build valuable skills in a fast paced retail environment. In this role, you deliver excellent customer service by living Walmart’s values, maintaining a clean, organized, and well zoned Dairy/Frozen department, and supporting stocking and sales activities. As part of the team, you help ensure fresh products are available and the department is always customer ready. This role is ideal for individuals looking for an engaging position in customer service or retail.

What you'll do...

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Maintain Department Organization and Standards
Keeps the Dairy/Frozen department clean, organized, and properly zoned to ensure it is customer-ready at all times.

Stock Rotation and Product Quality
Rotates merchandise regularly and checks for expired products to maintain freshness and quality standards.

Pricing, Signing, and Inventory Accuracy
Ensures merchandise is accurately signed and priced. Follows established procedures for ordering, clearance, markups and markdowns, signing, flagging, pricing, and labeling.

Cold Chain, Food Safety, and Sanitation
Adheres to cold chain and food safety standards, including temperature checks, thermometer calibration, proper food handling, product rotation, sell-by dates, expiration dates, and sanitation and cleaning procedures.

Merchandising and Feature Maintenance
Maintains department features to support merchandising standards and promotional execution.

Safety, Cleanliness, and Compliance
Maintains a neat, clean, and hazard-free work area by removing debris, spills, and unnecessary items, and by following all Company policies and Health and Safety guidelines.

Flexibility (Availability/Work Schedule)
• Be open to working a variety of shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on business needs. Your adaptability helps ensure the store runs smoothly and customers receive consistent, high-quality service.

POTENTIAL CHALLENGES IN THIS ROLE

High Task Volume in a Fast-Paced Environment
• Manages overnight hours effectively and planning accordingly to stay energized and focused.
• Effectively manages work hours and plans ahead to maintain energy and focus throughout the shift.

description:
About WPP Media

Job Title: Account Manager/Implementation Lead
Company: WPP Media South Africa
Location: Johannesburg, South Africa
Reports To: Client Partner

About WPP Media
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:
• Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
• Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
• Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Objectives of the Role:
The purpose of an Implementation Planner is to translate a client brief into a detailed media flow. The role is to translate strategy to plan and to activation.

A significant part of this role will be building and developing strong working relationships with both the client and the creative agencies which will enable the production of defined media flows.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Skills:
• To be able to interpret a client brief and provide tactical strategic advice on brand communications by applying EssenceMediacom best approaches
• Advise the client on optimal media plans
• Help to improve interfaces between planning and strategy
• Assist in preparing regular media reviews. (Competitor analysis and media environment scans)
• Work together with the BUD to integrate our Planning & strategy approach to drive more effective and efficient solutions to clients
• Assist in the preparation of central strategic work, e.g. availabilities, rates

Client Account and Stakeholder Management Skills:
• Improve interfaces between planning and strategy
• Keep up to date with media changes and alert the team of potential advantages/new opportunities for presentation to Client
• Prepare and update the media flow plans and advise BUD/Client of changes that occur on time and space that has been bought.
• Checking and ensuring media planning is reflective of the media strategy at all times
• Internally communicate and contribute to brainstorming to help generate ideas with the team
• Relationship building and negotiation for leveraging costs, discounts and added value incentives with media vendors (Securing the best discount, added value incentive or sponsorship deals from vendors)
• Maintain sound relationships & communications between EssenceMediaCom departments, their relevant creative/brand agencies, Clients and media vendors, where necessary
• Timeously highlighting any budgetary deviations
• Check commitment tracking of Budgets for Client with media vendors
• Attend regular status meetings both internally and with the clients; contributing to client business reviews
• Act as the client point of contact in relation to implementation planning. This will include responding to client queries and proactive client management

Operating and Technical Skills:
• To produce implementation plans, based on agreed strategy or parameters set out in the brief. (The best mix within a medium for the task at hand).
• Be proficient in the use of media planning measurement tools
• To apply all applicable and relevant trading deals
• To continuously improve on existing commitment discounts/positioning as circumstances allow
• Conduct detailed checking of media vendor contracts against what has been bought, and communicate any amendments to contracts detailing approved changes on media flow plans
• Monitor changes that occur on time and space that has been bought to ensure flow plans are updated and revised
• Help to leverage media vendor initiatives through innovative implementation plans
• Work in collaboration with buyer to ensure that any budget fluctuations are identified and necessary action taken
• Work with the buying team to ensure zero error implementation
• Weekly TV tracking and recommendation on changes
• Manage and generate TV Post Campaign Reports, including learning’s
• Ensure all cancellations are received from client in writing

Personal and Interpersonal Skills:
• Actively manage own performance in line with key tasks and objectives.
• Share knowledge with others across the team to enhance collective service delivery and client knowledge.
• Build effective business relationships with stakeholders through managing expectations, clear communication and consistent performance.
• To ensure that all time-sheets are updated accurately.


Life at WPP Media & Benefits
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Universal Banker
description:
What you'll do

The role of a Universal Banker is to provide our customers with an outstanding service we can all be proud of, by taking ownership of customers’ transactional or service requests and answering specific product queries. Our Universal Banker also educate our customers around HSBC self-service devices and actively speak to them around HSBC’s digital platforms, giving them the choice of how they wish to bank with us.

We’re looking for people who are passionate about delivering an outstanding customer experience, people who are ambitious and have a helpful personality. Previous Customer Service experience is helpful but is not essential, as what we’re really interested in is someone who can hold a conversation and who has a genuine passion for going above and beyond for customers – everything else we can teach you!

At HSBC we’re passionate about coaching and developing our people, you’ll have access to our learning platform and the opportunity to develop yourself and your career further.

Within this role you’ll:

  • Provide exceptional face-to-face customer service in a timely manner whilst working in a fast-paced busy Branch environment and adhering to our policies and procedures
  • Process a wide range of transactions, whilst maintaining a high degree of accuracy
  • Have excellent attention to detail
  • Play a supporting role in educating our customers around HSBC self-service devices and alternative digital banking platforms
  • Collaborate as part of the dynamic Branch team and actively seek to improve workflows and processes to make banking with HSBC easier for our customers

What do I need to be successful?

  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills enabling you to engage in effective conversations, build strong connections and show empathy to our customers
  • The ability to take ownership of customer enquiries through to resolution – you’ll pride yourself on delivering a customer experience that exceeds expectations, delivering a personalised, friendly and efficient service
  • Be resilient to a continuous changing environment

When & where you'll work

This is a full-time role that requires you to work 35 hours per week between the hours of Monday to Friday 09:00-17:00 and Saturday 09:00-13:30. (Not all our branches are open on a Saturday). Please note if you’re on a student visa that does not allow you to work 35 hours per week, unfortunately, we will not be able to progress your application. There may be times when we may ask you to support other local branches within a reasonable distance to you with any additional costs reimbursed in line with HSBC Expenses Policy.

Your Training

You’ll receive full training in-branch to get you up to speed with the specifics of your job role, the systems you will use, as well as the products and services that HSBC offer. Our Customer Service Representative training course is 8 days in total split over 2 weeks. As our training is important, we require you to attend the whole course therefore you will be unable to take holidays during your training period.

What You’ll Get!

We offer an attractive minimum starting salary of £25,000 based on 35 hours per week, plus an annual discretionary performance bonus.

You will also receive:

  • Over six weeks’ holiday. This includes bank and public holidays with the option to buy more
  • Perks at Work Benefit where you will be able to access to 30,000+ national & local employee discounts
  • A market-leading employer pension contribution
  • BUPA Healthcare
  • Life Assurance, equivalent to four times your annual salary
  • Access to a flexible benefits platform offering upgrades to Health Club Memberships, Retail Voucher Cards, Car Breakdown Cover and more
  • Sharesave schemes – a monthly savings plan linked to an option to buy shares in HSBC at a discounted rate

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please contact the Recruiter.

title: Kierownik Wydziału Wsparcia Technicznego (HelpDesk)
description:

Wojskowe Zakłady Elektroniczne S.A. są jednym z czołowych dostawców urządzeń z zakresu elektroniki oraz sprzętu wojskowego.
Głównym zadaniem WZE S.A. jest prowadzenie remontów i modernizacji systemów radiolokacyjnych oraz produkcja systemów walki radioelektronicznej w zakresie projektowania, produkcji i remontu sprzętu wojskowego
W ramach sukcesywnego rozszerzania zakresu działalności określono jej pięć głównych obszarów:
• Systemy Rakietowe,
• Platformy Lądowe,
• Systemy Radarowe,
• Walka Radioelektroniczna,
• Systemy Powietrzne i Kosmiczne.
Wojskowe Zakłady Elektroniczne S.A. należą do Polskiej Grupy Zbrojeniowej.

Twój zakres obowiązków

• Organizowanie i nadzorowanie pracy pierwszej linii wsparcia użytkowników systemów teleinformatycznych.
• Ustalanie priorytetów obsługi zgłoszeń, monitorowanie realizacji zgodnie z przyjętym SLA oraz prowadzenie eskalacji.
• Zapewnienie diagnozowania i usuwania awarii sprzętu, oprogramowania oraz problemów związanych z korzystaniem z systemów teleinformatycznych.
• Analizowanie przyczyn zgłoszeń powtarzalnych oraz inicjowanie działań zapobiegawczych
i usprawniających.
• Analizowanie potrzeb użytkowników i określanie standardowego sposobu ich realizacji.

• Definiowanie i utrzymywanie konfiguracji bazowych stanowisk pracy oraz zapewnienie zgodności urządzeń z przyjętymi standardami.
• Organizowanie testowania i kontrolowanego wdrażania konfiguracji, poprawek, aktualizacji
i zabezpieczeń urządzeń końcowych.
• Planowanie wymiany i napraw urządzeń oraz bezpiecznego wycofywania sprzętu i niszczenia nośników.

• Rozwijanie katalogu usług i bazy wiedzy, doskonalenie sposobu obsługi oraz określanie potrzeb kompetencyjnych zespołu i organizowanie wymiany wiedzy.

• Gotowość do pracy pod presją, przy jednoczesnej obsłudze zakłóceń, eskalacji użytkowników
i wdrożeń zmian.
• Umiejętność pracy zespołowej oraz samodzielnej organizacji pracy.

description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does Social Producer do at WPP Production?

Social is where a brand meets its audience every day and on a car account it has to move at the has to move at the speed of culture while living up to a brand built on precision, performance and trust. The Social Producer role exists to make that possible: turning creative ideas into finished, platform-native content and keeping the work moving smoothly between creative teams, the client and the craft specialists who make it.

At WPP Production, the Social Producer is the connective tissue between creative ambition and delivery. Working predominantly on a car account, you protect the quality of the work and the calm of the team by solving problems before they reach the client, keeping everyone clear on what is needed and by when, and making sure content lands on time, on brief and on budget. The value you deliver is confidence: clients trust their social content is in safe hands, creatives see their ideas made well, and production partners receive clear, well-organised direction to do their best work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of social content for the car account, from brief through to publish-ready assets, ensuring quality and brand standards are met every time.
  • Partner with creative, strategy, account and client teams to turn ideas into practical, achievable production plans.
  • Manage schedules, budgets and resources across multiple concurrent projects, keeping delivery on track and stakeholders informed.
  • Anticipate risks and resolve issues before they escalate, finding pragmatic solutions that protect the work, the timeline and the client relationship.
  • Coordinate directors, editors, designers, studios and freelancers across WPP Production to deliver content that is right for every platform and format.
  • Ensure every asset is approved, compliant and ready to publish, with clear and timely communication at every stage.
  • Champion smarter ways of working, including AI and next-generation tools, to raise the efficiency and quality of the output.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to brief, update and build trust with clients, creatives and production partners.
  • A natural problem solver who stays calm under pressure and finds practical solutions quickly.
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple projects, priorities and deadlines at once.
  • A solid understanding of social platforms, formats and content trends, and what makes content work in feed.
  • A collaborative, proactive approach to working across creative, client and production teams.
  • Confidence with budgets, schedules and approvals in a fast-moving production environment.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for high-quality, brand-led content and for working on a car account.
  • Nice to have: hands-on camera or editing skills (helpful, but not essential)

#LI-FP1

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

title: Associate Director Third Party Manufacturing
description:
The Associate Director, Third Party Manufacturing (TPM) Manager will be the main supplier relationship contact person in charge of providing the organization, supervision, strategic initiatives, and technical support necessary to manage supply of designated products. The role will ensure that high quality product is manufactured in compliance with local and international regulations, and released and delivered according to the established forecasts, schedules, and cost planned. This position also manages projects and programs impacting AbbVie to ensure a cost effective, marketable and manufacturable product and maximizes profitability throughout its life cycle. Through matrix management of cross functional groups/individuals, the Associate Director, TPM is responsible for leading various teams without direct authority, providing program management support, and is the primary AbbVie representative to coordinate operations for existing and new products manufactured with the supplier.

Responsibilities

•Participate in the negotiation of the Manufacturing Service Agreement and amendments, and ensure compliance with the terms of the agreements.
•Ensure effective planning and material procurement strategies are in place to supply the TPM with the required materials.
•Communicate to the TPM the product forecasts, and agree on manufacturing and delivery schedules. In coordination with Supply Chain and Planning, ensure the supplier delivers the product according to the demand forecasted.
•Actively participate in the development of Financial Operating Plan and Standard process and ensure the financial goals are met
•Coordinate the Steering Committee and monitor that the Virtual Operation Teams meet periodically to evaluate performance, address issues, and if necessary escalate.
•Review status reports and prepare updates for Senior leadership.
•In collaboration with technical and quality teams, periodically review process performance, quality trends, and agree on process improvement plans.
•Establish governance, guidelines, and communication channels. Ensure in coordination with the quality units that the supplier has the required quality systems and documentation to meet regulatory requirements, follow up inspection responses and commitments.
•Coordinate with QA, the annual quality management review and periodic audits of the TPM. Ensure deviations are properly investigated and product disposition decisions are made in a timely manner. Establish performance metrics and periodically track performance.
•Develop, implement and manage the programs or projects such as scope, cost, time & resource management, communication and risk management through the initiating, planning and executing phases of the project.

•Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in science or technical related field. MSc or MBA degree is preferred.
•A minimum of 10+ years of experience, in areas such as: manufacturing, engineering, project management, quality and S&T.
•The individual needs a broad business perspective, knowledge and understanding of manufacturing processes.
•Strong project experience and an ability to influence others are essential.
•Previous experience managing subcontracted relationships preferred.
•Proven leadership ability with superior communication skills including listening, verbal, presentation and written.
•Strong strategy development and planning skills coupled with necessary knowledge of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing and supply activities.
•Issue identification and strong problem analysis and solution development skills.
•Demonstrated team player and ability to work in a globally oriented work environment.
•Strong knowledge of business financial systems and tools

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
As Construction Project Manager at COS you will lead, manage and coordinate a variety of different construction projects globally with a high level of professionalism and in respect of cost, time, quality, compliance and sustainability. You ensure that the brand identity, DNA and specific customer needs are understood and incorporated in all relevant work, such as new store projects, rebuilds and optimisations.

What you will do:

  • You will work closely with the COS store design and NCG ( non commercial goods) teams to prepare budgets and business cases, ensuring financial transparency and appropriate sign-off. You will also follow up on costs.
  • You will take responsibility for the accuracy of construction budgets and timelines, collaborating with local teams to understand market-specific challenges.
  • You will drive value engineering in every project, recommending improvements for future projects, COS How to Build, and Facility Management guidelines.
  • You will visit local construction teams to coach, motivate, and ensure they deliver projects and Facility Management services efficiently and within set KPIs, meeting COS’s standards and expectations.
  • You will collaborate with stakeholders in COS, markets, and global expansion to drive continuous improvements in developments, standards, processes, and communication.
  • You will work closely with the Head of C&F to implement the department’s strategy and translate it into operational activities and actions.
  • You will understand and clarify COS’s needs regarding project processes and investment handling to the markets.
  • You will learn about and understand potential challenges and opportunities specific to different markets, both internal and external, and provide feedback and recommend solutions.
  • You will understand change orders and their origins, challenge them, and provide alternative solutions, creating an action plan to avoid them in the future.
  • You will collaborate with all functions in the Growth team, contributing to efficient information flow and leading the department towards set long- and short-term goals.
  • You will have an overview of COS’s long-term pipeline, including larger facility investments, portfolio composition changes, and new markets, ensuring timely actions.
  • You will be involved in developing new and existing store concepts and interiors, bringing expertise in constructing and maintaining stores, as well as innovation within the built environment.
  • You will secure COS’s energy management in both existing stores and future portfolio changes.
  • Proven experience in retail construction or facilities project management.
  • Exceptional communication and teamwork skills.
  • Thrives in an international environment.
  • Proactive approach to work tasks and responsibilities.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of coordinating multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Forward-thinking mindset when creating processes.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Behaviours based on our values

  • Delivery & Execution: Ability to produce high-quality, accurate work, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines. You should also be able to demonstrate resilience under pressure.
  • Problem Solving & Judgment: Ability to analyse issues logically, use data and evidence to guide decisions & anticipate and address issues before they arise.
  • Communication: Able to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, you should be able to explain technical or complex points simply and keep stakeholders informed and updated.
  • Collaboration: Abiloity to work constructively with other colleagues, share knowledge and support teammates. You should also be openminded and accept feedback professionally.
  • Adaptable & Curious: You should be able to adjust to changing priorities, learns new tools and processes quickly and show curiosity and self-development

This is a full time permanent contract based at our Head Office in London .

If you feel this opportunity is exciting feel free to apply by sending in your CV and Portfolio in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

We value collaboration and believe that great ideas thrive when we work closely together. Therefore, this role is primarily office-based, with 3 days per week at the office to foster teamwork and engagement. 2 day per week, you’ll have the flexibility to work remotely.

Please note this position is offered on a local contract, therefore you should have the legal right to work in UK before applying. Other candidates are welcome to register their interest, and we will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

We offer all our employees attractive benefits with broad development opportunities. All our employees receive a staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to this UK- based colleagues also receive

  • Up to 25 days holiday
  • Annual health checks
  • Pension scheme
  • Discounts on various activities and financial/lifestyle products via our benefits hub
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Employee assistance via retail trust
  • Private health & dental care

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Associate, Infrastructure Debt
description:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate, Infrastructure Debt.

Join HSBC Global Asset Management (UK) as an Associate in our Infrastructure Debt Investments team, based in London. This role supports the team’s work to originate and assess infrastructure debt opportunities, secure internal approvals and manage portfolio monitoring and reporting. You’ll help the team serve clients better by expanding the opportunity set while maintaining strong process discipline and controls. The environment is fast-paced with complex investment analysis and demanding timetables alongside ambitious fundraising and capital deployment targets. Success means producing high-quality analysis and materials that support investment decisions, keeping reporting accurate and timely and helping the team meet its investment excellence objectives for deployment, credit losses and yield.

If you want your work to support high-quality investment decisions and better outcomes for clients, this role offers real breadth. The team’s priorities are clear - deploy capital responsibly, manage risk well and deliver the expected return profile in changing markets.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In this role you’ll:

  • Originate and assess infrastructure debt investment opportunities to expand the pipeline for the team
  • Evaluate transaction risks through credit analysis, due diligence review and detailed assessment of financial accounts
  • Build and review financial models in Excel to support investment decision-making and internal approvals
  • Prepare materials for internal governance and approval processes in line with desk procedures and mandate restrictions
  • Monitor portfolio investments and support ongoing risk assessment aligned to return and risk profile objectives
  • Produce accurate client reporting and respond to client enquiries with a focus on timeliness and quality
  • Maintain and update team documents and procedures and partner with Risk, Regulatory Compliance and Financial Crime Compliance where needed
  • Create marketing and capital-raising materials that support fundraising activity and prospective client engagement

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:

  • Demonstrable experience in investment-grade and/or non-investment-grade infrastructure debt or project finance, gained through lending, advisory or investment activities, with experience extending beyond portfolio management.
  • Apply strong credit analysis and risk assessment skills, including the ability to evaluate key transaction risks.
  • Review due diligence reports and financial accounts thoroughly and critically.
  • Build and assess robust financial models, with strong Excel skills.
  • Communicate clearly and accurately in English through investment papers, reports and client communications.
  • Manage competing priorities effectively through strong organisation, planning and time management.
  • Collaborate effectively with investment, product specialist and control functions, engaging directly with clients where required.
  • Show a genuine interest in the infrastructure sector and its evolving market conditions; knowledge of relevant rating agency methodologies and ESG assessment experience would be advantageous.

Opening up a world of opportunity.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com.

title: Construction Inspector 1-4
description:
About this Job


At the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (DOTD), we plan, build, maintain, and protect the transportation systems that connect communities, support commerce, and keep Louisiana moving. Please visit our DOTD Career Center for more information about our agency.

Help ensure Louisiana’s road and bridge projects are built safely, accurately, and in accordance with DOTD standards, specifications, and contract requirements. Construction Inspectors support DOTD Project Engineers and higher-level inspectors by performing field inspections, materials observation, and construction documentation on active roadway, bridge, and drainage projects.

No prior construction inspection experience is required — training is provided, with opportunities for career progression and advancement through the Construction Inspector job series.

This is an outdoor, physically active role that may involve traffic exposure, varying weather conditions, extended workdays, night work, or changing schedules based on construction needs.

Positions are located in Ouachita Parish, District 05/Unit 245 and report to Construction Inspector Supervisor.


Minimum Qualifications

Possession of a high school diploma or GED; OR

Six months of experience in sub-professional engineering, heavy mobile equipment operation, or mobile equipment maintenance.

Job Specification

Job Duties:

  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including field notes, diaries, test reports, and estimates;
  • Enter construction project data into required systems (e.g., Site Manager or other DOTD applications);
  • Participate in required training and structured certification programs;
  • Support public interaction and coordination during construction activities, as needed;
  • Assist with emergency or disaster response activities when required.

  • Construction Inspector 2 - $17.15/hourly

Additional compensation may be considered impart with extraordinary qualifications in accordance with State Civil Service Rules and DOTD policy.

Career Progression: Vacancies may be filled as Construction Inspector 1, 2, 3, or 4 based on qualifications and agency needs.

Appointment Type: This position may be filled as either a probational appointment (open to all qualified applicants); a promotion (open to all statewide classified and Agency-wide permanent status employees); or by detail to special duty.

title: Senior Engineer Manufacturing Engineering (Equipment)
description:
The Equipment Engineer is responsible for equipment troubleshooting, installation, qualification, modification, automation, and continuous improvement to ensure stable, reliable, and efficient equipment performance. Mechanical, electrical, software, AI, and automation solutions are designed and integrated to enhance process equipment capability and automation tooling performance. Maintenance procedures, technical documentation, safety standards, and technician training are developed, while equipment projects, equipment characterization, and manufacturing capability development are supported.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Equipment troubleshooting, installation, qualification, modification, and continuous improvement are supported across manufacturing lines.
  • Equipment automation and upgrades are developed and implemented using AI and the latest automation technologies to improve equipment stability, performance, and productivity.
  • Electrical drawings, wiring layouts, software debugging, and control systems are prepared and maintained for process equipment.
  • Different equipment modules and systems are integrated to ensure stable and reliable operation.
  • Mechanical and electrical components are designed, modified, and assembled to improve equipment performance across various process requirements.
  • Process parameters are monitored and optimized to achieve consistent output quality and performance targets.
  • Maintenance, troubleshooting, and testing procedures are developed for equipment electrical and mechanical components.
  • Equipment characterization and capability studies are performed to ensure equipment meets required quality, performance, and specification standards.
  • Equipment design, modification, expansion, and automation projects are supported.
  • SOPs, safety procedures, environmental requirements, and HIRAC documentation are prepared and maintained.
  • Technical and safety training are provided, and safety guidelines are established for equipment technicians.
  • Process, manufacturing, automation teams, and suppliers are closely collaborated with to identify problems, develop solutions, and drive equipment improvements.
  • Consumable usage and equipment-related costs are monitored and optimized to reduce cost of ownership.
  • Equipment-related data is collected and analyzed to support continuous improvement and predictive maintenance initiatives.

REQUIRED:

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Materials Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related engineering field.
  • Fresh graduates with relevant engineering qualifications are encouraged to apply.

PREFERRED:

  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on equipment, automation, electrical/mechanical systems, or process equipment
  • Good problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills related to surface finishing and polishing processes
  • Experience or strong interest in CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization), polishing automation, AI-based process control, robotics, and new technologies

title: Data Analyst
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Join the Supply Chain organization and play a key role in the In-Season Optimisation area. You’ll work with Gen-AI technologies and leverage SQL, programming tools, and BI best practices to deliver actionable insights and optimize product performance. You will:

  • Translate business processes and objectives into data-driven insights, helping the organization understand performance and make strategic decisions throughout the value chain.
  • Support the analysis and optimization of replenishment, helping improve how, when, and how much stock is replenished to stores to increase product availability while maintaining healthy inventory levels.
  • Analyze and support the optimization of inventory movements across the supply chain, including warehouse-to-warehouse stock movements, to ensure stock is positioned where it is needed.
  • Understand how cross-functional initiatives and programs impact what we do and the decisions we make.
  • Translate large volumes of data into actionable insights that guide strategic decisions across fashion retail and supply chain.
  • Define, monitor, and visualize key KPIs to drive transparency and measure impact.
  • Lead data modelling conversations to ensure optimal data structures and model performance within your product area.
  • Act as the go-to analytics expert within your business and product team, collaborating end-to-end on data-driven business development, value realization and business case validation.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll be part of a truly international and cross-functional team, working closely with Business Process Leads, Data Scientists, Business Experts, and Product Managers. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do; our team brings together diverse backgrounds and perspectives to solve complex challenges and create real value for millions of customers across global markets. We work in an agile setup that encourages experimentation, continuous learning, and open dialogue.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

  • A degree in Economics, Business, Supply Chain, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in analytics roles, ideally within retail, fashion, supply chain, or other data driven environments. Experience working with inventory management, or supply chain optimization is a plus.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, or R. Experience with modern data tools and development practices, such as Git, Dataform, or dbt, is a plus.
  • A solid understanding of analytical methods applied to real-world data problems.
  • Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or similar.

And people who are…

  • Strategic thinkers with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for solving complex problems.
  • Curious and eager to learn, with a genuine interest in the fashion industry and how data can help solve real business and supply chain challenges.
  • Clear communicators who can transform data into compelling stories and practical recommendations.
  • Team players who thrive in collaborative, agile environments and are comfortable working with a range of stakeholders.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

We offer all our employee’s attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a 25% staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

title: Senior Equipment Engineer
description:
The Equipment Engineer is responsible for equipment troubleshooting, installation, qualification, modification, automation, and continuous improvement to ensure stable, reliable, and efficient equipment performance. Mechanical, electrical, software, AI, and automation solutions are designed and integrated to enhance process equipment capability and automation tooling performance. Maintenance procedures, technical documentation, safety standards, and technician training are developed, while equipment projects, equipment characterization, and manufacturing capability development are supported.

  • Good problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills related to surface finishing and polishing processes
  • Experience or strong interest in CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization), polishing automation, AI-based process control, robotics, and new technologies

title: Senior Pentester (Security Engineer)
description:
About us:

We are looking for a Senior Pentester (Security Engineer)
 to be a part of the DEVTALENTS team and contribute to the development of truly amazing solutions for businesses all over the world.

Joining DEVTALENTS can be a life-changing decision for you, with endless benefits along the way. We provide top projects for which recruitment is not possible externally because of our wide range of partners. We value open and transparent communication, leveraging tools like Slack and generative AI to enhance collaboration and efficiency. We support continuous growth, encouraging you to step beyond your comfort zone and develop technically and personally. We are looking for an experienced Senior Pentester (Security Engineer) to join our team and provide technical leadership and mentorship.


Your Role:



  • Conduct in-depth penetration tests (white-box and black-box) on both internal and customer-facing applications, services, and infrastructure.

  • Oversee, prioritize, and analyze bug bounty submissions, as well as findings from external penetration tests.

  • Perform variant analysis on disclosed vulnerabilities across multiple platforms and frameworks.

  • Investigate and review third-party solutions to ensure they meet our security standards.

  • Create and refine tools for reconnaissance, process automation, and ongoing metrics and performance tracking.

  • Offer expert advice to engineering and security operations teams, providing clear remediation strategies and deeper insight into identified issues.

  • Promote offensive security principles by hosting demos, workshops, and training sessions, building a stronger security-minded culture.

  • Evaluate our technology stack through the most effective methods available, adapting your approach as the environment evolves.

  • Determine priorities and focus areas to maximize value and impact.

  • Contribute significantly to the ongoing development and maturity of our security program.

Technical Expertise:

  • Proven track record in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and other technical security evaluations.

  • Strong ability to find, understand, and articulate security flaws in code, particularly in Java and Node.js environments.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructures, especially AWS, and familiarity with modern microservice-oriented architectures.

  • Exceptional communication skills, capable of clearly conveying findings and suggesting pragmatic, targeted improvements rather than merely reporting issues.

  • Comfortable scripting in Python and contributing to more extensive security tooling or automation projects.

  • Self-driven, with the initiative to spearhead projects that strengthen the broader security culture and foundations.

  • Hold one or more reputable industry certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSWE, CREST, GIAC, AWS certifications).

  • Active participant in CTFs and the broader cybersecurity community, staying current on emerging threats and best practices.

  • Higher education with a profile in Computer Science or related

  • English level min. B2.


Mindset & Approach:

  • Strong communication skills, capable of translating complex cybersecurity concepts into understandable terms for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Traffic Monitoring Operator - Virginia Beach
description:
AECOM is seeking Traffic Monitoring Operator(s) located in Virginia Beach, VA. The shift hours available for the position(s) are 3rd shift (9:15 pm – 5:45 am). The pay rate is $22.00/hour.

The operator position uses several software platforms and web-based applications to perform tasks. Transportation Operations Center (TOC) Operators are responsible for using Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) software to monitor Department roadways and manage events/incidents; dispatching incident management personnel through 2-way radios; and communicating, coordinating, and collaborating with other staff, Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) personnel, and partner agencies.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

The TOC in Virginia Beach, VA houses a 24/7/365 program that delivers incident management, dispatching, and traveler information services on Virginia’s roadways. AECOM operations staff serve at the TOC facility on shifts to continuously respond to changing traffic conditions and impacts to traffic flow and safety through direct communication with first responders, VDOT staff, Virginia State Police (VSP) and mobility stakeholders of VDOT.

The routine responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use software and applications to control and monitor various Intelligent Transportation Systems devices located along freeways, such as closed-circuit television (CCTV) cameras, dynamic message signs (DMS), and Highway Advisory Radios (HAR) located on the interstate infrastructure.
  • Monitor camera video and other information sources for the detection and verification of events that impact traffic flow and safety, such as motorist assists, traffic crashes, debris removal, abandoned vehicles, stalled vehicles, maintenance activity, and construction activity.
  • Log potential and confirmed events that impact traffic flow and safety using software applications, including traffic lane and road shoulder closures related to construction and maintenance activity.
  • Dispatch Safety Service patrollers, who provide roadside services on freeways in the Hampton Roads area related to traffic crashes and roadway hazard events using two-way radio systems.

COMMUNICATION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform communication tasks consistent with the program’s high level of customer service expectations and training.
  • Dispatch and communicate with SSP patrollers, using program-directed radio and/or phone communication protocols.
  • Communicate with appropriate local agencies, authorities, and wrecker companies to effectively monitor and clear traffic incidents.
  • Answer phone calls and provide information to VDOT personnel, or other agencies on traffic and road conditions, transfer calls to designated personnel as appropriate.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS :

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Be a minimum of 18 years of age.
  • Must pass a State and Federal criminal history/security background check; must also successfully complete Virginia Department of Transportation fingerprint -based criminal History Records Check (CHRC).
  • Must pass a pre-employment drug screen and successfully participate in the program’s mandatory random drug screening process.
  • Constantly operate a computer and other monitoring equipment.
  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time monitoring Intelligent Transportation Systems such CCTV camera displays, meters, law enforcement radio broadcasts, answering/responding to calls and communicating to other staff or partner agencies.
  • Ability to operate software platforms and web-based applications.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule associated with the needs of the operations.
  • Previous experience working in a call center, customer service, 911 Operator or dispatching environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet a high level of customer service expectations.
  • Ability to work in a calm manner and professional manner in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Previous experience working in a position which includes heavy telephone, radio, and computer usage.
  • Effective oral and written communications skills for in-person, radio, and phone conversations.
  • Ability to interpret or understand geographic information portrayed on a map and map-based applications.
  • TOMC operator certifications for levels 1 and 2 preferred.
  • Knowledge of interstates and state routes throughout Virginia with geographic familiarity of the freeway system and arterial roads.
  • Efficient and accurate data entry skills.
  • Working knowledge of and skill set to utilize and operate an ATMS software platform and/or web-based applications.
  • Knowledge of incident management response techniques and municipality and area traffic management organizations.
  • Associate’s degree in Civil Engineering, transportation related field or a combination of education and practical experience in a similar field.
  • This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization.
  • This position does not include relocation benefits.
  • This is NOT a remote position, but located on the client site locations.
  • Opportunities for overtime hours and pay are also available.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
