title: Construction Project Manager - Sales Market Denmark/Norway/Iceland
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As a Construction Project Manager, you will lead and manage retail construction projects from planning through handover, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to H&M standards, quality requirements, and Health & Safety regulations. You will play a key role in supporting our store expansion and optimization agenda across Denmark, Norway, and Iceland.
Your main responsibilities are:

  • Prepare project budgets, business cases, risk analyses, and project plans for new stores, relocations, rebuilds, and refurbishments.
  • Review contracts to ensure all project and country-specific risks are covered and attach execution and payment schedules accordingly.
  • Manage construction projects throughout the entire lifecycle, from pre-construction and permitting to execution and handover.
  • Coordinate consultants, contractors, landlords, and authorities to secure successful project delivery.
  • Monitor project progress through site visits and project meetings, ensuring compliance with timelines, budgets, quality standards, and company requirements.
  • Manage project finances, change orders, payment schedules, and contractual obligations throughout the project lifecycle.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Leasing Managers, Controlling, Procurement Specialists, Store Operations teams, Sales teams, General Contractors, Consultants, landlords, and external authorities. You will be part of a cross-functional expansion team working together to deliver sustainable and cost-efficient retail projects across the Sales Market.

WHO YOU ARE​
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical construction expertise with excellent project management capabilities.
We are looking for people with…​

  • A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Construction Management, or a related field. Project Management certification is considered an advantage.
  • Several years of experience within retail construction, facility management, real estate, or a related industry.
  • On-site experience dealing with construction-related contingencies.
  • Proven experience managing construction projects and coordinating multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, MS Teams, and preferably Power BI.

As a person, you are:

  • Structured, organized, and detail-oriented.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to anticipate challenges and drive solutions.
  • Collaborative and communicative, building strong relationships across functions and external partners.
  • A team player who acts in line with H&M's values and growth mindset.
  • You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in a Scandinavian language is considered a strong advantage.

WHO WE ARE​
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

JOIN US​
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, apply by sending your application in ENGLISH as soon as possible but no later than November 22nd, 2026. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

This is a permanent position. The position is based in our Support Office in Copenhagen and reports to the Construction & Facility Manager.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​

title: Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization
description:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Software Engineer, Billing /& Monetization to join our Billing team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a high-growth scale-up, you'll have the unique opportunity to drive innovation at scale while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance.

Klik hieronder op \'Solliciteren\' om uw sollicitatie ter overweging in te dienen. Zorg ervoor dat uw cv up-to-date is en dat u eerst de functie-eisen heeft gelezen.

About the role:
- ---

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on the systems this team owns: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. As we move from seats to usage and credits for our agentic products, these systems become as strategic as the product itself, and they have to be fast, accurate and trustworthy.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who cares about correctness as much as speed, and wants to see the commercial impact of their code.

Why DataSnipper?
- ---

*The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.*

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

**For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting.** In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than **600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries** rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than **$1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers**. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, *this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.*

What You Will Do:
- ---

### Metering /& Billing

* Build real-time **usage metering** and **credit consumption** for our agentic products, accurate down to the individual agent run

* Design pricing and rating logic that supports seats, usage, credits and enterprise contract terms without a rewrite for every new plan

* Integrate with billing, payment and finance systems (e.g. **Stripe**, CRM and ERP), and keep them reconciled

### Licensing /& Onboarding

* Build the **entitlements service** that decides what every user and tenant can do, enforced consistently across the Excel add-in and Alwin

* Own the onboarding flow end-to-end: sign-up, trials, provisioning, SSO and SCIM, and the first-run experience

* Instrument activation and conversion, and work with Product and Design to remove friction

### Engineering /& Collaboration

* Build systems where **correctness is non-negotiable**: idempotent, auditable, observable and secure

* **Own it end-to-end** , from design to production in our **Python** stack on **Azure** through to the web and add-in front ends. Anticipate issues, and shape the team's technical direction without waiting to be asked

* **Influence across functions**: partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success, using data and empathy to turn pricing, packaging and licensing decisions into robust implementation

* **Raise the bar** through code reviews, mentorship and clear, balanced feedback, and ask for the same in return

What You Bring:
- ---

### Must-Have

* **6+ years** in software engineering, with strong, production-grade backend experience (ideally **Python**)

* Experience building **billing, metering, licensing or entitlement systems** in production

* Solid experience building **data-driven web APIs** and distributed systems on a major **cloud platform**

* A strong grasp of **financial correctness**: idempotency, consistency, reconciliation and audit trails

* Strong fundamentals in **software architecture** , **system design** and **data modelling**

* Product mindset: you care about activation, conversion and revenue as much as uptime

* Sound judgment under ambiguity: you balance speed and accuracy, stay calm when plans change, and reprioritise without being told

* Proficient with **AI-assisted engineering** (we use Claude Code)

* Excellent communication; you can work directly with Finance and commercial teams to define what "correct" means

### Nice-to-Have

* **Usage- or credit-based billing** in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution

* Billing and payment platforms (e.g. **Stripe** ), CRM (e.g. **Salesforce**) and ERP integrations

* Identity and provisioning: **SSO** , **SCIM**, multi-tenant account models

* **Product-led growth**: self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades

* Revenue recognition, invoicing and tax basics

* Event streaming and high-volume data pipelines

* Scale-up experience, ideally in SaaS, fintech or audit tech

What We Offer:
- ---

* Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

* Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

* Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

* 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

* Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

* Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

* NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

* Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

* Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

* Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

* Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

Recruitment Process:
- ---

* Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

* Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

* Live coding Interview (75 minutes, online)

* System design interview (60 minutes, on-site)

* Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

*At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.*

*Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. xgiwjmb *

*We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.*

*What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper.*

title: Dangerous Goods Specialist
description:
Heb jij ervaring als Logistiek en/of Warehouse Medewerker en woon je in de omgeving van Schiphol-Rijk? Kom dan bij SGS werken en wij leiden je op tot Dangerous Goods Specialist!

Als Dangerous Goods Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor de administratieve, operationele en logistieke werkzaamheden rondom het gereed maken van zendingen met gevaarlijke stoffen en goederen. Je krijgt een baan waar je lichamelijk werk afwisselt met bureauwerk, de verdeling hiervan is ongeveer 60% operationeel en 40% administratief.

Je werkt op de afdeling Sample Management Dangerous Goods & Cargo en geeft advies aan onze klanten. Je hebt klantcontact per mail en telefoon en daarnaast schakel je regelmatig met chauffeurs en collega’s.

Wat je nog meer gaat doen als je bij ons komt werken als Dangerous Goods Specialist:

  • Het ontvangen en controleren van inkomende goederen en gevaarlijke stoffen
  • Het verpakken labelen en verzenden van goederen
  • Het opmaken van vervoersdocumenten
  • Controle en behandeling van zendingen op locatie bij klanten
  • Het uitbrengen van offertes

Heb je werkervaring of een afgeronde Mbo-opleiding in de richting van transport of logistiek? Dat is een mooie basis voor deze baan! Verder herken jij jezelf in de volgende competenties en vaardigheden.

Je hebt een hekel aan saai werk! Je bent niet bang om je handen uit je mouwen te steken en je wil jezelf graag verder verdiepen en ontwikkelen binnen het vak. Je werkt op Mbo-niveau en hebt een klantvriendelijke instelling. Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal en je hebt een rijbewijs, zodat je ook bij klanten op locaties werkzaamheden kunt uitvoeren.

Om veilig te kunnen werken in ons magazijn ben je in het bezit van de volgende certificaten. Zo niet? Dan kun je bij SGS deze certificaten halen nadat je aan de slag bent gegaan.

  • Vca-certificaat
  • ADR awareness-certificaat
  • Heftruck-certificaat

Verder bestaat de basis opleiding uit een IATA DG-opleiding en een IMDG-training.

Bij ons krijg je een zelfstandige en veelzijdige baan met veel verantwoordelijkheid. We besteden veel aandacht aan jouw persoonlijke en professionele groei en ontwikkeling. Verder bieden we je:

  • Een salaris tussen €2.610 en €3.400, passend bij jouw kennis, ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie
  • 32 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur)
  • 8 % vakantiegeld
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: je ontvangt een vergoeding van €0,21 per kilometer voor woon-werkverkeer
  • Mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen SGS
  • Deelname aan de pensioenregeling met vaste medewerker bijdrage van 6%
  • Deelname aan het SGS sport- en fietsplan
  • Actieve personeelsvereniging: word lid en geniet van leuke activiteiten en evenementen.

Is dit de baan die je zoekt? Solliciteer snel! Wil je eerst meer weten? Onze Corporate Recruiter Anne Martiene Gerritsen helpt je graag 06 – 51209983

Bureaus, acquisitie niet nodig! Cv’s zonder verzoek zijn eigendom van SGS zonder vergoeding!

title: Senior Associate, Data Analysis, Italy
description:

title: Creative Producer
description:
We are Disturbia; a UK based fashion and lifestyle brand for the people who play on the outskirts of mainstream; we celebrate the unusual, the quirky and the people who are gloriously themselves.
Our passions span folklore to psychodelia; magical fairytales to poison gardens, historic literature to witchcraft and all the other weird rabbit holes we can fall down.
Over the last 20 years, our growing in-house team of creatives, do-ers, dreamers and makers have been creating distinctive products and delivering an exceptional experience for those of you who dare to stand out from the crowd.
The spirit of our collections comes from the spirit inside our company. We’re a team of honest, humble, creatively minded souls across our offices in the North East and London. We all dream of the same goal; to grow a brand which enables millions of people to realise their unique selves.
Our designs are informed and inspired by the outcast, the esoteric, and the occult- we're always spinning fashion trends on their head in new and unexpected ways. We stand for the other in society and always want to do right by our community - all while having a hell of a lot of fun in the process.
We are a fast growing and dynamic environment; and we don’t believe it bureaucracy for bureaucracy sake – you won’t find pointless red tape around here. We value bright ideas and voices which want to be heard. If you want to do your best work and come and work in environment which reflects you true self, come and join us and make some magic.

As Disturbia continues to grow, the need has arisen to hire a Creative Producer, with at least 3 years’ experience, to join our Brand Team in London.

Our aesthetic is rooted in the whimsical, witchy, and esoteric — think celestial motifs, folk magic, alchemical symbols, dreamy botanicals, and vintage occult references. We're looking for someone who can partner with the Creative Lead and Head of Brand Development to elevate our content across the whole of Disturbia.


You’ll play a key role in running end-to-end production on all our creative shoots, whilst being the go-to person for pre-production, securing teams, on set production and working all the way through to delivery of assets.

The successful candidate should aim to meet the following capability requirements:
  • Work collaboratively with the Lead Creative and Head of Brand to deliver on brand, best in class photography and videography content that aligns with the brand's vision.
  • Leading production on creative shoots within allocated budget, developing shoot decks, shot lists and schedules. Production lead across pre-production, on set and post production.
  • Running production on set.
  • Working across production on shoots locally, remotely and on destination.
  • Retouch and edit notes for creatives. QC-ing all assets across motion and stills.
  • Managing and developing budgets including negotiating competitive prices with an understanding of industry rates. Reconciling budgets and processing invoices.
  • Managing timelines and ensuring deadlines are met.
  • Art buying, sourcing crew and suggesting best talent suitable for briefs. Sourcing new talent & curating a black book of teams for the brand to work with that executes the brands vision.
  • Efficient management and delivery of all allocated projects against a critical path and budgeted cost per style.
  • Effectively communicate the creative vision and requirements to team members, ensuring everyone is aligned on the project's goals.
  • Working with buying and design for sample management across campaigns. Collaborating on sample availability and working alongside the Sample Co-Ordinator to make sure required samples are available on time to meet deadlines for creative shoots.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues that arise during the shoot, ensuring a smooth and efficient production process.
  • Collaborating on creation and maintenance of organisation tools and documents created for shoot management.
  • Support the creative lead and Head of Brand as needed on campaign concepting, styling and creative elements.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience working end-to-end on shoot production or in a similar role
  • Experience with stills & video production is necessary
  • Excellent organisation, administration and presentation skills are a must.
  • Experience in fashion preferred.
  • Systems and data management: confident with excel, project management systems & reporting
  • Presentation skills: strong presentation skills required, experience with canva and miro beneficial
  • Problem solving: You are proactive, solutions-focused and comfortable making practical recommendations that support smooth production
  • Budget Management: comfortable working to a budget, negotiating rates with freelancers, logging invoices & tracking costs.
Personal Qualities
  • Creative and curious — you love exploring new visual languages and weaving stories into your work
  • Strong communicator — able to share ideas clearly and take on feedback with openness and positivity
  • Highly organised — able to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines without losing attention to detail
  • Team-oriented — you enjoy collaborating, contributing ideas, and supporting others in a close-knit team
  • Self-motivated and adaptable — comfortable working independently, showing initiative, and adapting to a growing brand’s needs
  • Passionate and aligned — you resonate with our brand’s vision and aesthetic, and bring that energy to everything you do
  • Holiday allowance starting at 23 days, on top of bank holidays, increasing with length of service.
  • Annual purchase scheme
  • Hybrid and flexible working.
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Store discount- 30% after probationary period and 50% after a years service
  • Sample sale in both offices
  • Friends & Family Discount
  • Regular socials and social fund
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Birthday treats
  • We believe that creative freedom needs space to breathe; this is why we offer flexible working hours, 2 days a week working from home and a respect for the life you have outside of our walls.
  • We would be nothing without our community of creative folk; we celebrate our whole together twice a year within a company wide social

It is intended as a unique career pathway to develop skills in wastewater and stormwater industry and is not intended as a permanent position.

The Good Neighbor Ambassador provides various community benefit services to the Sewer District’s service area while delivering exceptional service to ensure the Sewer District is represented professionally and effectively. Works on a variety of projects throughout the community to improve neighborhood vitality. Candidate must possess a high school diploma from an accredited institution, GED or state recognized equivalent.

No previous experience required.

title: Azure Infra Consultant
description:
Role Summary:

This role encompasses creating and maintaining scalable, reliable, and highly automated platforms for supporting development and operational activities. The candidate will work at the intersection of software development, operations, and cloud computing, using Azure as a key foundation to deliver a best-in-class developer and operational experience.

The role's primary focus is to enable development and DevOps teams by building shared application and infrastructure platforms, ensuring security, scalability, and standardization across the organization

Key Responsibilities:

· Platform Development and Maintenance: Design, implement, and maintain a shared platform that provides development teams with self-service capabilities for infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and other common needs.

· Environment Deployment Management: Manage infrastructure and deployments across Production and non-Production environments by using scalable and automated processes. Ensure that deployments are predictable, reliable, and error-free.

· Developer Experience Optimization: Work closely with software development teams to understand their workflows, challenges, and goals, creating tools and processes that improve productivity and reduce friction in the developer lifecycle. Standardize tooling and processes across teams for consistency and reliability.

· Automation and Process Improvement: Drive the automation of infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and application deployment pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and scripting languages. Focus on minimizing manual intervention.

· Security and Compliance by Design: Integrate security and compliance requirements into platform solutions from the outset. Collaborate with security teams to implement processes and tools that ensure systems remain secure and adhere to internal and external standards.

· Observability and Monitoring: Establish best practices and tooling for observability, including monitoring, logging, and tracing, to provide full visibility into both the performance and operational status of the platform. Ensure systems are highly available and resilient.

· Collaboration and Enablement: Act as the bridge between software development and operations teams, fostering a culture of collaboration. Provide education and documentation to enable teams to make effective use of the platform. Deliver reusable templates, libraries, and tools to simplify engineering workflows.

· Lifecycle Management and Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate the platform for improvement opportunities based on evolving development team and organizational requirements. Introduce innovations that improve platform reliability, scalability, and usability.

· Problem Identification and Resolution: Engineer solutions to address technical challenges that arise with infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and application operations, collaborating across teams to troubleshoot and implement permanent fixes.

Required Skills & Experience:

· 5+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Engineering roles with proven knowledge of Azure.

· Advanced knowledge of Azure services (App Services, Networking, Functions, Storage, Security features like Azure AD, and Key Vault).

· Expertise with ARM templates, Bicep, and Terraform for automated infrastructure provisioning.

· Ability to design and implement Azure service architecture that balances scalability, reliability, security, and cost.

· Deep understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles with tools like Terraform (preferred), ARM/Bicep, or Ansible.

· Proficient in automation scripting using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.

· Advanced experience managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or equivalent tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

· Experience designing self-service platforms that empower developers to independently provision infrastructure and deploy code using developer tools.

· Strong orientation towards standardization, modularization, and reusability of platform components.

· Expertise in designing resilient systems with automated failover and disaster recovery solutions.

· Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (e.g., Azure Monitor, ELK, Prometheus/Grafana, or Datadog) for actionable system insights.

· Experience embedding policies, security measures, and compliance checks into platform workflows (e.g., using Azure Policy, Azure Security Center, or similar tools).

· Understanding of role-based access control (RBAC) and governance frameworks for large-scale enterprise environments.

· Ability to look at systems holistically, identifying bottlenecks and architecting for scalability and performance.

· Strong understanding of non-functional testing disciplines like performance, security, availability, and compliance testing.

· Track record of building and scaling platforms in a high-growth and/or business critical environment with a focus on developer experience.

· Experience of supporting, manging and troubleshooting web application tech stacks running on cloud native platforms.

· Experience in medium to large-scale cloud infrastructures with knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery strategies, and distributed systems.

· Excellent collaboration skills, with an emphasis on enabling team success and shared accountability across development and operations teams.

· Ability to document, present, and train development teams on platform capabilities.

Certifications:

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate- AZ-104

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert – AZ-305

Educational qualification:

  • BE, BTech, BCA, BSc (IT) MCA, MBA (IT) and MSc(IT)

Experience :

  • 5+ Years of experience

title: Commercial Fence Technician
description:
Commercial Fence Technician

Welcome to Empire Netting & Fence – A Crown Co. Company | $20–$28 per hour | Full-Time

At Empire Netting & Fence, we're looking for a Local Commercial Fence Technician who enjoys working outdoors, takes pride in quality craftsmanship, and values being part of a dependable team.

We believe in working hard, enjoying life outside of work, and surrounding ourselves with people who have each other's backs.

Job Description

As a Local Commercial Fence Technician, you'll install various types of fencing, gates, and railing systems for commercial and residential properties. You'll work alongside an experienced crew to complete projects safely, efficiently, and to high-quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install commercial and residential fencing, gates, railings, and related materials.
  • Measure, lay out, dig post holes, set posts, and pour concrete for fence installations.
  • Safely operate hand tools, power tools, and fencing equipment.
  • Read tape measures, use levels, and follow project layouts and installation specifications.
  • Assist with loading, unloading, and transporting materials and equipment.
  • Maintain clean, organized job sites, tools, vehicles, and equipment.
  • Follow safety procedures and work with teammates to complete projects on schedule.
  • Assist with equipment maintenance and learn to operate machinery as needed.

Job Requirements

We're looking for a dependable Local Commercial Fence Technician with a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow.

Required Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in construction, landscaping, fencing, or other hands-on labor preferred.
  • Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and measuring equipment.
  • Basic knowledge of measurements, leveling, and construction practices.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and perform physically demanding tasks outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality.
  • Availability Monday–Friday, with occasional overtime or weekends.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous commercial fence installation experience.
  • Ability to read blueprints and construction drawings.
  • Experience operating skid loaders, telehandlers, or other construction equipment.
  • Welding experience or knowledge.
  • CDL license.
  • OSHA 10 and First Aid/CPR/AED certifications.

What's In It for You?

At Empire Netting & Fence, we believe hard work should lead somewhere. As a Local Commercial Fence Technician, you'll have opportunities to develop your skills, take on new challenges, and advance your career while enjoying the benefits of being part of the Crown Co. family.

Here's what we offer:

  • Competitive Pay: $20–$28/hour, based on experience.
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Company-Paid Benefits: Group term life insurance and short-term disability.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan and HSA options.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • Gym Membership Stipend
  • Professional Development and opportunities for advancement.
  • A Team-First Culture: Built around grit, loyalty, integrity, a positive mindset, and enjoying the journey.

Apply today and join the Empire Netting & Fence team!

title: Tender Co-Ordinator - Maternity Cover
description:
The Tender Coordinator supports the preparation and submission of high-quality market engagement responses, expressions of interest, pre-qualification questionnaires and tenders across public and private sector opportunities in the UK and Ireland.

Reporting to the Tender Unit Director, the role is part of the UK & Ireland Tender Unit and works closely with Directors, Bid and Project Managers, technical contributors, corporate functions, external partners and the wider Proposal and Marketing team.


The role helps bid teams deliver compliant, competitive submissions on time by maintaining effective governance, clear plans, accurate records and consistently high quality content throughout the opportunity and tender lifecycle.


Key responsibilities


• Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms, frameworks, shared mailboxes and
client information sources to identify and track relevant opportunities.
• Maintain the central opportunity and tender register, including deadlines, status
updates, key commercial information and auditable records.
• Support Go/No-Go and Bid/No-Bid decisions by gathering client, competitor,
commercial and delivery information and coordinating approvals.
• Coordinate PQQs and tenders from kick-off to submission, maintaining plans,
responsibilities, deadlines, compliance matrices, document trackers and review
points.
• Coordinate timely inputs from operational teams, corporate functions and external
partners, escalating risks to quality, compliance or deadlines.
• Draft, edit and proofread concise, persuasive tender content and develop supporting
CVs, case studies, organisation charts, capability statements and presentations.
• Ensure submissions meet client requirements, Egis quality standards and brand
guidelines; quality-check, compile and upload final documents ahead of deadlines.
• Create and manage tender workspaces in SharePoint and Microsoft Teams, applying
effective file structures, access controls, naming conventions and version
management.
• Maintain templates, the Tender Library, staff CVs, capability information and project references, capturing reusable content and lessons learned.
• Support post-submission clarifications, presentations, feedback reviews, reporting and
continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience is desirable.

Skills and behaviours

  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to produce concise, persuasive and accurate content.
  • Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, contributors and deadlines.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how client priorities, evaluation criteria and win themes shape a submission.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook,Teams and SharePoint.
  • Working knowledge of CRM, bid management or commercial database tools is desirable; knowledge of Adobe InDesign and Illustrator is also desirable.
  • Keen attention to detail, a strong sense of ownership and a consistent focus on quality, compliance and timely delivery.
  • A collaborative, professional and adaptable approach, with the confidence to influencecontributors and remain calm under pressure.
  • A practical improvement mindset and willingness to learn new tools, skills and processes.

Experience and knowledge

  • Demonstrable experience coordinating successful market engagement, pre-qualification and tender submissions in a structured tendering environment.
  • Proven ability to coordinate multi-disciplinary inputs and deliver compliant, high-qualitysubmissions to demanding deadlines.
  • Understanding of public and private sector procurement and tendering processes in the UK and Ireland.
  • Experience interpreting tender requirements, maintaining trackers and coordinating supporting documentation.
  • Experience of data entry, database administration, document control and structured record keeping.

Location

Hybrid working (2 days per week) out of our London HQ (Waterloo)

Working Hours:

Full time - 40 hours per week (6 Month FTC)

Package:

  • Competitive Salary, plus discretionary bonus
  • Working hours of 40 hours per week.
  • 26 days holiday, plus bank holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Workplace Pension
  • Death in Service
  • Company car scheme

title: AI Developer / Programer novih tehnologija (m/ž)

title: Senior Engineer – Geotechnical
description:
Within the Transportation business, AECOM is looking to hire a highly skilled and motivated Senior Geotechnical Engineer with a solid background to join the team located in Pretoria.

If you are passionate about geotechnical engineering and eager to work on high-profile international and local projects, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

You will be an integral part of our Ground Engineering team, working on a variety of exciting projects and collaborating with experts from around the world.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Deliver geotechnical investigation, interpretation and design services across a range of infrastructure projects.
  • Undertake geotechnical analyses and designs for foundations, retaining structures, excavations, earthworks, slope stability and settlement assessments.
  • Interpret ground investigation data and develop geotechnical parameters and recommendations for design.
  • Prepare and review geotechnical reports, calculations, specifications and drawings for feasibility, preliminary and detailed design stages.
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop practical and cost-effective design solutions.
  • Liaise with clients, contractors, authorities and other stakeholders throughout project delivery.
  • Provide technical guidance and day-to-day mentoring to graduate and junior engineers.
  • Assist with proposal preparation, tender submissions, fee estimates and technical inputs for new opportunities.
  • Support project planning, programme management and reporting on project progress.
  • Undertake site visits and provide construction-phase geotechnical support as required.
  • Collaborate with local and international Ground Engineering teams to deliver high-quality project outcomes.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience delivering geotechnical investigation and design projects, including responsibility for technical outputs and project delivery.
  • Ability to work independently on technical assignments and lead small to medium-sized geotechnical project task.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with clients, project teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing geotechnical reports, interpretative reports, specifications, calculations and design documentation.
  • Good understanding of current geotechnical design codes, standards and industry best practice. Experience with Eurocodes would be advantageous.
  • Experience in the design of shallow and deep foundations, retaining structures, earthworks, excavations and slopes.
  • Experience using geotechnical software such as Rocscience Suite (Slide, RS2, Rocfall), PLAXIS, GEO5, WALLAP, ALP, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Civil 3D would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of soil mechanics, rock mechanics and engineering geology principles.
  • Ability to identify, assess and manage geotechnical risks and develop practical engineering solutions.
  • Willingness to undertake site visits and travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of progressively responsible geotechnical engineering experience.
  • Experience delivering transportation, water, building, industrial or energy infrastructure projects.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary project interfaces.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor junior technical staff.
  • Experience managing project budgets, programmes, resources and client deliverables.
  • Postgraduate qualification in Geotechnical Engineering would be advantageous.
  • Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) or Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Civil Engineering.
  • Minimum of 8 years' post-graduate experience in geotechnical investigation, interpretation and design.
  • Registered as a Professional Engineer (Pr Eng) with ECSA.
  • Demonstrated experience in geotechnical design for civil infrastructure projects.

At AECOM, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity

At AECOM, our Freedom to Grow philosophy supports flexibility and balance to help our people thrive. As part of this approach, we ask all hybrid employees to work from an AECOM office at least three days per week.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
